local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui=game:GetService("StarterGui")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local screen=script.Parent
local ui=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MarketReign"):WaitForChild("TerminalUI"))
local controller=ui.Mount(screen)
-- Private replies for the server-owned /reset command. This remote has no server event handler.
local noticeConnection
task.spawn(function()
 local remote=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MarketReign:WaitForChild("OwnerNotice")
 noticeConnection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
  if type(message)~="string"then return end
  local channels=game:GetService("TextChatService"):FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
  local channel=channels and (channels:FindFirstChild("RBXSystem")or channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral"))
  if channel then
   local safe=message:gsub("&","&"):gsub("<","<"):gsub(">",">")
   channel:DisplaySystemMessage("[Get Funded!] "..safe)
  end
 end)
end)
-- Keep the Roblox system menu, but prevent avatar controls covering the trading workspace.
pcall(function()StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,false)end)
pcall(function()StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Health,false)end)
pcall(function()StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList,false)end)
game:GetService("GuiService").TouchControlsEnabled=false
-- Humanoid state switches are local to each simulation; disable jumping on the client too.
-- CharacterAdded covers respawns even though this ScreenGui survives them.
local function disableJump(character)
 local humanoid=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
 if not humanoid or player.Character~=character then return end
 humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,false)
 humanoid.AutoJumpEnabled=false;humanoid.Jump=false;humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
end
local characterConnection=player.CharacterAdded:Connect(disableJump)
if player.Character then task.spawn(disableJump,player.Character)end
screen.Destroying:Connect(function()
 characterConnection:Disconnect();if noticeConnection then noticeConnection:Disconnect()end;controller:Destroy()
end)

-- Native Roblox GUI. All panels and chart marks are editable GuiObjects.
local Market = require(script.Parent.MarketClient)
local ChartView = require(script.Parent.ChartView)
local Feedback = require(script.Parent.UIFeedback)
local LeaderboardClient = require(script.Parent.LeaderboardClient)
local LeaderboardView = require(script.Parent.LeaderboardView)
local StatsView = require(script.Parent.StatsView)
local ProgressView = require(script.Parent.ProgressView)
local BadgeArt=require(script.Parent.BadgeArt)
local AwayView=require(script.Parent.AwayView)
local ShopView = require(script.Parent.ShopView)
local DepthPurchase = require(script.Parent.DepthPurchase)
local Level2View = require(script.Parent.Level2View)
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local UI = {}
-- ImageGen artwork: icons/copy-trading/follower-checkmark.png (transparent RGBA).
local FOLLOWER_CHECKMARK = "rbxassetid://87249253289841"
-- ImageGen artwork in icons/trade-outcomes; the sign of the actual closing P&L selects the face.
local TRADE_OUTCOME_FACES={Profit="rbxassetid://115617570278067",Loss="rbxassetid://128402867973425"}
local painting -- Chart painting is synchronous; input handlers live on a separate, stable surface.
local fx -- Interaction feedback (tweens and sounds) for the mounted workspace; nil in Edit previews.
local C = {
 -- Colorful game terminal. Opaque plotting surfaces preserve hollow candle readability.
 Bg=Color3.fromRGB(2,17,49), Panel=Color3.fromRGB(5,39,111), Raised=Color3.fromRGB(50,40,147),
 Chart=Color3.fromRGB(3,25,65), Border=Color3.fromRGB(27,92,196), Grid=Color3.fromRGB(20,62,119),
 Text=Color3.fromRGB(245,249,255), Muted=Color3.fromRGB(159,210,248), Blue=Color3.fromRGB(190,132,255),
 Green=Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160), Red=Color3.fromRGB(255,81,127), Buy=Color3.fromRGB(0,211,135), Sell=Color3.fromRGB(249,58,116),
 Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(0,220,255),
}
-- All interface copy uses the same rounded family. Chart axes use a compact numeric font.
local F,M,B,N=Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local function clean(value)
 return (value:gsub("⌄","v"):gsub("⌃","^"):gsub("⋮","..."):gsub("☑","[x]"):gsub("☐","[ ]"))
end
local function make(class,name,parent,props,identity)
 if painting then local o=painting:Get(class,name,parent);painting:Props(o,props or{},identity);return o end
 local o=Instance.new(class);o.Name=name
 for k,v in pairs(props or {})do o[k]=v end
 o.Parent=parent;return o
end
local function frame(p,name,x,y,w,h,color,z,identity)
 return make("Frame",name,p,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=color or C.Panel,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=z or p.ZIndex or 1},identity)
end
local function text(p,name,value,x,y,w,h,size,color,font,align,z)
 return make("TextLabel",name,p,{Text=clean(value),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
  TextColor3=color or C.Text,TextSize=size or 13,Font=font or F,
  TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(1,15,49),TextStrokeTransparency=(font==Enum.Font.RobotoMono or name=="Watermark"or(color and math.max(color.R,color.G,color.B)<.35))and 1 or .55,
  TextXAlignment=align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,ZIndex=z or p.ZIndex})
end
local function stroke(p,color) return make("UIStroke","Border",p,{Color=color or C.Border,Thickness=1,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})end
local function round(p,r)make("UICorner","Corners",p,{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 8)})end
-- Keep outlined cards and centred hover growth inside each scrolling viewport.
local function insetScroll(sc)
 local inset=math.max(8,math.ceil(sc.Size.X.Offset*.01))
 make("UIPadding","ContentPadding",sc,{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,inset),PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,inset)})
 return sc.Size.X.Offset-inset*2-sc.ScrollBarThickness-4,inset
end
local function tint(p,top,bottom)
 -- CanvasGroup gradients tint the composited children too. Keep color on a background layer.
 if p:IsA("CanvasGroup")then
  local surface=frame(p,"GradientSurface",0,0,0,0,p.BackgroundColor3,p.ZIndex)
  surface.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);surface.BackgroundTransparency=p.BackgroundTransparency
  local corners=p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner");if corners then corners:Clone().Parent=surface end
  p.BackgroundTransparency=1;p=surface
 end
 return make("UIGradient","SurfaceLight",p,{Color=ColorSequence.new(top or Color3.new(1,1,1),bottom or Color3.fromRGB(213,213,229)),Rotation=90})
end
local function panel(p,accent)
 local gamePanel=p.Name=="Chart"or p.Name=="OrderTicket"or p.Name=="Activity"
 round(p,gamePanel and 17 or 14)
 local edge=stroke(p,gamePanel and Color3.fromRGB(0,112,255)or accent or C.Border);edge.Thickness=gamePanel and 4 or 1
 if p.Name=="OrderTicket"or p.Name=="Activity"then
  p.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
  tint(p,p.Name=="OrderTicket"and Color3.fromRGB(52,29,190)or Color3.fromRGB(5,46,129),Color3.fromRGB(3,29,79))
 elseif p.BackgroundColor3~=C.Chart then tint(p)end
end
-- Tabs, segments, toggles and pickers use the softer selection sound.
local SELECT_NAMES={Market=true,Limit=true,Toggle=true,Same=true,Proportional=true,ShowLevels=true,SoundToggle=true}
local function selectable(name)
 return SELECT_NAMES[name]or name:match("^Tab")or name:match("^Nav")or name:match("^Market%u")or name:match("^Time")
  or name:match("^Choose")or name:match("^Lead")or name:match("^Follow")or name:match("^Tool")or name:match("^Level")
end
local function button(p,name,value,x,y,w,h,fn,color,fg,size,z)
 local b=make("TextButton",name,p,{Text=clean(value),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=color or C.Raised,
  BackgroundTransparency=color==false and 1 or 0,BorderSizePixel=0,TextColor3=fg or C.Text,TextSize=size or 13,Font=M,
  TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(1,15,49),TextStrokeTransparency=.55,AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=z or p.ZIndex})
 if color~=false then round(b);stroke(b,fg==C.Blue and C.Blue or C.Border)end
 -- Buttons in a "StaticButtons" container (clipped lists) keep their geometry, so hover growth never clips.
 if name=="BuyLong"or name=="SellShort"or p:GetAttribute("StaticButtons")then b:SetAttribute("FixedGeometry",true)end
 -- One guarded activation path: repeat clicks are debounced, disabled controls ignored, and each
 -- control plays its sound (attribute "Sound": Click, Tick, Select, Open, None).
 b.Activated:Connect(function(...)
  local f=fx
  if f then
   if b.Active==false or f:Guard(b,b:GetAttribute("Debounce"))then return end
   local sound=b:GetAttribute("Sound")
   if sound~="None"then f:Play(sound or(selectable(name)and"Select"or"Click"))end
  end
  fn(...)
 end)
 if fx and name~="OverlayBackdrop"and name~="SheetBackdrop"then
  local area=w*h
  fx:Bind(b,area>18000 and{Lift=1.015,Press=.975}or area>6000 and{Lift=1.025,Press=.955}or{Lift=1.05,Press=.92})
 end
 return b
end
-- Glossy game controls. Every variant: vertical gradient, bright rim, shine strip and outlined label.
local GLOSS={
 Purple={Color3.fromRGB(152,80,255),Color3.fromRGB(80,28,214),Color3.fromRGB(196,140,255)},
 Navy={Color3.fromRGB(15,48,117),Color3.fromRGB(3,24,66),Color3.fromRGB(27,92,196)},
 Grey={Color3.fromRGB(100,108,124),Color3.fromRGB(55,62,77),Color3.fromRGB(145,154,173)},
 Cyan={Color3.fromRGB(0,192,255),Color3.fromRGB(0,94,228),Color3.fromRGB(80,232,255)},
 Green={Color3.fromRGB(34,253,158),Color3.fromRGB(0,173,112),Color3.fromRGB(129,255,202)},
 Pink={Color3.fromRGB(255,120,168),Color3.fromRGB(231,40,99),Color3.fromRGB(255,168,197)},
 Red={Color3.fromRGB(255,109,136),Color3.fromRGB(222,30,72),Color3.fromRGB(255,158,175)},
 Gold={Color3.fromRGB(255,222,40),Color3.fromRGB(255,158,0),Color3.fromRGB(255,244,120)},
}
local GLOSS_INK={Purple=Color3.fromRGB(40,10,120),Navy=Color3.fromRGB(1,15,49),Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(0,48,130),Green=Color3.fromRGB(0,112,72),
 Pink=Color3.fromRGB(160,20,70),Red=Color3.fromRGB(140,14,44),Gold=Color3.fromRGB(150,70,0),Grey=Color3.fromRGB(37,42,54)}
local function glossy(b,variant)
 variant=GLOSS[variant]and variant or"Navy"
 local g=GLOSS[variant]
 local gradient=b:FindFirstChild("ControlLight")
 if not gradient then
  b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);b.BackgroundTransparency=0;b:SetAttribute("RestingColor",Color3.new(1,1,1));b.Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
  gradient=make("UIGradient","ControlLight",b,{Rotation=90})
  local edge=b:FindFirstChild("Border")or stroke(b);edge.Thickness=2
  if not b:FindFirstChild("Corners")then round(b,9)end
  -- A gradient on a TextButton also tints its own text. A child label stays white.
  b.TextTransparency=1;b.TextStrokeTransparency=1
  local label=text(b,"ControlLabel",b.Text,4,0,b.Size.X.Offset-8,b.Size.Y.Offset,b.TextSize,C.Text,Enum.Font.FredokaOne,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,b.ZIndex+2)
  label.TextStrokeTransparency=1
  label.TextScaled=true;make("UITextSizeConstraint","TextSize",label,{MinTextSize=8,MaxTextSize=math.max(8,b.TextSize)})
  make("UIStroke","TextOutline",label,{Color=GLOSS_INK[variant],Thickness=1.5,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual})
 end
 if b:GetAttribute("Gloss")~=variant then
  gradient.Color=ColorSequence.new(g[1],g[2]);b.Border.Color=g[3];b:SetAttribute("Gloss",variant)
  local label=b:FindFirstChild("ControlLabel");local outline=label and label:FindFirstChild("TextOutline")
  if outline then outline.Color=GLOSS_INK[variant]end
  local shine=b:FindFirstChild("Shine")
  if variant~="Navy"and not shine and b.Size.X.Offset>=30 and b.Size.Y.Offset>=24 then
   shine=make("Frame","Shine",b,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,3),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(b.Size.X.Offset-16,3),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),
    BackgroundTransparency=.5,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=b.ZIndex+1});round(shine,2)
  elseif variant=="Navy"and shine then shine:Destroy()end
 end
 return b
end
-- Glossy selection controls share the interface typography.
local function gameControl(b,selected)
 glossy(b,selected and"Purple"or"Navy")
 if b:GetAttribute("ControlSelected")~=selected then
  b.Border.Color=selected and C.Blue or C.Border;b:SetAttribute("ControlSelected",selected)
  if fx then fx:Selected(b,selected)end
 end
 return b
end
local function gameHeading(label)
 label.Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne;label.TextStrokeTransparency=1
 make("UIStroke","TextOutline",label,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(1,15,49),Thickness=2,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual})
 return label
end
local function panelStars(p)
 local w,h=p.Size.X.Offset,p.Size.Y.Offset
 for i,xy in ipairs({{.93,.09,20},{.96,.92,24},{.035,.92,20}})do
  local size=xy[3]
  local star=frame(p,"Star"..i,xy[1]*w-size/2,xy[2]*h-size/2,size,size,C.Panel,p.ZIndex);star.BackgroundTransparency=1
  for ray=0,4 do
   local angle=math.rad(-90+ray*72)
   local arm=frame(star,"Ray",size/2,size/2,size*.46,size*.28,Color3.fromRGB(29,98,226),p.ZIndex)
   arm.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5);arm.Rotation=math.deg(angle);arm.BackgroundTransparency=.65;round(arm,size*.1)
  end
 end
end
local function rule(p,x,y,w,color,z)return frame(p,"Rule",x,y,w,1,color or C.Border,z)end
local function line(p,name,x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width,z)
 local l=frame(p,name,(x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2,Vector2.new(x2-x1,y2-y1).Magnitude,width or 1,color,z)
 l.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);l.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1));return l
end
-- Red glossy close button with a drawn cross (the reference popups' X).
local function dismissButton(p,x,y,size,fn,z)
 local d=button(p,"Dismiss","",x,y,size,size,fn,Color3.new(1,1,1),C.Text,20,z or p.ZIndex+2)
 d.Corners.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,math.floor(size*.26));d.Border.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,158,175);d.Border.Thickness=3
 tint(d,Color3.fromRGB(255,109,136),Color3.fromRGB(227,33,77))
 local pad=size*.3
 for _,pts in ipairs({{pad,pad,size-pad,size-pad},{pad,size-pad,size-pad,pad}})do
  local shadow=line(d,"CrossShadow",pts[1],pts[2]+1,pts[3],pts[4]+1,Color3.fromRGB(174,21,52),math.max(5,size*.16),d.ZIndex+1);round(shadow,4)
  local cross=line(d,"Cross",pts[1],pts[2],pts[3],pts[4],C.Text,math.max(3,size*.1),d.ZIndex+2);round(cross,3)
 end
 return d
end
-- Small line icons are native GuiObjects, so no external image assets are required.
local function icon(p,kind,x,y,size,color)
 local box=frame(p,"Icon"..kind,x,y,size,size,C.Panel);box.BackgroundTransparency=1
 local function l(a,b,c,d)line(box,"Path",a*size,b*size,c*size,d*size,color or C.Blue,1.5)end
 if kind=="Trade"or kind=="Equity"then
  for i,hh in ipairs({.3,.55,.8})do
   local bar=frame(box,"Bar",(i-1)*size*.31,size*(1-hh),size*.17,size*hh,C.Panel);bar.BackgroundTransparency=1;stroke(bar,color or C.Blue)
  end
 elseif kind=="Positions"or kind=="Balance"then
  l(.08,.3,.92,.3);l(.92,.3,.92,.87);l(.92,.87,.08,.87);l(.08,.87,.08,.3)
  l(.31,.3,.31,.12);l(.31,.12,.67,.12);l(.67,.12,.67,.3);l(.08,.5,.92,.5)
 elseif kind=="Learn"then
  l(.5,.18,.5,.91);l(.08,.1,.5,.18);l(.5,.18,.92,.1);l(.08,.1,.08,.78);l(.92,.1,.92,.78);l(.08,.78,.5,.91);l(.5,.91,.92,.78)
 elseif kind=="Review"then
  l(.12,.15,.88,.15);l(.88,.15,.88,.9);l(.88,.9,.12,.9);l(.12,.9,.12,.15);l(.28,.38,.72,.38);l(.28,.57,.72,.57);l(.28,.76,.55,.76)
 elseif kind=="Accounts"or kind=="Trophy"then
  l(.24,.12,.76,.12);l(.24,.12,.31,.5);l(.76,.12,.69,.5);l(.31,.5,.69,.5);l(.5,.5,.5,.72);l(.34,.72,.66,.72)
  l(.34,.72,.28,.9);l(.66,.72,.72,.9);l(.28,.9,.72,.9);l(.24,.2,.08,.2);l(.08,.2,.16,.4);l(.76,.2,.92,.2);l(.92,.2,.84,.4)
 elseif kind=="Lock"then
  l(.2,.45,.8,.45);l(.8,.45,.8,.9);l(.8,.9,.2,.9);l(.2,.9,.2,.45);l(.34,.45,.34,.2);l(.34,.2,.66,.2);l(.66,.2,.66,.45);l(.5,.6,.5,.75)
 elseif kind=="Copy"then
  l(.1,.32,.62,.32);l(.62,.32,.62,.9);l(.62,.9,.1,.9);l(.1,.9,.1,.32);l(.38,.32,.38,.1);l(.38,.1,.9,.1);l(.9,.1,.9,.68);l(.9,.68,.62,.68)
 elseif kind=="Check"then
  l(.14,.55,.4,.8);l(.4,.8,.88,.22)
 else
  l(.5,.9,.5,.1);l(.5,.1,.18,.42);l(.5,.1,.82,.42)
 end
 return box
end
local function dash(p,x,y,w,color,d,z,t)
 if painting then return painting:Dash(p,x,y,w,color,d,z,t)end
 t=t or 1
 for off=0,w,d+5 do frame(p,"DashedLine",x+off,y-(t-1)//2,math.min(d,w-off),t,color,z)end
end
local RIGHT,CENTER=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
-- Colorful game summary: uploaded transparent artwork with native, live text.
local SC={Ink=Color3.fromRGB(3,18,55),Green=Color3.fromRGB(50,255,91),Red=Color3.fromRGB(255,143,166)}
local SF=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local summaryThemes={
 Balance={Top=Color3.fromRGB(0,171,255),Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(0,91,230),Edge=Color3.fromRGB(17,211,255),Base=Color3.fromRGB(0,56,153),Image="rbxassetid://84096597834437"},
 Equity={Top=Color3.fromRGB(137,57,255),Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(78,31,220),Edge=Color3.fromRGB(183,105,255),Base=Color3.fromRGB(56,12,145),Image="rbxassetid://135864586704544"},
 Unrealized={Top=Color3.fromRGB(0,216,107),Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(0,145,100),Edge=Color3.fromRGB(10,245,134),Base=Color3.fromRGB(0,84,66),Image="rbxassetid://140314319475475"},
 Trophy={Top=Color3.fromRGB(255,224,33),Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(255,167,0),Edge=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,98),Base=Color3.fromRGB(166,77,0),Image="rbxassetid://80175474742009"},
 Blown={Top=Color3.fromRGB(255,96,150),Bottom=Color3.fromRGB(190,22,92),Edge=Color3.fromRGB(255,178,204),Base=Color3.fromRGB(104,8,54)},
}
local function summarySurface(tile,kind,compact)
 local theme=summaryThemes[kind]
 local w,h=tile.Size.X.Offset,tile.Size.Y.Offset
 local radius=compact and 10 or 20
 local depth=compact and 3 or 8
 local base=frame(tile.Parent,kind.."Depth",tile.Position.X.Offset,tile.Position.Y.Offset+depth,w,h,theme.Base,2)
 round(base,radius);local outline=stroke(base,SC.Ink);outline.Thickness=compact and 3 or 6
 tile.ZIndex=3;tile.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 tile.Border.Color=theme.Edge;tile.Border.Thickness=compact and 2 or 4
 tile.Corners.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius)
 tint(tile,theme.Top,theme.Bottom)
 local texture=frame(tile,"Texture",5,5,w-10,h-10,theme.Top,3);texture.BackgroundTransparency=1
 texture.ClipsDescendants=true;round(texture,radius-3)
 if not compact then
  for i,xy in ipairs({{.1,.18},{.88,.2},{.12,.78},{.84,.8},{.55,.12}})do
   local d=frame(texture,"Diamond"..i,xy[1]*(w-20),xy[2]*(h-20),12,12,Color3.new(1,1,1),3)
   d.Rotation=45;d.BackgroundTransparency=.93;round(d,2)
  end
  local shine=frame(texture,"Shine",w*.16,-h*.25,w*.13,h*1.6,Color3.new(1,1,1),3)
  shine.Rotation=38;shine.BackgroundTransparency=.94
 end
end
-- Shared by the chart header and order ticket at every viewport size.
local function instrumentSelector(p,value,x,y,w,h,fn,size)
 local b
 b=gameControl(button(p,"ContractSelector",value,x,y,w,h,function()fn(b)end,C.Chart,C.Text,size),false)
 local label=b.ControlLabel
 label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0);label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w-48,h);label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
 local chevron=frame(b,"Chevron",w-28,(h-14)/2,16,14,C.Chart,b.ZIndex+2);chevron.BackgroundTransparency=1;chevron.Active=false
 line(chevron,"Left",2,4,8,10,C.Text,3,chevron.ZIndex)
 line(chevron,"Right",8,10,14,4,C.Text,3,chevron.ZIndex)
 b.Border.Color=C.Cyan
 return b
end
local function summaryIcon(p,kind,x,y,size,negative)
 return make("ImageLabel","IconPanel",p,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),
  BackgroundTransparency=1,Image=summaryThemes[kind].Image,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,ZIndex=5,
  Rotation=0,ImageColor3=negative and Color3.fromRGB(255,176,189)or Color3.new(1,1,1)})
end
local function summaryText(p,name,value,x,y,w,h,size,color,compact)
 local label=text(p,name,value,x,y,w,h,size,color or C.Text,SF,nil,6)
 label.TextStrokeTransparency=1
 label.TextScaled=true
 make("UITextSizeConstraint","TypeSize",label,{MinTextSize=compact and 8 or 10,MaxTextSize=size})
 make("UIStroke","TextOutline",label,{Color=SC.Ink,Thickness=compact and 1.5 or math.clamp(size*.09,2,4),ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round})
 return label
end
-- Fixed-size text for labels on cards that lift on hover. TextScaled re-measures against the lifted (UIScale)
-- size and can re-wrap, so these take the largest size up to the label's constraint that fits its box once.
local function fixText(label)
 local constraint=label:FindFirstChild("TypeSize")
 local size=constraint and constraint.MaxTextSize or label.TextSize
 local floor=constraint and constraint.MinTextSize or 8
 local w,h=label.Size.X.Offset,label.Size.Y.Offset

 local function submitOrder(dir,orderType,price,qty,label)

  local paths=dir>0 and tradePaths or sellPaths
  if type(qty)~="number" or qty~=qty or qty==math.huge or qty<1 or qty%1~=0 then fail("Enter a whole number of contracts, starting at 1.");effect(paths,"Error");return false end
  for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do

   fail("Order too large. Available now: "..max.." "..s.Contract.." contracts.");effect(paths,"Error");return false

 local function coachProgress()
  if not s.Coach then return false end
  local fill,hist=session.Fills[1],session.History[1]
  local base=s.CoachBase
  if not base or base.Account~=session.AccountKey then
   s.CoachBase={Account=session.AccountKey,Fill=fill and fill.TradeId,History=hist and hist.TradeId};return false
  end
  local before=s.Coach
  if s.Coach<=3 and fill and fill.TradeId~=base.Fill then s.Coach=4;base.Fill=fill.TradeId end
  if s.Coach==4 and hist and hist.TradeId~=base.History then s.Coach=5 end
  return s.Coach~=before
 end

-- Read-only client view. All orders and balances are owned by MarketServer.

local root=script.Parent

local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)

local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)

local Protection=require(root.TradeProtection)
local ContractLimits=require(root.ContractLimits)
local Market={DepthLevels=Config.DepthLevels or 5,Contracts=Config.Contracts,ContractOrder=Config.ContractOrder,Progression=Progression,ContractLimit=ContractLimits.ForBalance}
Market.Contracts=table.clone(Config.Contracts)

Market.PositionOrder=table.clone(Config.ContractOrder)

for _,key in ipairs(Config.LegacyOrder) do Market.Contracts[key]=Config.LegacyContracts[key];table.insert(Market.PositionOrder,key) end

function Market.Number(value)

 local raw=string.format("%.2f",math.abs(value or 0)) local whole,decimal=raw:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")

 return ((value or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","").."."..decimal

end

function Market.Money(value) return "$"..Market.Number(value) end

function Market.Signed(value) return (value<0 and "−" or "+")..Market.Money(math.abs(value)) end

function Market.Snap(value,key) return math.round(value/Config.Contracts[key].Tick)*Config.Contracts[key].Tick end

Market.Protection=Protection.Resolve

local Session={} Session.__index=Session

function Market.New(base,preview,previewData)

 base=base or Progression.StartingBalance

 local self=setmetatable({Base=base,Prices={},Quotes={},Positions={},Orders={},History={},Fills={},Cache={},
  ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(),ClosedEvents={},ClosedEventOrder={},
  Time=0,Regime="Connecting",EventBacklog={},Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed,Ready=false,CanTrade=false,NextId=0,Pending={},Contract=Config.ContractOrder[1],Timeframe="1m",

  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Replies=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Events=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Preview=preview},Session)

 self.SummaryData={Balance=base,Equity=base,Unrealized=0,Session=0,Allowance=Progression.StartingBalance,Count=0,Margin=0}

 for _,key in ipairs(Market.ContractOrder) do self.Prices[key]=Market.Contracts[key].Last end

 if preview then

  self.Regime="Edit preview"

  if previewData then

   -- An offline snapshot generated by the real exchange, used only to author Studio's saved GUI.

   self.Quotes=previewData.Quotes self.Cache=previewData.CandlesBySeries

   self.Time=previewData.Time self.Step=previewData.Step

   for key,quote in pairs(self.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  end

  return self

 end

 self.Remote=root:WaitForChild("OrderRequest",60)

 local update=root:WaitForChild("MarketUpdate",60)

 if not self.Remote or not update then self.Regime="Exchange unavailable" return self end

 self.Connection=update.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)

  self.DepthAccess=packet.DepthAccess or {Allowed=false,State="Checking"}
  self.DepthReceivedAt=os.clock();self.DepthContract=packet.Contract
  self.DepthLive=not packet.StatusOnly and packet.CanTrade==true
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed or not self.DepthLive then
   for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end
  end

  self.CanTrade=packet.CanTrade==true self.ConnectionStatus=packet.ConnectionStatus self.PersistenceMode=packet.PersistenceMode

  -- Atomic funded portfolio and live unlock projection arrive with each price batch.

  if packet.Portfolio then
   self.Portfolio=packet.Portfolio
   if not self.PreferencesDirty and not self.PreferencesPending then
    self.ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(packet.Portfolio.ProtectionPreferences)
   end
  end
  -- Lifetime stats are computed and persisted by the server; sent when they change.

  if packet.Stats then self.Stats=packet.Stats self.StatsAt=os.clock() end

  if packet.StatusOnly then

   if packet.NoAccount then

    -- No trading account yet (first join): clear any previous account view.

    self.Ready=false self.AccountKey=nil self.AccountToken=nil self.Positions={} self.Orders={} self.History={} self.Fills={}

   end

   for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {})do self:_reply(reply)end
   for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

   self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()return
  end

  self.Ready=true self.Base=packet.Base self.AccountKey=packet.AccountKey self.AccountToken=packet.AccountToken self.Positions=packet.Positions

  self.Orders=packet.Orders or self.Orders self.History=packet.History or self.History self.Fills=packet.Fills or self.Fills

  self.SummaryData=packet.Summary self.Quotes=packet.Quotes self.Time=packet.Time
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed then for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end end

  -- Server-computed maximum new order per instrument/side (same rule the exchange enforces).

  self.Capacity=packet.Capacity self.Limit=packet.Limit self.Triggers=packet.Triggers or {}

  self.Regime=packet.Regime self.News=packet.News self.Speed=packet.Speed self.Step=packet.Step

  for key,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  local cacheKey=packet.Contract..":"..packet.Timeframe

  -- A subscription can be dropped by the server's request rate limit (fast contract/timeframe

  -- switching). If the server is still streaming another series, ask again instead of waiting forever.

  if(packet.Contract~=self.Contract or packet.Timeframe~=self.Timeframe)and os.clock()-(self.SubscribedAt or 0)>1.5 then

   self:Subscribe(self.Contract,self.Timeframe)

  end

  if packet.Full then self.Cache[cacheKey]=packet.Candles else

   local data=self.Cache[cacheKey] or {} self.Cache[cacheKey]=data

   for _,candle in ipairs(packet.Candles) do

    local found=false

    for i=math.max(1,#data-2),#data do if data[i].Time==candle.Time then data[i]=candle found=true break end end

    if not found then table.insert(data,candle) end

   end

   while #data>Config.MaxCandles do table.remove(data,1) end

  end

  for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {}) do self:_reply(reply) end
  for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

  self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()
 end)

 self:Subscribe(Config.ContractOrder[1],"1m")

 local start=os.clock() while not self.Ready and not self.ConnectionStatus and os.clock()-start<45 do task.wait(0.1) end

 return self

end

-- Server events (unlocks, depletion notices) are announced once. Events that arrive before the UI

-- listens (the first packets after joining or reconnecting) are kept and replayed to OnEvent.

function Session:_event(event)
 if (event.Kind=="RankUp" or event.Kind=="Milestone")and event.Id then
  self.ProgressionEvents=self.ProgressionEvents or {};local key=event.Kind..":"..event.Id
  if self.ProgressionEvents[key]then return end;self.ProgressionEvents[key]=true
 end
 if event.Kind=="TradeClosed"then
  -- Execution identity, not price or a disappearing position, is the source of confirmation.
  if not event.Account or not event.TradeId then return end
  local key=event.Account..":"..event.TradeId
  if self.ClosedEvents[key]then return end
  self.ClosedEvents[key]=true;table.insert(self.ClosedEventOrder,key)
  if #self.ClosedEventOrder>128 then self.ClosedEvents[table.remove(self.ClosedEventOrder,1)]=nil end
 end
 if self.EventHandler then self.EventHandler(event) else table.insert(self.EventBacklog,event) end

 self.Events:Fire(event)

end
function Session:_reply(reply)
 self.Pending[reply.RequestId]=nil
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if pending and pending.Id==reply.RequestId then
  self.PreferencesPending=nil
  if reply.Ok and Protection.SamePreferences(self.ProtectionPreferences,pending.Value)then self.PreferencesDirty=false end
  -- A retry can be rejected during an exchange pause; retain the latest local intention.
  self.PreferencesRetryAt=os.clock()+(reply.Ok and 0 or 2)
 end
 self.Replies:Fire(reply)
end
function Session:_flushPreferences(force)
 if self.Preview or not self.PreferencesDirty or not self.CanTrade then return end
 if not force and os.clock()<(self.PreferencesRetryAt or 0)then return end
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if not force and pending and os.clock()-pending.At<2 then return end
 if pending then self.Pending[pending.Id]=nil end
 local value=table.clone(self.ProtectionPreferences)
 local ok,_,_,id=self:Send("ProtectionPreferences",table.clone(value))
 if ok then self.PreferencesPending={Id=id,Value=value,At=os.clock()}end
end
function Session:SetProtectionPreferences(value)
 local clean=Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if not clean then return false,"Check your stop loss and take profit settings. Use amounts greater than $0."end
 self.ProtectionPreferences=clean;self.PreferencesDirty=true;self:_flushPreferences(true)
 return true
end
function Session:OnEvent(fn)

 self.EventHandler=fn

 local backlog=self.EventBacklog self.EventBacklog={}

 for _,event in ipairs(backlog) do fn(event) end

end

function Session:Send(action,request,expectedAccount)

 if self.Preview then return false,"Edit preview only. Press Play to trade." end

 if not self.Remote then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"and not self.CanTrade then return false,self.ConnectionStatus or "Waiting for the exchange."end

 local now=os.clock()
 -- Bound pending acknowledgements even when the server rate-limits or loses a reply.
 local pendingCount,oldestId,oldestAt=0,nil,math.huge
 for id,at in pairs(self.Pending)do
  if now-at>30 then self.Pending[id]=nil else
   pendingCount+=1;if at<oldestAt then oldestId=id;oldestAt=at end
  end
 end
 if action=="Place"then
  self.PlaceTokens=math.min(6,(self.PlaceTokens or 6)+(now-(self.PlaceTokenTime or now))*5);self.PlaceTokenTime=now
  if self.PlaceTokens<1 then return false,"Orders are arriving too quickly. Wait a moment before placing another."end
  self.PlaceTokens-=1
 end

 self.NextId+=1 request=request or {} request.Id=self.NextId request.Action=action

 request.ExpectedAccount=expectedAccount or self.AccountToken

 -- These read requests are answered by a snapshot, not a request acknowledgement.
 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"then
  if pendingCount>=64 and oldestId then self.Pending[oldestId]=nil end
  self.Pending[self.NextId]=now
 end
 self.Remote:FireServer(request)

 return true,"Order sent to exchange.","Orders",self.NextId

end

function Session:Subscribe(key,tf)

 self.Contract=key self.Timeframe=tf self.SubscribedAt=os.clock() self:Send("Subscribe",{Contract=key,Timeframe=tf})

end

function Session:Candles(key,tf) return self.Cache[key..":"..tf] or {} end

function Session:Pnl(p) return p.Unrealized or 0 end

function Session:Summary() return self.SummaryData end

function Session:Working() return self.Orders end

function Session:Cancel(id,protection) return self:Send("Cancel",{OrderId=id,Protection=protection}) end

function Session:AmendProtection(key,id,field,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:AmendOrder(key,id,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendOrder",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:Close(key) return self:Send("Close",{Contract=key}) end

-- Lifecycle requests always include ExpectedAccount through Send.

function Session:Start() return self:Send("Start",{}) end

function Session:Restart() return self:Send("Restart",{}) end
function Session:ResetAccount(expectedAccount) return self:Send("ResetAccount",{},expectedAccount) end
function Session:AcknowledgeAway(id) return self:Send("AcknowledgeAway",{SummaryId=id})end
function Session:CreateProtection(key,id,field,price,quantity)
 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=quantity})
end

function Session:Flag(stage) return self:Send("Flag",{Stage=stage}) end

function Session:RefreshStats() return self:Send("Stats",{}) end

-- orderType: "Market", "Limit" (price = limit) or "Stop" (price = stop trigger; an entry that becomes a

-- market order when a trade reaches it). The server validates every field.

function Session:Place(key,direction,quantity,orderType,price,stopDollars,targetDollars,execution)

 if not self.Ready then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 return self:Send("Place",{Contract=key,Direction=direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=orderType,Execution=execution or "Immediate",

  Price=(orderType=="Limit" or orderType=="Stop") and price or nil,StopDollars=stopDollars,TargetDollars=targetDollars})

end

-- Largest order the exchange currently accepts for this instrument and side (nil until the first packet).

function Session:MaxOrder(key,direction)

 local c=self.Capacity and self.Capacity[key]

 return c and (direction>0 and c.Buy or c.Sell) or nil

end

function Session:Destroy()

 if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect() end self.Changed:Destroy() self.Replies:Destroy() self.Events:Destroy()

end

return Market

local V=require(script.Parent.ChartViewport)

return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 local function series(n,interval)

  local c={} for i=1,n do local o=100+math.sin(i/7)*5 c[i]={Time=(i-1)*(interval or 60),Open=o,High=o+2,Low=o-2,Close=o+(i%3==0 and -1 or 1),Volume=i} end return c

 end

 local candles=series(700)

 -- Deep zoom-out is limited by history and by plot width (7 px per candle).

 local minBars,maxBars=V.Limits(#candles,1266)

 check(minBars==10 and maxBars==math.floor(1266/7),"700 candles: zoom-out respects readable spacing: "..maxBars)

 local _,wide=V.Limits(1440,1266) check(wide==math.floor(1266/7),"Long history: zoom-out is limited by plot width at 7 px per candle: "..wide)

 local _,narrow=V.Limits(1440,500) check(narrow==math.floor(500/7),"Narrow plots still allow readable spacing")

 local _,cap=V.Limits(5000,4000) check(cap==V.MaxBars,"Absolute render ceiling")

 local _,small=V.Limits(30,1266) check(small==math.max(40,math.ceil(30*1.15)+5),"Zoom limits follow available history")

 local state={} local live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(live.Live and live.Follow and #live.Data<#candles,"Starts following live with a navigable window")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,1.4,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==maxBars,"Zoom out reaches the practical limit and stops")

 check(live.Right<=candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60+1e-6 and #live.Data<=maxBars+3 and live.Interval==60,"Zoom keeps real one-minute candles and a bounded readable count")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,0.5,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==minBars,"Zoom in stops at the minimum")

 -- Cursor-anchored zoom keeps the time under the pointer fixed (away from bounds).

 V.Reset(state) local v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(state,v,400,0,1266,300) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 for _,f in ipairs({0.1,0.37,0.8})do

  local anchor=V.TimeAt(v,f) V.Zoom(state,v,1.3,f) local z=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(z,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom out keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

  anchor=V.TimeAt(z,f) V.Zoom(state,z,0.7,f) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(v,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom in keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

 end

 -- Detached viewport is preserved when candles arrive; following scrolls with them.

 check(not v.Follow,"Panning into history stops following")

 local right,low=v.Right,v.Low

 local grown=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=130,Low=90,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local after=V.Resolve(state,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(after.Right==right and after.Bars==v.Bars,"New candles do not move a detached viewport")

 local follow={} local f1=V.Resolve(follow,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 local f2=V.Resolve(follow,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(f2.Right-f1.Right==60 and f2.Follow,"Following scrolls by exactly the new candle")

 -- Auto-fit pan moves time only; manual scale pans price too.

 local pan={} local p0=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,p0,100,80,1266,300) local p1=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(p1.AutoY and p1.Right<p0.Right,"Auto-fit drag pans time and keeps auto scale")

 -- Y-axis drag: up = taller candles (narrower range), down = shorter; persists until auto-fit.

 V.ScalePrice(pan,p1,-60,300) local tall=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(not tall.AutoY and tall.High-tall.Low<p1.High-p1.Low,"Dragging the axis up compresses the range")

 V.Pan(pan,tall,-30,40,1266,300) local moved=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs((moved.High-moved.Low)-(tall.High-tall.Low))<1e-9 and moved.Low>tall.Low,"Manual scale survives panning and pans price")

 local grown2=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown2,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=400,Low=10,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local still=V.Resolve(pan,grown2,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(still.Low==moved.Low and still.High==moved.High,"Manual scale persists across live updates")

 V.ScalePrice(pan,moved,80,300) local short=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(short.High-short.Low>moved.High-moved.Low,"Dragging the axis down expands the range")

 V.AutoFit(pan) local fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(fitted.AutoY and fitted.Low==short.Low,"Auto-fit starts from the current scale")

 for _=1,200 do V.Ease(pan,1/60) end fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs(fitted.Low-fitted.TargetLow)<1e-9 and math.abs(fitted.High-fitted.TargetHigh)<1e-9,"Auto-fit settles exactly on the visible candles")

 local lo,hi=math.huge,-math.huge

 for _,c in ipairs(fitted.Data)do if c.Time>=fitted.Left-30 and c.Time<=fitted.Right+30 then lo=math.min(lo,c.Low) hi=math.max(hi,c.High)end end

 check(fitted.Low<lo and fitted.High>hi,"Auto-fit contains every visible candle")

 -- Go to live keeps the zoom; reset restores defaults.

 V.Zoom(pan,fitted,1.5,0.5) local zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,zoomed,600,0,1266,300) zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.GoLive(pan,101) local back=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(back.Follow and back.Bars==zoomed.Bars and back.Right==candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60,"Go to live keeps zoom and follows")

 V.Reset(pan) local reset=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(reset.Bars==V.DefaultBars.Desktop and reset.Live,"Reset view restores default zoom, auto-fit and live")

 -- Pinch keeps the time under the start midpoint under the current midpoint.

 local pinch={} local pv=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 local anchor=V.TimeAt(pv,0.4) V.Pinch(pinch,pv,0.4,0.55,0.6,0,200)

 local pz=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(pz,0.55)-anchor)<1e-6 and pz.Bars<pv.Bars,"Pinch zoom anchors to the midpoint")

 -- Bounds and degenerate data.

 V.Pan(state,v,-1e8,0,1266,300) local b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right<=b.Maximum,"Right bound")

 V.Pan(state,b,1e8,0,1266,300) b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right>=b.Minimum and #b.Data>0,"Left bound keeps candles visible")

 local one=V.Resolve({},{{Time=0,Open=100,High=100,Low=100,Close=100,Volume=1}},"1D",0.25,false,{100},500)

 check(one.High>one.Low and one.Right>one.Left,"Single flat candle has a valid view")

 -- Ticks are round multiples of the tick size and inside the range.

 local ticks,step=V.PriceTicks(5801.3,5843.9,0.25,6)

 check(step%0.25==0 and #ticks>=3 and ticks[1]>=5801.3 and ticks[#ticks]<=5843.9,"Price ticks")

 for _,t in ipairs(ticks)do check(math.abs(t/step-math.round(t/step))<1e-6,"Price ticks are aligned") end

 local tt,ts=V.TimeTicks(3000,9000,60,6) check(ts>=60 and tt[1]%ts==0,"Time ticks aligned")

 check(candles[1].Time==0 and candles[700].Time==699*60,"Navigation never mutates candles")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Zoom limits, cursor/pinch anchoring, follow vs detached, auto-fit pan, manual Y scale, auto-fit easing, go live, reset, bounds, ticks"}

end

-- Presentation-only chart navigation. Never modifies prices, candles or account state.
-- Time is horizontal (seconds), price is vertical. All inputs are screen deltas in pixels.
local Viewport={}
Viewport.Seconds={["1m"]=60,["5m"]=300,["15m"]=900,["1h"]=3600,["1D"]=86400}
Viewport.MinBars=10          -- deepest zoom-in
Viewport.MaxBars=240        -- absolute zoom-out ceiling (render budget)
Viewport.PixelsPerBar=7      -- readable 3+ px bodies, distinct wicks and space between candles
Viewport.RightMargin=3       -- empty bars to the right of the live candle
Viewport.EaseSeconds=0.07    -- auto-fit price-scale smoothing
Viewport.DefaultBars={Desktop=72,Mobile=36}

-- Practical zoom range: limited by the available history and by how many candles the plot can draw.
function Viewport.Limits(count,width)
 local render=math.clamp(math.floor((width or 800)/Viewport.PixelsPerBar),Viewport.MinBars+10,Viewport.MaxBars)
 local data=math.max(40,math.ceil(count*1.15)+Viewport.RightMargin+2)
 return Viewport.MinBars,math.max(Viewport.MinBars+2,math.min(render,data))
end
-- First index whose candle time is >= time (binary search; candles are time ordered).
local function lowerBound(candles,time)
 local lo,hi=1,#candles+1
 while lo<hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if candles[mid].Time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end end
 return lo
end
Viewport.LowerBound=lowerBound

function Viewport.Resolve(state,candles,timeframe,tick,mobile,levels,width)
 if #candles==0 then return nil end
 local interval=Viewport.Seconds[timeframe]
 local minBars,maxBars=Viewport.Limits(#candles,width)
 state.Bars=math.clamp(state.Bars or (mobile and Viewport.DefaultBars.Mobile or Viewport.DefaultBars.Desktop),minBars,maxBars)
 state.Interval=interval
 local latest,earliest=candles[#candles].Time,candles[1].Time
 if state.Right==nil then state.Right=latest+Viewport.RightMargin*interval state.Follow=true end
 -- Following: new candles scroll the view by exactly the time they add. Detached: the view never moves.
 if state.Follow and state.Latest and latest~=state.Latest then state.Right+=latest-state.Latest end
 state.Latest=latest
 local maximum=latest+state.Bars*0.8*interval
 local minimum=math.min(earliest+math.min(6,state.Bars*0.5)*interval,maximum)
 state.Right=math.clamp(state.Right,minimum,maximum)
 local right=state.Right local left=right-state.Bars*interval
 -- One extra candle each side so partially visible bodies are drawn and clipped, not popped.
 local first=lowerBound(candles,left-interval) local last=lowerBound(candles,right+interval)-1
 local visible=table.move(candles,first,math.max(first-1,last),1,{})
 local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(visible)do
  if c.Time>=left-interval*0.5 and c.Time<=right+interval*0.5 then low=math.min(low,c.Low) high=math.max(high,c.High) end
 end
 if low==math.huge then local c=candles[math.clamp(first,1,#candles)] low=c.Low high=c.High end
 -- While following, keep the live price and the open position's levels in view.
 if state.Follow then for _,price in ipairs(levels or {})do low=math.min(low,price) high=math.max(high,price) end end
 local padding=math.max(tick*2,(high-low)*0.08)
 local targetLow,targetHigh=low-padding,high+padding
 state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh=targetLow,targetHigh
 local auto=state.AutoY~=false
 local lo,hi
 if auto then
  if not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=targetLow,targetHigh end
  lo,hi=state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh
 else lo,hi=state.Low,state.High end
 if hi-lo<tick then local mid=(lo+hi)/2 lo,hi=mid-tick/2,mid+tick/2 end
 return {Left=left,Right=right,Low=lo,High=hi,Bars=state.Bars,Interval=interval,Data=visible,First=first,
  Earliest=earliest,Latest=latest,Minimum=minimum,Maximum=maximum,MinBars=minBars,MaxBars=maxBars,Tick=tick,
  Follow=state.Follow==true,AutoY=auto,TargetLow=targetLow,TargetHigh=targetHigh,
  Live=state.Follow==true and auto}
end
-- Eases the displayed auto-fit range toward its target. Returns true while still moving.
function Viewport.Ease(state,dt,snap)
 if state.AutoY==false or not state.TargetLow then return false end
 if snap or not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false end
 local range=math.max(1e-9,state.TargetHigh-state.TargetLow)
 local dl,dh=state.TargetLow-state.ShowLow,state.TargetHigh-state.ShowHigh
 if math.abs(dl)<range*0.0005 and math.abs(dh)<range*0.0005 then
  state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false
 end
 local k=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/Viewport.EaseSeconds)
 state.ShowLow+=dl*k state.ShowHigh+=dh*k
 return true
end
function Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction) return view.Left+(view.Right-view.Left)*fraction end
function Viewport.PriceAt(view,fraction) return view.High-(view.High-view.Low)*fraction end
function Viewport.X(view,time,width) return (time-view.Left)/(view.Right-view.Left)*width end
function Viewport.Y(view,price,height) return (view.High-price)/(view.High-view.Low)*height end
local function refollow(state)
 if state.Latest and state.Interval then state.Follow=state.Right>=state.Latest+state.Interval*0.5 end
end
-- Manual price scale: fix the current range so later changes are explicit.
local function manual(state,view)
 if state.AutoY~=false then state.AutoY=false state.Low,state.High=view.Low,view.High end
end
function Viewport.Pan(state,start,dx,dy,width,height)
 state.Right=math.clamp(start.Right-dx/math.max(1,width)*(start.Right-start.Left),math.min(start.Minimum,start.Maximum),start.Maximum)
 -- Auto-fit keeps the price axis fitted to the candles; a manual scale pans vertically with the pointer.
 if not start.AutoY then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
function Viewport.Zoom(state,view,factor,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 local bars=math.clamp(view.Bars*factor,view.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,view.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction)
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-fraction)*bars*view.Interval
 -- Zooming out reveals more history, not empty future: the right edge never moves past where it was
 -- (or the live candle's usual margin), so the extra room goes to older candles.
 if bars>view.Bars and view.Latest and view.Interval then
  state.Right=math.min(state.Right,math.max(view.Right,view.Latest+Viewport.RightMargin*view.Interval))
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Two-finger gesture: the time under the starting midpoint stays under the current midpoint.
function Viewport.Pinch(state,start,fromFraction,toFraction,ratio,dy,height)
 local bars=math.clamp(start.Bars*ratio,start.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,start.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(start,math.clamp(fromFraction,0,1))
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-toFraction)*bars*start.Interval
 if not start.AutoY and dy then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Y-axis drag: down expands the visible price range (candles shorter), up compresses it (taller).
function Viewport.ScalePrice(state,start,dy,height)
 local factor=math.exp(math.clamp(dy,-2000,2000)/math.max(120,height)*1.6)
 local mid=(start.Low+start.High)/2
 local half=math.clamp((start.High-start.Low)/2*factor,(start.Tick or 0.01)*2,math.max(1,math.abs(mid))*2)
 state.AutoY=false state.Low=mid-half state.High=mid+half
end
function Viewport.AutoFit(state)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.Low,state.High end
 state.AutoY=true state.Low=nil state.High=nil
end
-- Follow the live candle again at the current zoom. A manual scale is re-centred on the live price.
function Viewport.GoLive(state,price)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low and price then
  local half=(state.High-state.Low)/2 state.Low=price-half state.High=price+half
 end
 state.Right=nil state.Follow=true
end
function Viewport.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state)
end
Viewport.Manual=manual
local niceSteps={1,2,2.5,5}
-- Round-number price grid; every label is a multiple of the contract tick.
function Viewport.PriceTicks(low,high,tick,count)
 local range=math.max(high-low,tick) local raw=range/math.max(1,count)
 local magnitude=10^math.floor(math.log10(raw)) local step
 for _,m in ipairs(niceSteps)do if m*magnitude>=raw then step=m*magnitude break end end
 step=step or 10*magnitude
 step=math.max(tick,math.ceil(step/tick-1e-9)*tick)
 local ticks={} local p=math.ceil(low/step-1e-9)*step
 while p<=high+1e-9 and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,p) p+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
local timeSteps={60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,10800,14400,21600,43200,86400,172800,432000,864000,2592000}
function Viewport.TimeTicks(left,right,interval,count)
 local raw=(right-left)/math.max(1,count) local step=timeSteps[#timeSteps]
 for _,s in ipairs(timeSteps)do if s>=interval and s>=raw then step=s break end end
 local ticks={} local t=math.ceil(left/step)*step
 while t<=right and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,t) t+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
return Viewport

-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
-- `thickness` (default 1 px) is centred on y. Segments are sized to stay inside the row, so the row does
-- not clip: clipping a 1 px-tall row could round to an empty rectangle and hide the whole line.
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z,thickness)
 thickness=thickness or 1
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y-(thickness-1)//2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,thickness),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z or entry.T~=thickness then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.T=thickness entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),thickness)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

local Pool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
return function()
 local root=Instance.new("Frame") local pool=Pool.new(root)
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local function mark(x,identity,animate)
   pool:Begin(animate)
   local object=pool:Get("Frame","Candle",root)
   pool:Props(object,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,20)},identity)
   pool:Finish();return object
  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)
  assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==450 and not next(pool.Moving),"Dragging must follow the pointer without tween lag")
  mark(500,120,true);pool:Step(.01);pool:Begin(true);pool:Finish()
  assert(not candle.Visible)
  mark(500,120,true);assert(candle.Visible and candle.Position.X.Offset==500,"Hidden animation cannot resume with stale geometry")
  pool:Begin(false);local row=pool:Dash(root,0,30,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position
  pool:Begin(false);local same=pool:Dash(root,0,80,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")
  -- Keyed objects: a candle keeps its own object whatever order candles are drawn in.
  local keyed=Pool.new(root)
  local function draw(times)
   keyed:Begin(false) local out={}
   for _,t in ipairs(times)do out[t]=keyed:Get("Frame","KeyedCandle",root,t)end
   keyed:Finish() return out
  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})
  assert(a[120]==b[120] and a[180]==b[180] and b[240]~=a[60],"Keyed objects follow their identity")
  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")
  local c=draw({60}) assert(c[60]==a[60] and c[60].Visible,"Returning candles reuse their object")
  for _=1,5 do draw({60}) end keyed:Prune(3)
  assert(a[120].Parent==nil and c[60].Parent==root,"Long-unused keyed objects are destroyed")
  return {Passed=true,Cases=10,Checks="Reuse, intermediate motion, exact settlement, candle identity, immediate drag, hidden motion, grouped dash resizing, keyed identity, keyed hiding, pruning"}
 end)
 root:Destroy();if not ok then error(result)end;return result
end

-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- A rectangle's extension handle: the midpoint of its right edge, in the caller's pixel space.
function Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
 return math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),(toY(d.P1)+toY(d.P2))/2
end
-- Strong magnet: nearest candle open/high/low/close anywhere in screen space.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y)
 local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if (cx-x)^2<=bestD then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=(cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Pixel-space soft price magnet for the selected candle, stable at every zoom level.
function Tools.SoftSnap(candle,toY,y,previous,threshold)
 if not candle then return nil end
 local limit=threshold or 7;local best,distance
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","Close","High","Low"})do
  local d=math.abs(toY(candle[field])-y)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=field;distance=d end
 end
 if previous and previous.Time==candle.Time then
  local held=math.abs(toY(candle[previous.Field])-y)
  if held<=limit+3 and (distance>limit or held<=distance+1)then best=previous.Field;distance=held;limit+=3 end
 end
 if distance<=limit then return {Time=candle.Time,Price=candle[best],Field=best}end
end
function Tools.NearestCandle(candles,toX,x)
 local best,distance
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do local d=math.abs(toX(c.Time)-x)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=c;distance=d end
 end
 return best
end
function Tools.ProtectionField(direction,entry,price)
 local delta=(price-entry)*direction
 return delta<0 and "Stop" or delta>0 and "Target" or nil
end
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- The selected rectangle has an "Extend" dot at the midpoint of its right edge (checked first, slightly tighter
-- than corner handles so a small rectangle's corners stay reachable). Other handles belong to the
-- selected drawing only. A rectangle's body is "Slide" (horizontal move).
-- Interiors of unselected rectangles are flagged Interior: the view decides whether a drag there
-- moves the rectangle (mouse) or pans the chart (touch, where rectangles cover a small plot).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 local extendRadius=math.max(4,handleRadius-2)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Rect" and d.Id==selectedId then
   local ex,ey=Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
   if math.abs(ex-x)<=extendRadius and math.abs(ey-y)<=extendRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part="Extend"} end
  end
 end
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end
 local interior
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Line" then
   if math.abs(toY(d.P1)-y)<=tolerance and x>=0 and x<=(width or math.huge) then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then
   if segmentDistance(x,y,toX(d.T1),toY(d.P1),toX(d.T2),toY(d.P2))<=tolerance then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Rect" then
   local x1,x2=math.min(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2))
   local y1,y2=math.min(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2)),math.max(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2))
   local inside=x>=x1-tolerance and x<=x2+tolerance and y>=y1-tolerance and y<=y2+tolerance
   if inside then
    local edge=math.abs(x-x1)<=tolerance or math.abs(x-x2)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y1)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y2)<=tolerance
    if edge or d.Id==selectedId then return {Drawing=d,Part="Slide"} end
    interior=interior or {Drawing=d,Part="Slide",Interior=true}
   end
  end
 end
 return interior
end
-- Applies an edit to `target` from its unmodified `original`.
function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)
 for k,v in pairs(original)do target[k]=v end
 if part=="Move" then
  target.T1=original.T1 and original.T1+delta.Time target.P1=original.P1+delta.Price
  if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time target.P2=original.P2+delta.Price end
 elseif part=="Extend" then
  -- Right edge only: the left edge and both price levels stay fixed; the edge never crosses the left
  -- edge (it keeps at least delta.MinWidth seconds, one candle, of width).
  local right=(original.T2 or original.T1)>=original.T1 and "T2" or "T1" local left=right=="T2" and "T1" or "T2"
  target[right]=math.max(point.Time,original[left]+(delta and delta.MinWidth or 0))
 elseif part=="Slide" then
  -- Horizontal only: width (T2-T1), height and both price levels stay exactly as they were.
  target.T1=original.T1+delta.Time if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time end
 elseif part=="P1" or part=="P2" then
  local n=part:sub(2) target["T"..n]=point.Time target["P"..n]=point.Price
 else
  local index=tonumber(part:match("Corner(%d)"))
  if index then
   local f=cornerFields[index] target[f[1]]=point.Time target[f[2]]=point.Price
  end
 end
end
-- Liang-Barsky clip to [0,w]x[0,h]. Rotated GUI objects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants.
function Tools.ClipSegment(x1,y1,x2,y2,w,h)
 local t0,t1=0,1 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
 for _,edge in ipairs({{-dx,x1},{dx,w-x1},{-dy,y1},{dy,h-y1}})do
  local p,q=edge[1],edge[2]
  if p==0 then if q<0 then return nil end
  else
   local r=q/p
   if p<0 then if r>t1 then return nil elseif r>t0 then t0=r end
   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end
  end
 end
 return x1+t0*dx,y1+t0*dy,x1+t1*dx,y1+t1*dy
end
-- Undo/redo of the whole drawing list (small, so snapshots are simple and exact).
local History={} History.__index=History
function Tools.History(limit) return setmetatable({Past={},Future={},Limit=limit or 100},History) end
function History:Record(list)
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
local function restore(list,snapshot) table.clear(list) for i,d in ipairs(snapshot)do list[i]=copy(d) end end
-- Records a snapshot taken before an edit that has already been applied (e.g. a finished drag).
function History:Push(snapshot)
 table.insert(self.Past,snapshot) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
function History:Undo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Past) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Future,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:Redo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Future) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:CanUndo() return #self.Past>0 end
function History:CanRedo() return #self.Future>0 end
-- Candle direction from exact tick counts: 1 up, -1 down, 0 doji. Independent of the viewport.
function Tools.Direction(candle,tick)
 local o=math.round(candle.Open/tick) local c=math.round(candle.Close/tick)
 return c>o and 1 or c<o and -1 or 0
end
return Tools

local T=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)

return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 -- A simple linear transform stands in for the chart: 10 px per minute, 4 px per point.

 local function view(left,high) return function(t)return math.floor((t-left)/6+0.5)end,function(p)return math.floor((high-p)*4+0.5)end end

 local X,Y=view(0,120)

 local candles={{Time=600,Open=100,High=110,Low=95,Close=105},{Time=660,Open=105,High=108,Low=101,Close=101}}

 local snap=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(600)+3,Y(110)+4)

 check(snap and snap.Field=="High" and snap.Price==110 and snap.Time==600,"Snaps to the nearest OHLC point")

 local far=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,900,-300)
 check(far and far.Time==660,"Strong snap has no distance limit, including future space")
 check(T.Snap({},X,Y,900,-300)==nil,"No candles leaves snapping empty")
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
  local hit=T.Snap({candles[1]},X,Y,X(600),Y(candles[1][field]))
  check(hit and hit.Price==candles[1][field],"Every OHLC target: "..field)
 end
 local pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=100,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==0,"Screen-space distance beats price-only distance")
 pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=10,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==10,"Screen-space distance beats nearest candle in time")

 local close=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(660),Y(101)+2) check(close.Price==101,"Snaps to close/low")

 -- Rectangles: stored in time/price, hit-tested in pixels at any zoom.

 local r=T.New("Rect",{Time=600,Price=110},{Time=720,Price=100},"BX","1m")

 check(r.Id and r.Border=="Blue" and r.Opacity==0.15,"Defaults")

 local list={r}

 local inside=T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000)

 check(inside.Interior and inside.Part=="Slide","Interior of an unselected rectangle is flagged (the view chooses grab or pan)")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Slide","Interior of the selected rectangle slides it")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(600),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Edge selects/slides")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(720)+3,Y(100)-2,6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner handle")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(900),Y(50),6,8,r.Id,1000)==nil,"Empty space pans")

 local X2,Y2=view(300,140) -- panned and rescaled chart: same drawing, new pixels

 check(T.HitTest(list,X2,Y2,X2(720),Y2(100),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Anchors follow the chart after panning")

 local original=T.Copy(r)

 T.Edit(r,original,"Move",nil,{Time=60,Price=2})

 check(r.T1==660 and r.T2==780 and r.P1==112 and r.P2==102,"Move shifts both anchors")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=-90,Price=7})

 check(r.T1==510 and r.T2==630 and r.P1==110 and r.P2==100,"Slide moves horizontally only: width, height and prices kept")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=240,Price=0})

 check(r.T2-r.T1==original.T2-original.T1 and r.P1==original.P1 and r.P2==original.P2 and r.T1==840,"Slide right keeps size")

 -- Right-edge extension handle: midpoint of the right edge, extends width only.

 local ext=T.Copy(original) local elist={ext}

 local ex,ey=T.ExtendPoint(ext,X,Y) check(ex==X(720) and ey==(Y(110)+Y(100))/2,"Extension handle sits at the right-edge midpoint")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Unselected rectangle has no extension hit area")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex,Y(100)+2,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner still reachable next to the extension handle")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Extend","Selected rectangle extension is hittable")

 local copyR=T.Copy(original)

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=900,Price=90},{Time=180,Price=-20,MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==900 and copyR.P1==110 and copyR.P2==100,"Extend moves only the right edge: left edge and prices fixed")

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=300,Price=90},{MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==660,"Extend never crosses the left edge (one-candle minimum)")

 local flipped=T.Copy(original) flipped.T1,flipped.T2=original.T2,original.T1 local flippedOriginal=T.Copy(flipped)

 T.Edit(flipped,flippedOriginal,"Extend",{Time=840,Price=0},{MinWidth=60})

 check(flipped.T1==840 and flipped.T2==600 and flipped.P1==110,"Extend works whichever corner the rectangle was drawn from")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Corner1",{Time=540,Price=115})

 check(r.T1==540 and r.P1==115 and r.T2==720 and r.P2==100,"Corner resize keeps the opposite corner")

 local trend=T.New("Trend",{Time=0,Price=100},{Time=600,Price=110},"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({trend},X,Y,X(300),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==trend,"Trend hit")

 local line=T.New("Line",{Time=0,Price=104},nil,"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({line},X,Y,50,Y(104)+2,6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==line,"Horizontal line hit")

 -- Clipping keeps rotated trend lines inside the plot.

 local ax,ay,bx,by=T.ClipSegment(-50,50,150,50,100,100) check(ax==0 and bx==100 and ay==50,"Clip horizontal")

 check(T.ClipSegment(-10,-10,-5,-5,100,100)==nil,"Clip outside")

 -- Undo/redo restores exact drawing lists.

 local h=T.History(3) local drawings={}

 h:Record(drawings) table.insert(drawings,T.Copy(r))

 local before=T.CopyList(drawings) drawings[1].P1=200 h:Push(before)

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==115,"Undo edit")

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and #drawings==0,"Undo create")

 check(not h:Undo(drawings),"Nothing more to undo")

 check(h:Redo(drawings) and #drawings==1 and h:Redo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==200,"Redo")

 h:Record(drawings) check(not h:CanRedo(),"A new edit clears redo")

 for _=1,10 do h:Record(drawings) end check(#h.Past==3,"History is bounded")

 -- Direction uses exact tick counts, so float noise can never flip a candle's colour.

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.4,Close=2218.4000000001},0.1)==0,"Doji")

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.3,Close=2218.4},0.1)==1 and T.Direction({Open=5824.75,Close=5824.5},0.25)==-1,"Up/down")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Magnet snapping, rectangle/trend/line hit tests, anchoring after pan, move/slide/extend/resize, clipping, undo/redo, direction"}

end
