-- Candlestick chart: painting, navigation and drawing tools. Presentation only: it reads candles,
-- quotes and positions from the session and never changes prices or account state, except that a
-- stop/target drag sends the same AmendProtection request the order ticket uses, and the right-click
-- order menu submits through the terminal's shared order path (same checks and server validation).
local Viewport=require(script.Parent.ChartViewport)
local PaintPool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
local Tools=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
-- Cache by number format so quote changes do not make the axis width jitter.
local axisWidths={}
local function axisTextWidth(label,size,font)
 local pattern=label:gsub("%d","0") local key=font.Name..":"..size..":"..pattern
 local width=axisWidths[key]
 if not width then
  width=0
  for digit=0,9 do
   local sample=pattern:gsub("0",tostring(digit))
   width=math.max(width,TextService:GetTextSize(sample,size,font,Vector2.new(2000,24)).X)
  end
  axisWidths[key]=math.ceil(width)
 end
 return axisWidths[key]
end
local View={} View.__index=View
local MB1,MB2,MB3,TOUCH,MOVE=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,Enum.UserInputType.Touch,Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
local RIGHT,CENTER=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local DRAW={Line=true,Trend=true,Rect=true}
-- Reused native materials: bevels disappear at dense zoom levels without adding image assets.
local CANDLE_LIGHT=ColorSequence.new({
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.35,Color3.fromRGB(232,255,247)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(137,175,192)),
})
local CANDLE_INK=Color3.fromRGB(1,14,40)
local CANDLE_GLEAM=Color3.fromRGB(220,255,247)
local CURSOR={Hand="rbxasset://SystemCursors/OpenHand",Grab="rbxasset://SystemCursors/ClosedHand",Cross="rbxasset://SystemCursors/Cross",
 NS="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNS",Move="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeAll",NWSE="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNWSE",
 NESW="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNESW",Point="rbxasset://SystemCursors/PointingHand",EW="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeEW"}
local function count(t) local n=0 for _ in pairs(t)do n+=1 end return n end
local TOOL_NAMES={Pan="Select & pan",Crosshair="Crosshair",Trend="Trend line",Line="Horizontal line",Rect="Rectangle"}
View.ToolNames=TOOL_NAMES

-- ImageGen originals and upload manifest: output/imagegen/chart-tool-icons-v1/.
-- The PNGs retain transparent padding; a 38px image draws an approximately 25px glyph.
local TOOL_IMAGES={
 Pan="rbxassetid://116288191081900",Crosshair="rbxassetid://74362312458286",
 Trend="rbxassetid://70763323599430",Line="rbxassetid://99078267753564",
 Rect="rbxassetid://93642847191922",Magnet="rbxassetid://119661898132965",
 Clear="rbxassetid://101328487416478",Delete="rbxassetid://101328487416478",
}
function View.AddToolIcon(parent,name,size)
 local asset=TOOL_IMAGES[name];if not asset then return nil end
 local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
 icon.Name="ToolIcon";icon.BackgroundTransparency=1;icon.BorderSizePixel=0
 icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);icon.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
 icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size);icon.Image=asset
 icon.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
 icon.Active=false;icon.Selectable=false;icon.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+3;icon.Parent=parent
 return icon
end

-- Measured alpha bounds keep the generated labels at a consistent optical size without
-- changing their original PNGs. Timeframe controls display only the image artwork.
local TIMEFRAME_IMAGES={
 ["1m"]={Image="rbxassetid://99798012167473",Width=0.65311,Height=0.4067,CX=0.5012,CY=0.52392},
 ["5m"]={Image="rbxassetid://98117480331927",Width=0.6866,Height=0.39474,CX=0.5012,CY=0.51794},
 ["15m"]={Image="rbxassetid://131026004162086",Width=0.73684,Height=0.31818,CX=0.50478,CY=0.51316},
 ["1h"]={Image="rbxassetid://76925568025497",Width=0.56699,Height=0.46411,CX=0.5012,CY=0.52392},
 ["1D"]={Image="rbxassetid://112401119467136",Width=0.55981,Height=0.36124,CX=0.50478,CY=0.51316},
}
function View.AddTimeframeIcon(parent,timeframe)
 local asset=TIMEFRAME_IMAGES[timeframe];if not asset then return nil end
 local side=math.min((parent.Size.X.Offset-10)/asset.Width,(parent.Size.Y.Offset-14)/asset.Height,20/asset.Height)
 local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
 icon.Name="TimeframeIcon";icon.BackgroundTransparency=1;icon.BorderSizePixel=0
 icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 icon.Position=UDim2.new(.5,(.5-asset.CX)*side,.5,(.5-asset.CY)*side)
 icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(side,side);icon.Image=asset.Image;icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
 icon.Active=false;icon.Selectable=false;icon.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+3;icon.Parent=parent
 parent.Text=""
 local label=parent:FindFirstChild("ControlLabel")
 if label then label:Destroy()end
 return icon
end

function View.new(ctx)
 local self=setmetatable({Ctx=ctx,S=ctx.State,Views={},History=Tools.History(100),Touches={},Ctrl=false,Shift=false,ModifierKeys={},
  Seen={},Mutations=0,ColorMismatches=0,PaintCount=0,PaintTotal=0,PaintMax=0,Cursor=""},View)
 self.S.Drawings=self.S.Drawings or {}
 for _,d in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do Tools.Normalize(d)end
 self.S.Magnet=self.S.Magnet==true
 self.S.Tool=self.S.Tool or "Pan"
 if RunService:IsStudio()and ctx.Root then self:Diagnostics(ctx.Root)end
 return self
end
-- Studio-only test hook: read drawing/candle state and trigger the focus-loss and menu paths.
function View:Diagnostics(root)
 local f=root:FindFirstChild("ChartDiagnostics") or Instance.new("BindableFunction")
 f.Name="ChartDiagnostics" f.Parent=root
 f.OnInvoke=function(command)
  if command=="Drawings"then return Tools.CopyList(self.S.Drawings)
  elseif command=="Placement"then
   local p=self.Placement
   return p and {Kind=p.Kind,A=Tools.Copy(p.A),B=Tools.Copy(p.B),Waiting=p.Waiting} or nil
  elseif command=="Visible"then
   local g=self.Geometry if not g then return {} end
   local list={} for i,d in ipairs(g.Data)do list[i]={Time=d.Time,Open=d.Open,High=d.High,Low=d.Low,Close=d.Close,X=g.X(d.Time)}end return list
  elseif command=="FocusLost"then self:FocusLost() return true
  elseif command=="MenuOpened"then self:Cancel() return true
  elseif command=="OrderMenu"then
   local m=self.Menu if not m then return nil end
   return {Contract=m.Contract,Price=m.Price,Market=m.Market,Side=m.Side,Options=m.Labels,Quantity=self.S.Qty}
  elseif command=="OrderMarkers"then return self.OrderMarkers or {}
  elseif command=="State"then
   return {Ctrl=self.Ctrl,Shift=self.Shift,RectangleLockTime=self.RectangleLockTime,Magnet=self:MagnetOn(),Drag=self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind,Placement=self.Placement and self.Placement.Kind,Touches=count(self.Touches),Tool=self.S.Tool,Selected=self.Selected}
  end
  return nil
 end
end
function View:Busy() return self.Drag~=nil end
function View:Reset() self.Geometry=nil self.Pool=nil self.OverlayPool=nil self.HoverDirty=false self.Base=nil self.Chrome=nil end
function View:Palette(key) local C=self.Ctx.C return C[key] or C.Blue end
function View:Current() -- drawings on the chart being viewed
 local s=self.S local list={}
 for _,d in ipairs(s.Drawings)do if d.Contract==s.Contract then table.insert(list,d)end end
 return list
end
function View:Find(id) for _,d in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do if d.Id==id then return d end end end
function View:SelectedDrawing()
 local d=self.Selected and self:Find(self.Selected)
 if d and d.Contract==self.S.Contract then return d end
end
function View:CtrlDown()
 return self.Ctrl
end
function View:ShiftDown() return self.Shift end
function View:MagnetOn()
 -- Rectangle Ctrl owns the time lock, including when the persistent magnet is enabled.
 if self.S.Tool=="Rect" and self:CtrlDown()then return false end
 return (self.S.Magnet or self:CtrlDown()) and not self:SnapBypassed()
end
function View:SnapBypassed()
 return UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt)
end
function View:MarkDirty() self.Dirty=true end

-- Screen position -> plot-local pixels (origin at the price area's top-left).
function View:Local(pos)
 local g=self.Geometry
 return pos.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left,pos.Y-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.Y-g.Top
end
function View:PointAt(x,y,snap,touch)
 local g=self.Geometry local v=g.View

   -- Corner orientation depends on which way the rectangle is stored.
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NWSE or CURSOR.NESW
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Target.Kind=="Rect"and(d.Part=="Corner2"or d.Part=="Corner4")then
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NESW or CURSOR.NWSE
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Part~="Move"and d.Part~="Slide"and d.Part~="Extend"then icon=CURSOR.Move end
 elseif self.Hover and self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover) local g=self.Geometry
  if y>=0 and y<=g.Height and x>=0 then
   if x>=g.Width then icon=CURSOR.NS
   elseif DRAW[self.S.Tool]then icon=CURSOR.Cross
   else
    local hit=self:Hit(x,y,false)
    local prot=false
    for _,ph in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do if math.abs(y-ph.Y)<=6 then prot=true end end
    local grab=hit and(not hit.Interior or hit.Part=="Slide")
    local order,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,false)
    icon=order and(part=="Cancel"and CURSOR.Point or CURSOR.NS)or prot and CURSOR.NS or grab and((hit.Part=="Slide"or hit.Part=="Extend")and CURSOR.EW or hit.Part=="Move"and CURSOR.Move or CURSOR.Point)
     or self.S.Tool=="Crosshair"and CURSOR.Cross or CURSOR.Hand
   end
  end
 end
 self:SetCursor(icon)
end

-- Input
function View:Blocked()
 local s=self.S return not self.Geometry or s.Overlay or s.Sheet or self.Ctx.Options.Preview
end
function View:WorkingOrder(id)
 for _,o in ipairs(self.Ctx.Session.Orders or {})do if o.Id==id and not o.Protection then return o end end
end
function View:OrderHit(x,y,touch)
 -- Buttons win over lines, including when two orders share a price.
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if x>=m.X and x<=m.X+m.W and y>=m.Top and y<=m.Top+m.H then return m,x>=m.CancelX and "Cancel"or"Drag" end
 end
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if m.Type=="Limit" and m.Y and math.abs(y-m.Y)<=(touch and 12 or 5)then return m,"Drag" end
 end
end
function View:Began(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 -- Right-click cancels an in-progress drawing or edit (Esc is reserved for the Roblox menu in-game).
 -- Otherwise it opens the order menu at the clicked price.
 if kind==MB2 then
  if self.Drag or self.Placement or DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh() else self:OpenOrderMenu(Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y))end
  return
 end
 if kind~=MB1 and kind~=MB3 and kind~=TOUCH then return end
 if self:Blocked()then return end
 local g=self.Geometry local s=self.S local session=self.Ctx.Session
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 self.LastTouch=kind==TOUCH
 if kind==TOUCH then
  self.Touches[ev]=pos
  if count(self.Touches)>=2 then
   local d=self.Drag
   if not d or d.Kind=="Pan"or d.Kind=="Inspect"then self:StartPinch()end
   return
  end
 end
 if self.Drag then return end
 local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if y<0 or y>g.Height or x<0 then return end
 local base={Input=ev,Type=kind,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=false}
 local function start(kindName,extra) local d=table.clone(base) d.Kind=kindName for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do d[k]=v end self.Drag=d self.Dirty=true return d end
 -- The price axis owns gestures that start on it, even beside an SL/TP or order price tag.
 -- Choose the gesture before marker hit tests so crossing into the plot keeps scaling.
 if x>=g.Width then
  local now=os.clock() local lastTap=self.LastAxisTap
  if lastTap and now-lastTap.Time<0.4 and(lastTap.Pos-pos).Magnitude<16 then self.LastAxisTap=nil;self:AutoFit();return end
  self.LastAxisTap={Time=now,Pos=pos}
  start("Scale");return
 end
 -- X consumes the gesture and only cancels its order; it can never become a chart drag.
 if kind~=MB3 then
  local marker,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
  if marker then
   if self.OrderPending or self.Pending then return end
   if part=="Cancel"then
    start("CancelOrder",{Id=marker.Id,Base=session.AccountKey});return
   elseif marker.Type=="Limit"then
    start("Order",{Id=marker.Id,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Original=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Price=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Quantity=marker.Quantity});return
   end
  end
 end
 -- The position label can create or replace either protection. Its own rectangle
 -- wins over nearby protection lines so a tight stop cannot steal the gesture.
 local held=session.Positions[s.Contract]
 local entry=self.EntryMarker
 if kind~=MB3 and entry and held and not held.Triggered and not self.Pending and not self.OrderPending
  and x>=entry.X and x<=entry.X+entry.W and y>=entry.Y and y<=entry.Y+entry.H then
  start("Protection",{FromEntry=true,Creating=true,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Id=held.Id,
   Original=held.Entry,Price=held.Entry,Entry=held.Entry,Quantity=held.Quantity,Direction=held.Direction,Stop=held.Stop,Target=held.Target})
  self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection","Create");return
 end
 -- Stop and target labels keep priority over drawing tools.
 if kind~=MB3 and held and not held.Triggered and not self.Pending then
  local chosen,distance=nil,math.huge
  for _,hit in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do
   local label=x<=hit.Width
   local tolerance=kind==TOUCH and(label and 22 or 14)or(label and 10 or 6)
   local d=math.abs(y-hit.Y)
   if held[hit.Field] and d<=tolerance and d<distance then chosen=hit.Field;distance=d end
  end
  if chosen then
   start("Protection",{Field=chosen,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Id=held.Id,Original=held[chosen],Price=held[chosen]})
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",chosen);return
  end
 end
 if self.Pending or self.OrderPending then return end
 if kind==MB3 then start("Pan");return end
 local tool=s.Tool
 if DRAW[tool]then
  local pt=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
  if tool=="Line"then start("PlaceLine",{Point=pt});return end
  if self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting then
   self.Placement.B=pt;self:CommitPlacement();self.Ctx.onIdle(true);return
  end
  self.Placement={Kind=tool,A=pt,B=pt};start("Place");return
 end
 if tool=="Crosshair"and kind==TOUCH then self.Hover=pos;start("Inspect");return end
 local hit=self:Hit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
 -- With a mouse, pressing anywhere on a rectangle grabs it (selects it and slides it horizontally), so
 -- a drag on a rectangle never pans the chart. On touch an unselected interior still pans; tap to select.
 if hit and(not hit.Interior or(kind~=TOUCH and hit.Part=="Slide"))then
  local d=hit.Drawing
  start("Edit",{Part=hit.Part,Target=d,Original=Tools.Copy(d),Before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings),StartPoint=self:PointAt(x,y,false),SelectChanged=self.Selected~=d.Id})
  if hit.Part=="Move" or hit.Part=="Slide" then
   local anchors=Tools.Points(d)
   if d.Kind=="Line" then anchors={{Time=self.Drag.StartPoint.Time,Price=d.P1}} end
   local nearest=math.huge
   for _,pt in ipairs(anchors)do
    local dist=(g.X(pt.Time)-x)^2+(g.Y(pt.Price)-y)^2
    if dist<nearest then nearest=dist;self.Drag.Anchor=pt end
   end
  end
  self.Selected=d.Id;return
 end
 start("Pan",{Click=hit and hit.Drawing.Id or false})
end
function View:StartPinch()
 local g=self.Geometry if not g then return end
 local a,b local list={} for input,pos in pairs(self.Touches)do table.insert(list,{input,pos})end
 a,b=list[1],list[2]
 if self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Pan"then self.Drag=nil end
 local mid=(a[2]+b[2])/2
 local x=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 self.Drag={Kind="Pinch",A=a[1],B=b[1],StartDistance=math.max(20,(a[2]-b[2]).Magnitude),StartFraction=x,StartMid=mid,View=g.View,State=g.State,
  Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true,Type=TOUCH}
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
end
function View:UpdatePinch()
 local d=self.Drag local pa,pb=self.Touches[d.A],self.Touches[d.B]
 if not pa or not pb then return end
 local g=self.Geometry
 local mid=(pa+pb)/2 local dist=math.max(20,(pa-pb).Magnitude)
 local fraction=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/d.Width
 Viewport.Pinch(d.State,d.View,d.StartFraction,fraction,d.StartDistance/dist,mid.Y-d.StartMid.Y,d.Height)
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Changed(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH and self.Touches[ev]then self.Touches[ev]=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)end
 if kind==MOVE then self.LastTouch=false end
 local d=self.Drag
 if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then if kind==TOUCH then self:UpdatePinch()end return end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=MOVE then return end
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 local delta=pos-d.Start
 if not d.Moved and delta.Magnitude<(d.Type==TOUCH and 8 or 4)then return end
 d.Moved=true
 self.Hover=pos
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then Viewport.Pan(d.State,d.View,delta.X,delta.Y,d.Width,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Scale"then Viewport.ScalePrice(d.State,d.View,delta.Y,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order"then
  local Market=self.Ctx.Market local tick=Market.Contracts[d.Contract].Tick
  d.Price=math.max(tick,Market.Snap(d.Original-delta.Y/d.Height*(d.View.High-d.View.Low),d.Contract))
  if d.FromEntry then
   local field=Tools.ProtectionField(d.Direction,d.Entry,d.Price)
   d.Field=field;d.ExpectedPrice=field and d[field]or nil;d.Creating=d.ExpectedPrice==nil
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",d.Field or "Unavailable")
  end
 elseif self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(pos)
  if d.Kind=="Edit"then
   local pt=self:DrawingPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
   local origin=d.Anchor or d.StartPoint
   local Market=self.Ctx.Market
   Tools.Edit(d.Target,d.Original,d.Part,pt,{Time=pt.Time-origin.Time,Price=pt.Snap and pt.Price-origin.Price or Market.Snap(pt.Price-origin.Price,self.S.Contract),
    MinWidth=self.Geometry.View.Interval})
  elseif d.Kind=="Place"then self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
  elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then d.Point=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Ended(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH then self.Touches[ev]=nil end
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then
  if kind~=TOUCH then return end
  local remaining,pos=next(self.Touches)
  if remaining and self.Geometry then
   -- Lifting one finger continues as a one-finger pan from where it is.
   local g=self.Geometry
   self.Drag={Kind="Pan",Input=remaining,Type=TOUCH,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true}
  else self:Finish(true)end
  return
 end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=d.Type then return end
 self:Finish(ev.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Cancel)
end
function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil
 local s=self.S local chrome=false
 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then
  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil
   if chosen~=self.Selected then self.Selected=chosen;chrome=true end
  end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then
  if not commit then for k in pairs(d.Target)do d.Target[k]=nil end for k,v in pairs(d.Original)do d.Target[k]=v end
  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end
  if d.SelectChanged then chrome=true end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Place"then
  if not commit or not self.Placement then self.Placement=nil
  elseif d.Moved then self:CommitPlacement();chrome=true
  else self.Placement.Waiting=true end
 elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then
  if commit then
   local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
   local line=Tools.New("Line",d.Point,nil,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
   table.insert(s.Drawings,line);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=line.Id;s.Tool="Pan";chrome=true
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="CancelOrder"then
  if commit and not d.Moved and d.Base==self.Ctx.Session.AccountKey then
   local ok,message=self.Ctx.Session:Cancel(d.Id)
   if not ok then self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Order"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendOrder(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Price,d.Original,d.Quantity)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.OrderPending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.OrderPending==d then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Limit change not confirmed. Showing its last confirmed price.","error")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original and d.Field then
   local ok,message,_,requestId
   if d.Creating then ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:CreateProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.Quantity)
   else ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.FromEntry and d.ExpectedPrice or d.Original,d.FromEntry and d.Quantity or nil)end
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.Pending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.Pending==d then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Change not confirmed. Showing the last confirmed price.")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message)end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Inspect"then self.Hover=nil
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 self.Ctx.onIdle(chrome)
end
function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 self.RectangleLockTime=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))
 if(p.Kind=="Rect"and(w<3 or h<3))or(p.Kind=="Trend"and w+h<4)then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
 table.insert(s.Drawings,d);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=d.Id;s.Tool="Pan"
end
function View:Wheel(ev)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if not g or self.Drag or self.Pending or self.OrderPending or self:Blocked()then return end
 local x=(ev.Position.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 Viewport.Zoom(g.State,g.View,ev.Position.Z>0 and 0.85 or 1/0.85,x);self.Dirty=true
end
-- Returns true when the key was used by the chart.
function View:KeyBegan(ev)
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged();return false end
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=true
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged();return false
 end
 if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
 local ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
 local shift=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
  if self.Menu then self:CloseOrderMenu();return true end
  if self.Drag or self.Placement then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if self.Selected then self.Selected=nil;self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  return false
 elseif(key==Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)and self:SelectedDrawing()and not self.Drag then
  self:DeleteSelected();return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Z and not self.Drag then if shift then self:Redo()else self:Undo()end return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true
 end
 return false
end
function View:KeyEnded(ev)
 if ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged() end
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=nil
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged()
 end
end
-- Re-evaluate an active drag when the modifier changes, even without mouse motion.
function View:ModifierChanged()
 self:UpdateRectangleLock()
 self.Dirty=true
 local d=self.Drag
 if d and d.Moved and d.Type~=TOUCH and self.Hover then
  self:Changed({UserInputType=MOVE,Position=self.Hover})
 elseif self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting and self.Hover then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover)
  self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,self.LastTouch)
 end
end
-- Cancels the current gesture: an edit restores the drawing, a placement is discarded.
function View:Cancel()
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
 if DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self.S.Tool="Pan" end
end
-- Window focus lost (or the Roblox menu opened): cancel any gesture and clear modifier state.
function View:FocusLost()
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 self.Ctrl=false self.Shift=false table.clear(self.ModifierKeys) table.clear(self.Touches)
 self:Cancel()
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true self:SetCursor("")
end
function View:Step(dt)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if g and Viewport.Ease(g.State,dt,self.Drag and(self.Drag.Kind=="Protection"or self.Drag.Kind=="Order"))then self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:OnMarketUpdate()
 self:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag
 local message
 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered
   or d.FromEntry and (held.Quantity~=d.Quantity or held.Entry~=d.Entry or held.Stop~=d.Stop or held.Target~=d.Target)
   or not d.FromEntry and held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if d and d.Kind=="Order"then
  local o=self:WorkingOrder(d.Id)
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not o or o.Price~=d.Original or o.Quantity~=d.Quantity then
   self:Finish(false);message="Limit order changed or filled. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if self.OrderPending then
  local p=self.OrderPending
  if p.Base~=session.AccountKey or not self:WorkingOrder(p.Id)then self.OrderPending=nil end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=pending.Base or not held or held.Id~=pending.Id or held.Triggered or not pending.Creating and not held[pending.Field]then self.Pending=nil end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 return message
end
function View:OnReply(reply)
 if self.OrderPending and reply.RequestId==self.OrderPending.RequestId then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
 if self.Pending and reply.RequestId==self.Pending.RequestId then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Right-click order menu. The clicked price becomes the order price; the choices depend on where it
-- sits relative to the last traded price: above -> Limit Sell / Stop Buy, below -> Limit Buy / Stop Sell.
-- It shows only those two actions with their price. The quantity is the one selected in Place a Trade
-- (one shared state), and submission uses the terminal's shared order path (same client checks, SL/TP
-- settings, pending state and toasts); the server validates exactly as for the ticket.
local MENU_W,MENU_ROW,MENU_PAD=236,42,8
function View:MenuOptions(price,last)
 if price>last then
  return "Above",{{Dir=-1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Sell",Gloss="Red"},{Dir=1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Buy",Gloss="Green"}}
 elseif price<last then
  return "Below",{{Dir=1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Buy",Gloss="Green"},{Dir=-1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Sell",Gloss="Red"}}
 end
 return "At",{}
end
function View:OpenOrderMenu(pos)
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 local ctx=self.Ctx
 if self:Blocked() or not ctx.submitOrder then return false end
 local g=self.Geometry local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if x<0 or x>g.Width or y<0 or y>g.Height then return false end
 local s=self.S local Market=ctx.Market
 local price=Market.Snap(g.View.High-y/g.Ppp,s.Contract)
 local last=ctx.Session.Prices[s.Contract]
 -- Exactly at the last price there is no limit/stop choice; BUY and SELL place market orders.
 if price<=0 or not last or price==last then return false end
 self.Menu={Contract=s.Contract,Price=price,Pos=pos}
 self:BuildOrderMenu()
 return true
end
function View:CloseOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 self.Menu=nil
 for _,o in ipairs({m.Frame,m.Backdrop})do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy()end end
 local root=self.Ctx.Root
 if root then root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOpen",false);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuPrice",nil);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOptions",nil)end
end
function View:BuildOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 local ctx=self.Ctx local C,Market,s,root=ctx.C,ctx.Market,self.S,ctx.Root
 local frame,button,stroke,round=ctx.frame,ctx.button,ctx.stroke,ctx.round
 for _,o in ipairs({m.Frame,m.Backdrop})do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy()end end
 local key=m.Contract local last=ctx.Session.Prices[key] or m.Price
 local side,options=self:MenuOptions(m.Price,last)
 if #options==0 then self:CloseOrderMenu() return end
 m.Side=side m.Market=last m.Options=options
 local pxs=Market.Number(m.Price)
 -- Full-screen catcher: a left click anywhere closes; a right click moves the menu to that point.
 local backdrop=Instance.new("TextButton")
 backdrop.Name="OrderMenuBackdrop" backdrop.Text="" backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1 backdrop.BorderSizePixel=0 backdrop.AutoButtonColor=false
 backdrop.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) backdrop.ZIndex=94 backdrop.Parent=root
 -- Clicks on the menu's own background must not reach the catcher underneath.
 local function overMenu(p)
  local f=m.Frame if not f or not f.Parent then return false end
  local a,z=f.AbsolutePosition,f.AbsoluteSize
  return p.X>=a.X and p.X<=a.X+z.X and p.Y>=a.Y and p.Y<=a.Y+z.Y
 end
 backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(ev)
  local p=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
  if overMenu(p) then return end
  if ev.UserInputType==MB2 then
   if not self:OpenOrderMenu(p) then self:CloseOrderMenu() end
  elseif ev.UserInputType==MB1 or ev.UserInputType==TOUCH then self:CloseOrderMenu() end
 end)
 m.Backdrop=backdrop
 local h=MENU_PAD*2+#options*MENU_ROW+(#options-1)*6
 local origin=root.AbsolutePosition
 local px=math.clamp(m.Pos.X-origin.X+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.X-MENU_W-8))
 local py=math.clamp(m.Pos.Y-origin.Y+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.Y-h-8))
 local menu=frame(root,"ChartOrderMenu",px,py,MENU_W,h,C.Panel,95);menu.Active=true
 round(menu,12);local edge=stroke(menu,C.Cyan);edge.Thickness=2
 m.Frame=menu
 m.Labels={} m.Buttons={}
 local y=MENU_PAD
 for i,o in ipairs(options)do
  local b=ctx.gloss(button(menu,"Order"..o.Type..(o.Dir>0 and"Buy"or"Sell"),"",MENU_PAD,y,MENU_W-MENU_PAD*2,MENU_ROW,function()
   local n=s.Qty
   local what=string.lower(o.Title).." "..n.." "..key.." @ "..pxs
   if ctx.submitOrder(o.Dir,o.Type,m.Price,n,what)then self:CloseOrderMenu();ctx.refresh()end
  end,C.Raised,C.Text,15,96),o.Gloss)
  b:SetAttribute("Sound","None");b:SetAttribute("Debounce",.4)
  m.Buttons[i]={Button=b,Option=o}
  table.insert(m.Labels,o.Title)
  y+=MENU_ROW+6
 end
 self:RefreshOrderMenu()
 root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOpen",true);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuPrice",m.Price);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOptions",table.concat(m.Labels,","))
end
-- Button labels ("Limit Sell at 5,850.00") and the over-limit flag for the shared quantity.
function View:RefreshOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m or not m.Frame or not m.Frame.Parent or not m.Buttons then return end
 local ctx=self.Ctx local qty=self.S.Qty local pxs=ctx.Market.Number(m.Price)
 for _,item in ipairs(m.Buttons)do
  local o,b=item.Option,item.Button
  local label=b:FindFirstChild("ControlLabel") local value=o.Title.." at "..pxs
  if label then label.Text=value end b.Text=value
  local max=ctx.maxOrder and ctx.maxOrder(m.Contract,o.Dir)
  b:SetAttribute("OverLimit",max~=nil and qty>max)
 end
end
-- Keeps the menu honest while prices move: the choices are rebuilt if the market crosses the clicked
-- price (and it closes if the market sits exactly on it). Changing instrument or opening a popup closes it.
function View:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 if m.Contract~=self.S.Contract or self:Blocked() then self:CloseOrderMenu() return end
 self:RefreshOrderMenu()
 local last=self.Ctx.Session.Prices[m.Contract]
 if not last or last==m.Market then return end
 local side=self:MenuOptions(m.Price,last)
 if side~=m.Side then self:BuildOrderMenu() return end
 m.Market=last
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Commands (toolbar, mobile tools sheet, keyboard)
function View:Command(name)
 if name=="Magnet"then self:ToggleMagnet()
 elseif name=="Undo"then self:Undo()
 elseif name=="Redo"then self:Redo()
 elseif name=="Clear"then self:Clear()
 else self:SetTool(name)end
end
function View:SetTool(name)
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.S.Tool=name self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.Hover=nil
 if DRAW[name]then self.Selected=nil end
 self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ToggleMagnet() self.S.Magnet=not self.S.Magnet self.Ctx.refresh() end
function View:CancelPlacement() self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.SoftSnap=nil self.Dirty=true end
function View:Undo()
 if self.History:Undo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:Redo()
 if self.History:Redo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:DeleteSelected()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(self.S.Drawings)
 for i,x in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do if x==d then table.remove(self.S.Drawings,i)break end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:Clear()
 local s=self.S local current=self:Current()
 if #current==0 then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 for i=#s.Drawings,1,-1 do local d=s.Drawings[i] if d.Contract==s.Contract then table.remove(s.Drawings,i)end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Placement=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:SetStyle(field,value)
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d or d[field]==value then return end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d[field]=value self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleFill()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Colors local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if v==d.Fill then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Fill=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleOpacity()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Opacities local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if math.abs(v-(d.Opacity or 0.15))<0.001 then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Opacity=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ActiveState() local g=self.Geometry return g and g.State,g end
function View:ResetView() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.Reset(state);self.Base=nil;self.Dirty=true end end
function View:AutoFit() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.AutoFit(state);self.Dirty=true end end
function View:GoLive()
 local state=self:ActiveState()
 if state and not self.Drag then Viewport.GoLive(state,self.Ctx.Session.Prices[self.S.Contract]);self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:Destroy() self:CloseOrderMenu() self:SetCursor("") end
return View

-- Interaction feedback for the Get Funded! GUI: hover/press/release tweens, selection pops, popup
-- transitions and a small palette of UI sounds. Presentation only; it never changes trading state.
-- The GUI is rebuilt on refresh, so per-control state (hover, last press, selection) is remembered by
-- the control's path. A rebuilt control continues its animation instead of snapping or replaying it.
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local FX={} FX.__index=FX

-- Official Roblox GUI sounds (public, Roblox-owned). Volumes are relative to the master volume.
FX.Sounds={
 Click={Id=17208396156,Volume=.30,Gap=.045,Speed=1.05},  -- Roblox GUI - Select
 Tick={Id=17208396156,Volume=.16,Gap=.04,Speed=1.25},    -- steppers: lighter and shorter
 Select={Id=17208204604,Volume=.24,Gap=.06},             -- Roblox GUI - Bubble: tabs, segments, toggles
 Open={Id=17208405682,Volume=.18,Gap=.09},               -- Roblox GUI - Swipe: popups and sheets
 Send={Id=17208399163,Volume=.26,Gap=.1},                -- Roblox GUI - Send: order submitted (not confirmed)
 Success={Id=17208380755,Volume=.34,Gap=.12},            -- Roblox GUI - Purchase: server-confirmed action
 TakeProfit={Id=17208380755,Volume=.34,Gap=0},          -- Confirmed TP: success
 StopLoss={Id=17208353912,Volume=.30,Gap=0},            -- Confirmed SL: distinct negative tone
 Milestone={Id=17208361335,Volume=.36,Gap=.4},           -- Roblox GUI - Notification High: unlocks
 Error={Id=17208353912,Volume=.30,Gap=.22},              -- Roblox GUI - Negative: rejected or invalid
}
FX.Levels={Low=.35,Medium=.65,High=1}
local QUICK=TweenInfo.new(.07,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local HOVER=TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SETTLE=TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local BOUNCE=TweenInfo.new(.26,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local POP=TweenInfo.new(.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

function FX.new(root,options)
 options=options or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Root=root,Memory={},MemoryCount=0,Loops={},Last={},LastAny=0,Tweens=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
  Enabled=options.Sound~=false,Level=options.Level or "Medium",Preview=options.Preview==true,Alive=true,Played={}},FX)
 -- Edit previews are saved into the place; they never create sounds or effect layers.
 if not self.Preview then self:_sounds() end
 return self
end
function FX:_sounds()
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder") folder.Name="GetFundedUISounds"
 local group=Instance.new("SoundGroup") group.Name="GetFundedUI" group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] or .65 group.Parent=SoundService
 self.Group=group self.Folder=folder self.Instances={}
 for name,spec in pairs(FX.Sounds)do
  local s=Instance.new("Sound") s.Name=name s.SoundId="rbxassetid://"..spec.Id s.Volume=spec.Volume s.PlaybackSpeed=spec.Speed or 1
  s.SoundGroup=group s.Parent=folder self.Instances[name]=s
 end
 folder.Parent=SoundService
end
function FX:SetSound(enabled,level)
 if enabled~=nil then self.Enabled=enabled==true end
 if level and FX.Levels[level]then self.Level=level end
 if self.Group then self.Group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] end
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundEnabled",self.Enabled);self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundLevel",self.Level)end
end
-- Plays one UI sound, rate limited per sound and overall so rapid input never becomes noise.
function FX:Play(name)
 local spec=FX.Sounds[name] local s=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]
 self.Played[name]=(self.Played[name] or 0)+1
 if not spec or not s or not self.Enabled then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(self.Last[name] or 0)<spec.Gap or now-self.LastAny<.03 then return false end
 self.Last[name]=now self.LastAny=now
 s.TimePosition=0 s:Play()
 -- Studio diagnostics: how often each sound actually played (after rate limiting).
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name,(self.Root:GetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name)or 0)+1)end
 return true
end

-- Confirmed executions have already been deduplicated by MarketClient. They must not be
-- dropped by click throttling or cut off by another fill in the same network batch.
function FX:PlayFill(name)
 local template=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]
 if not self.Alive or not self.Enabled or not template then return false end
 local sound=template:Clone();sound.Name=name.."Fill";sound.Parent=self.Folder
 self.Played[name]=(self.Played[name]or 0)+1;self.LastAny=os.clock()
 sound.Ended:Once(function()sound:Destroy()end)
 game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound,10)
 sound:Play()
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name,(self.Root:GetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name)or 0)+1)end
 return true
end

-- An accent only plays when nothing else just played (a popup opened by a click keeps the click).
function FX:Accent(name)
 if os.clock()-self.LastAny<.12 then return false end
 return self:Play(name)
end
-- Per-path memory survives GUI rebuilds.
function FX:Mem(key)
 local m=self.Memory[key]
 if not m then
  if self.MemoryCount>1500 then table.clear(self.Memory) self.MemoryCount=0 end
  m={} self.Memory[key]=m self.MemoryCount+=1
 end
 return m
end
function FX:Tween(o,info,props)
 local old=self.Tweens[o] if old then old:Cancel() end
 local t=TweenService:Create(o,info,props) self.Tweens[o]=t t:Play() return t
end
local function scaleOf(o,name)
 local s=o:FindFirstChild(name or "PressScale")
 if not s then s=Instance.new("UIScale") s.Name=name or "PressScale" s.Parent=o end
 return s
end
FX.ScaleOf=scaleOf
-- UIScale scales around the anchor point; centre it so controls grow and shrink in place.
local function centre(o)
 if o.AnchorPoint~=Vector2.zero or not o.Parent then return end
 local size,pos=o.Size,o.Position
 o.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 o.Position=pos+UDim2.new(size.X.Scale/2,size.X.Offset/2,size.Y.Scale/2,size.Y.Offset/2)
end
FX.Centre=centre
local function inside(o)
 if not UIS.MouseEnabled or not o.Parent then return false end
 local m=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
 local gui=o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
 if not(gui and gui.IgnoreGuiInset)then m-=GuiService:GetGuiInset()end
 local p,s=o.AbsolutePosition,o.AbsoluteSize
 return m.X>=p.X and m.X<=p.X+s.X and m.Y>=p.Y and m.Y<=p.Y+s.Y
end
local function sheen(o)
 local f=o:FindFirstChild("HoverSheen")
 if not f then
  f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Name="HoverSheen" f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
  f.BackgroundTransparency=1 f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.ZIndex=o.ZIndex f.Active=false
  local corner=o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
  if corner then local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=corner.CornerRadius c.Parent=f end
  f.Parent=o
 end
 return f
end

-- Hover, press and release feedback for one button. Options: Lift, Press, Sheen (0..1), Quiet.
function FX:Bind(b,opts)
 if self.Preview then return end
 opts=opts or {}
 local fixed=b:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")==true
 local lift,press=fixed and 1 or opts.Lift or 1.035,fixed and 1 or opts.Press or .94
 local glow=opts.Sheen or .9
 local key
 local rest
 local function k() key=key or b:GetFullName() return key end
 local function enabled() return b.Active~=false and not b:GetAttribute("Disabled") end
 local function darken(on)
  if b.BackgroundTransparency>=1 then return end
  rest=rest or b:GetAttribute("RestingColor") or b.BackgroundColor3
  self:Tween(b,on and QUICK or SETTLE,{BackgroundColor3=on and rest:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.16) or rest})
 end
 local function state(name,instant)
  if not b.Parent then return end
  local sc=scaleOf(b)
  local target=name=="Down" and press or name=="Hover" and lift or 1
  if instant then sc.Scale=target else
   self:Tween(sc,name=="Down" and QUICK or name=="Release" and BOUNCE or name=="Hover" and HOVER or SETTLE,{Scale=name=="Release" and lift or target})
  end
  if b.BackgroundTransparency<1 or opts.Sheen then
   local f=sheen(b)
   local t=(name=="Hover" or name=="Release") and glow or name=="Down" and math.min(1,glow+.05) or 1
   if instant then f.BackgroundTransparency=t else self:Tween(f,HOVER,{BackgroundTransparency=t})end
  end
 end
 b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=true
  if enabled() then state("Hover") end
 end)
 b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=false
  state("Leave") darken(false)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
  if not enabled() then if not opts.Quiet then self:Shake(b) end return end
  self:Mem(k()).PressedAt=os.clock()
  state("Down") darken(true)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
  darken(false)
  if enabled() then state(UIS.MouseEnabled and inside(b) and "Release" or "Leave") end
 end)
 -- After the whole render: centre, then restore hover or finish a press that caused the rebuild.
 task.defer(function()
  if not b.Parent or not self.Alive then return end
  if not fixed then centre(b)end
  local m=self.Memory[k()]
  if not m then return end
  local recent=m.PressedAt and os.clock()-m.PressedAt<.32
  local hovering=m.Hover and inside(b)
  if not hovering then m.Hover=false end
  if recent and enabled() then
   scaleOf(b).Scale=press state(hovering and "Release" or "Leave")
  elseif hovering and enabled() then state("Hover",true) end
 end)
end
-- Debounce: returns true when this activation should be ignored (repeat within `gap`, or disabled).
function FX:Guard(b,gap)
 if b:GetAttribute("Disabled") then return true end
 local m=self:Mem(b:GetFullName()) local now=os.clock()
 if m.ActivatedAt and now-m.ActivatedAt<(gap or .12) then return true end
 m.ActivatedAt=now m.PressedAt=m.PressedAt or now
 return false
end
-- Pops a control when it becomes selected (not when it is merely rebuilt while selected).
function FX:Selected(o,selected)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Selected m.Selected=selected
 if selected and was==false then
  task.defer(function()
   if not o.Parent then return end
   centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end)
 end
end
-- A short bump when a displayed value changes (steppers). Frequent market readouts do not use this.
function FX:Bump(o,value)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Value m.Value=value
 if was~=nil and was~=value then
  local sc=scaleOf(o,"BumpScale") sc.Scale=1.16 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
 end
end
function FX:Shake(o)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry") then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(255,81,127));return end
 -- Establish the same anchor as Bind before capturing the rest position. A deferred Bind
 -- must never centre a control halfway through a shake and invalidate that saved position.
 centre(o)
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 if m.Shaking then return end m.Shaking=true
 local base=o.Position
 local offsets={-7,6,-4,3,0}
 task.spawn(function()
  for _,dx in ipairs(offsets)do
   if not o.Parent then break end
   local t=TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(.035,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),{Position=base+UDim2.fromOffset(dx,0)})
   t:Play() t.Completed:Wait()
  end
  if o.Parent then o.Position=base end
  m.Shaking=false
 end)
end
-- Popup entrance: scale from 90% with a light overshoot and fade the backdrop in.
function FX:Open(dialog,backdrop,fromBottom)
 if self.Preview then return end
 if dialog and dialog.Parent then
  if fromBottom then
   local target=dialog.Position dialog.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.min(80,dialog.AbsoluteSize.Y*.25))
   self:Tween(dialog,TweenInfo.new(.24,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target})
  else
   centre(dialog) local sc=scaleOf(dialog,"PopScale") sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end
 end
 if backdrop and backdrop.Parent then
  local t=backdrop.BackgroundTransparency backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1
  self:Tween(backdrop,TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{BackgroundTransparency=t})
 end
end
-- Popup exit: the closed popup is moved out of the canvas (which is about to be rebuilt) into a
-- non-interactive CanvasGroup that fades and shrinks, then is destroyed.
function FX:Ghost(items)
 if self.Preview or not self.Root or #items==0 then for _,o in ipairs(items)do o:Destroy()end return end
 local ghost=Instance.new("CanvasGroup") ghost.Name="PopupGhost" ghost.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) ghost.BackgroundTransparency=1
 ghost.BorderSizePixel=0 ghost.ZIndex=6 pcall(function()ghost.Interactable=false end)
 ghost.Parent=self.Root
 for _,o in ipairs(items)do
  for _,d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiButton")or d:IsA("TextBox")then d.Active=false pcall(function()d.Interactable=false end)end end
  o.Parent=ghost
  if o.Name~="OverlayBackdrop"and o.Name~="SheetBackdrop"then
   centre(o) self:Tween(scaleOf(o,"PopScale"),TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Scale=.94})
  end
 end
 local t=TweenService:Create(ghost,TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{GroupTransparency=1})
 t.Completed:Connect(function()ghost:Destroy()end) t:Play()
 task.delay(.5,function()if ghost.Parent then ghost:Destroy()end end)
end
-- Effects that must outlive a rebuild (success rings) live on a layer above the canvas.
function FX:Layer()
 if self.Preview or not self.Root then return nil end
 local layer=self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer")
 if not layer then
  layer=Instance.new("Frame") layer.Name="EffectsLayer" layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) layer.BackgroundTransparency=1
  layer.BorderSizePixel=0 layer.ZIndex=7 layer.Active=false layer.Parent=self.Root
 end
 return layer
end
-- Expanding glow ring around a control's on-screen rectangle.
function FX:Ring(o,color,radius)
 local layer=self:Layer() if not layer or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 local p=o.AbsolutePosition-self.Root.AbsolutePosition local s=o.AbsoluteSize
 local ring=Instance.new("Frame") ring.Name="SuccessRing" ring.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 ring.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2) ring.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X,s.Y)
 ring.BackgroundColor3=color ring.BackgroundTransparency=.7 ring.BorderSizePixel=0 ring.ZIndex=8
 local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 12) c.Parent=ring
 local st=Instance.new("UIStroke") st.Color=color st.Thickness=3 st.Parent=ring
 ring.Parent=layer
 local info=TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
 TweenService:Create(ring,info,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X+26,s.Y+26),BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
 local fade=TweenService:Create(st,info,{Transparency=1}) fade.Completed:Connect(function()ring:Destroy()end) fade:Play()
end
function FX:Pulse(o)
 if self.Preview or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160));return end
 centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=1.07 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
end
-- Looping decorations (loading dots, coach highlight) are stopped before each rebuild.
function FX:Loop(tween) table.insert(self.Loops,tween) tween:Play() return tween end
function FX:StopLoops() for _,t in ipairs(self.Loops)do t:Cancel()end table.clear(self.Loops) end
function FX:Destroy()
 self.Alive=false self:StopLoops()
 for o,t in pairs(self.Tweens)do t:Cancel()end
 if self.Folder then self.Folder:Destroy() end
 if self.Group then self.Group:Destroy() end
 local layer=self.Root and self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer") if layer then layer:Destroy() end
end
return FX

-- Read-only transport with one request in flight, late-response rejection and visible-only refresh.
local Client={} Client.__index=Client
function Client.new(preview,data)
 local self=setmetatable({Preview=preview,Data=data,Tab="Global",Cache={},CacheAt={},Visible=false,Alive=true,Serial=0,
  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),NextRefresh=0},Client)
 if not preview then
  self.ResetConnection=script.Parent:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LeaderboardRevision"):Connect(function()
   self.Serial+=1;self.Busy=false;self.Cache={};self.CacheAt={};self.NextRefresh=0
   self.Data={Tab=self.Tab,State="Loading",Rows={}};self.Changed:Fire();self:Fetch(true)
  end)
 end
 return self
end
function Client.Stale(packet)
 local result=table.clone(packet);result.State="Stale"
 if result.Your then
  result.Your=table.clone(result.Your);result.Your.Rank=nil
  result.Your.Status=result.Your.Eligible and "Outside top 100" or "Close a trade to join"
 end
 result.Rows={}
 for _,row in ipairs(packet.Rows or {})do local r=table.clone(row);r.Rank=nil;table.insert(result.Rows,r)end
 return result
end
function Client:Cached(tab)
 local data=self.Cache[tab]
 if not data then return nil end
 if os.clock()-(self.CacheAt[tab]or 0)>(tab=="Global"and 45 or 10)or(tab=="Global"and data.SavedAt and os.time()-data.SavedAt>120)then return Client.Stale(data)end
 return data
end
function Client:Fetch(force)
 if not self.Alive or self.Preview or self.Busy or not self.Visible then return end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(self.RequestAt or 0)+2.1 then
  if force then self.NextRefresh=math.min(self.NextRefresh,now+2.2) end
  return
 end
 self.RequestAt=now;self.Busy=true;self.Serial+=1
 local serial,tab=self.Serial,self.Tab
 local settled=false
 if not self.Cache[tab] then self.Data={Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={}};self.Changed:Fire() end
 local function finish(packet)
  if not self.Alive or serial~=self.Serial or settled then return end
  settled=true
  self.Busy=false
  if type(packet)~="table" or packet.State=="Throttled" then packet={Tab=tab,State="Error",Rows={}} end
  if packet.State=="Error" and self.Cache[tab] then packet=Client.Stale(self.Cache[tab])end
  if packet.State=="Ready" or packet.State=="Empty" then self.Cache[tab]=packet;self.CacheAt[tab]=os.clock()end
  if self.Tab==tab then self.Data=packet;self.NextRefresh=os.clock()+((packet.State=="Error" or packet.State=="Loading")and 10 or tab=="Global"and 45 or 10);self.Changed:Fire()
  else self.NextRefresh=0;self:Fetch(true) end
 end
 task.delay(12,function()if self.Alive and self.Busy and serial==self.Serial then finish({Tab=tab,State="Error",Rows={}})end end)
 task.spawn(function()
  local remote=script.Parent:FindFirstChild("LeaderboardRequest")
  local ok,packet=pcall(function()return remote and remote:InvokeServer(tab)end)
  finish(ok and packet or nil)
 end)
end
function Client:SetVisible(visible)
 if self.Visible==visible then return end
 self.Visible=visible
 if visible then self.Data=self:Cached(self.Tab)or self.Data;self.NextRefresh=0;self:Fetch(true) end
end
function Client:Select(tab)
 if self.Tab==tab then return end
 self.Tab=tab;self.Data=self:Cached(tab) or {Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={}};self.NextRefresh=0;self.Changed:Fire();self:Fetch(true)
end
function Client:Step()
 if self.Visible and os.clock()>=self.NextRefresh then self:Fetch() end
end
function Client:Destroy()
 self.Alive=false;self.Serial+=1;if self.ResetConnection then self.ResetConnection:Disconnect()end;self.Changed:Destroy()
end
return Client

-- Stats page: trading performance for the current account. Every number is computed and
-- persisted by the server (TradeStats / FundedAccounts:Stats). Only Stats content is drawn here, using
-- individual editable components from 06 - Polished Stats Pieces. TerminalUI owns all shared navigation.
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local Kit=require(script.Parent.StatsPieces)
local View={}
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local TOP=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
local AtEnd=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local BODY=Enum.Font.GothamMedium

local function commas(n)
 local raw=tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n or 0)+0.5))
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..raw:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
end
local function plural(n,word) return commas(n).." "..word..(n==1 and "" or "s") end
local function pct(rate) return rate and string.format("%.1f%%",rate*100) or "—" end
local function measure(value,size,width,font) return math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(value,size,font or FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(1,width-4),10000)).Y*1.12)+8 end
View.Commas=commas

-- Always use the current account, including when an older UI state selected another period.
-- Do not display a previous account's cached packet while a restart is loading.
function View.Resolve(data,state,portfolio)
 local list=data and data.Scopes or {};local scope=list[1]
 state.StatsScope="ALL";state.StatsPeriod="Current"
 local agg=scope and scope.Current
 if data and portfolio and data.Run and portfolio.Run and data.Run~=portfolio.Run then agg=nil end
 return scope,agg,"Current",list
end
function View.OpenFor(scope,pf,agg)return pf and pf.Open or agg and agg.Open or 0 end
function View.Describe(scope,agg,period)
 return "Current account only. Starting money and open profit are excluded."
end
function View.Coverage(agg,signed)
 if agg.Partial then
  local count=agg.UntrackedTrades>0 and (" across "..(agg.CountUnknown and "at least " or "")..plural(agg.UntrackedTrades,"earlier trade"))
   or (agg.CountUnknown and " across an unknown number of earlier trades" or "")
  return "Results without a full breakdown (net "..signed(agg.UntrackedNet)..count..") are included in realized profit. Ratios need a complete trade breakdown."
 elseif agg.Recovered then
  return "Includes earlier trades rebuilt from your saved trade history."
 end
 return nil
end

  BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=4,ScrollBarImageColor3=muted,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y})
 local cw,inset=ctx.insetScroll(sc) local narrow=cw<620 local gap=narrow and 12 or 18

  return ctx.make("TextLabel",name,parent,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(xx,yy),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ww,hh),BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Text=value,TextColor3=color or white,TextSize=size,Font=body and BODY or FONT,TextXAlignment=LEFT,TextWrapped=true,TextScaled=false,LineHeight=1.12})

  o.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(xx,yy) o.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ww,hh) return o

  o.TextScaled=false;o.TextSize=size;o.LineHeight=1.12;o.TextStrokeTransparency=1

  fit(o,size);o.Font=FONT;o.TextWrapped=false;o.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromHex("061B48");o.TextStrokeTransparency=.86
  local hh=math.ceil(size*1.3)+8

 end

 local titleH=narrow and 40 or 66

 if data.New or not scope then
  if data.New then

  else

 end
 -- All transient UI is confined to the Stats viewport; the terminal owns the sidebar.
 local layer=ctx.make("Frame","StatsOverlays",ctx.Canvas,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x+inset,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(cw,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=50,Visible=not s.Overlay and not s.Sheet})
 local help

  local hw=math.min(530,cw-16)

  local close=ctx.button(help,"Close","×",hw-54,8,44,44,function()s.StatsHelp=nil closeHelp()end,false,white,28,114)

  end)

-- One dollar-to-tick calculation shared by the ticket and authoritative exchange.
-- Dollars are the estimated TOTAL for the requested quantity, excluding slippage.
local Protection={}
Protection.Defaults={StopOn=true,TargetOn=true,StopDollars=500,TargetDollars=1500}
-- Preferences are dollar intentions, independent of the current instrument/quantity.
-- Resolve still enforces the instrument's 10,000-tick limit when an order is placed.
function Protection.Preferences(value)
 local result={}
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v;if type(value)=="table"then v=value[key]end
  if type(default)=="boolean"then
   if type(v)=="boolean"then result[key]=v else result[key]=default end
  else result[key]=type(v)=="number"and v==v and v>=.01 and v<=1e9 and v or default end
 end
 return result
end
function Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return nil end
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v=value[key]
  if type(v)~=type(default)then return nil end
  if type(v)=="number"and(v~=v or v<.01 or v>1e9)then return nil end
 end
 return Protection.Preferences(value)
end
function Protection.SamePreferences(a,b)
 for key in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do if a[key]~=b[key]then return false end end
 return true
end
function Protection.Resolve(spec,quantity,dollars,entry,direction,field)
 if type(quantity)~="number" or quantity<1 or quantity%1~=0 then return nil,"Enter a whole number of contracts, starting at 1." end
 local unit=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 if type(dollars)~="number" or dollars~=dollars or dollars<=0 or dollars==math.huge or dollars>unit*10000 then
  return nil,"Enter a protection amount above $0 and within 10,000 price ticks for this quantity."
 end
 local ticks=math.max(1,math.round(dollars/unit))
 local result={Ticks=ticks,Dollars=ticks*unit,TickDollars=unit}
 if entry then
  local side=(field=="Stop" and -1 or 1)*(direction or 1)
  result.Price=math.round((entry+side*ticks*spec.Tick)/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick
  result.Dollars=math.abs(result.Price-entry)*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 end
 return result
end
return Protection

-- Smooth, transparent native rings. Circular strokes keep the inner/outer curves concentric;
-- a radial half-plane cuts each coloured prefix at the exact statistical angle.
-- No uploaded textures, pixel wedges, tessellation seams, or opaque centre masks.
local Charts={}
function Charts.Draw(ctx,parent,name,cx,cy,radius,thickness,win,loss,half,colors)
 local container=ctx.frame(parent,name,cx-radius-thickness/2-2,cy-radius-thickness/2-2,
  radius*2+thickness+4,(half and radius or radius*2)+thickness+4,colors.Neutral,4)
 container.BackgroundTransparency=1
 local margin=thickness/2+2 local center=radius+margin
 win=win and math.clamp(win,0,1) or nil
 loss=win and math.clamp(loss or 0,0,1-win) or 0
 container:SetAttribute("Renderer","CircularStroke")
 container:SetAttribute("WinShare",win)
 container:SetAttribute("LossShare",loss)
 container:SetAttribute("NeutralShare",win and math.max(0,1-win-loss) or 1)
 container:SetAttribute("Thickness",thickness)
 container:SetAttribute("ArcDegrees",half and 180 or 360)
 local function layer(label,color,share,z,side)
  if share<=0 then return end
  local clip=ctx.frame(container,label,side=="Right"and center or 0,0,
   half and center*2 or center,half and center or center*2,color,z)
  clip.BackgroundTransparency=1 clip.ClipsDescendants=true
  local disk=ctx.frame(clip,"Circle",side=="Right"and -radius or margin,margin,radius*2,radius*2,color,z)
  disk.BackgroundTransparency=1 ctx.round(disk,radius)
  local stroke=ctx.stroke(disk,color) stroke.Thickness=thickness stroke.BorderStrokePosition=Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Center
  if share<1 then
   local rotation=half and 90-share*180 or (side=="Right"and share*180 or 180+share*180)
   local cut=Instance.new("UIGradient") cut.Name="RadialBoundary" cut.Rotation=rotation
   local first,last=half and 1 or 0,half and 0 or 1
   cut.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,first),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4995,first),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5005,last),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,last)})
   cut.Parent=stroke
  end
 end
 local function prefix(label,color,share,z)
  if half then layer(label,color,share,z,"Top")
  else
   layer(label.."Right",color,math.clamp(share*2,0,1),z,"Right")
   layer(label.."Left",color,math.clamp(share*2-1,0,1),z,"Left")
  end
 end
 prefix("Track",colors.Neutral,1,4)
 if win then
  prefix("Loss",colors.Loss,win+loss,5)
  prefix("Win",colors.Win,win,6)
 end
 return container
end
return Charts

function Kit.FromAggregate(a)

   Help="Net profit or loss from closed trades in this account. Excludes open profit and starting money."},
  {Key="Trade",Title="Trade win rate",Value=complete and percent(a.WinRate) or "—",
   Caption=complete and string.format("%d wins / %d trades · %d even",a.Wins or 0,a.Trades or 0,a.Even or 0) or unknown,
   Bars=complete and {a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable closed trades divided by all closed trades, including break-even trades. Each closing fill counts as one trade."},
  {Key="Average",Title="Avg win / avg loss",Value=complete and ratio(a.WinLossRatio,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No losing trades" or "Average win ÷ absolute average loss",
   Bars=complete and {a.AvgWin or 0,a.AvgLoss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Avg win",money(a.AvgWin)},{"Avg loss",a.AvgLoss and money(-a.AvgLoss) or "—"}} or nil,

  {Key="Day",Title="Day win rate",Value=daily and percent(a.DayWinRate) or "—",
   Caption=daily and string.format("%d profitable / %d UTC days",a.WinningDays or 0,a.DayCount or 0) or "Needs complete trade dates",
   Bars=daily and {a.WinningDays or 0,math.max(0,(a.DayCount or 0)-(a.WinningDays or 0)),0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable days divided by days with closed trades in this account. Days run from midnight to midnight UTC. Days without trades do not count."},
  {Key="Factor",Title="Profit factor",Value=complete and ratio(a.ProfitFactor,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No gross losses" or "Gross wins ÷ absolute gross losses",
   Bars=complete and {a.Gains or 0,a.Loss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Gross wins",money(a.Gains or 0)},{"Gross losses",money(-(a.Loss or 0))}} or nil,
   Help="Total profits divided by total losses from closed trades. The bar compares those two totals."},
  {Key="Best",Title="Best day share",Value=percent(best),
   Caption=not daily and "Needs complete trade dates" or net<=0 and "Needs realized profit above $0" or "Best daily net profit ÷ realized profit",
   Help="Your best day's net profit divided by this account's realized profit. Losses on other days can push this above 100%. Needs complete trade dates and realized profit above $0."},
 }
end

local function setText(root,name,value)

end
local function setBar(root,name,values,complete)

 for i,v in ipairs(values)do

   local part=build(node,bar)

function Kit.ApplyAggregate(root,a)

 for i,m in ipairs(metrics)do
  local label=setText(root,names[i].."Value",m.Value)

 end

 for _,pair in ipairs({{"Average",3},{"Factor",5}})do
  local details=metrics[pair[2]].Details
  setText(root,pair[1].."Detail0",details and details[1][2]or"—")

 setText(root,"CoverageCopy",not complete and "Trade breakdown incomplete.\nRatios are unavailable."
  or not a.DailyComplete and "Some trades have no dates.\nDaily stats are unavailable."
  or(a.Net or 0)<=0 and "UTC days. Best-day share needs\nrealized profit above $0."
  or "Current account only.\nTrading days use UTC.")
 setBar(root,"TradeBar",{a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0},complete)

end
-- Root is the Stats viewport. Popups account for inherited scaling and stay inside it.
function Kit.BindDropdown(root,trigger,items,selectedKey,onChoose)

 local opened,overlay,selected=false,nil,selectedKey
 local previousSelection
 local api={}
 local function caption()
  for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==selected then setText(trigger,trigger.Name.."Label",item.Label);return end end
 end
 function api:Close()
  opened=false

  previousSelection=nil
 end
 function api:Set(key)selected=key;caption()end
 function api:Choose(key)
  local exists=false;for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==key then exists=true end end
  if not exists then return false end

  if accepted then self:Set(key)end

 end
 function api:Open()
  if self:IsOpen() then self:Close();return end

  local old=root:FindFirstChild("DropdownOverlay");if old then old:Destroy()end
  opened=true;previousSelection=root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")and GuiService.SelectedObject or nil
  overlay=make("TextButton","DropdownOverlay",root,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=100,Selectable=false})
  overlay.Activated:Connect(function()self:Close()end)
  local scale=root.Size.X.Offset>0 and root.AbsoluteSize.X/root.Size.X.Offset or 1
  scale=math.max(.01,scale)
  local x=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.X-root.AbsolutePosition.X)/scale
  local y=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.Y-root.AbsolutePosition.Y+trigger.AbsoluteSize.Y)/scale+8
  local w=trigger.AbsoluteSize.X/scale

  w=math.min(w,math.max(1,root.Size.X.Offset-16))
  local h=math.min(#items*50+12,312,math.max(56,root.Size.Y.Offset-16))
  x=math.clamp(x,8,math.max(8,root.Size.X.Offset-w-8))
  if y+h>root.Size.Y.Offset-8 then y=math.max(8,y-h-trigger.Size.Y.Offset-16)end
  y=math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,root.Size.Y.Offset-h-8))
  local menu=build({kind="Frame",name="DropdownMenu",x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,top="#0A3274",bottom="#031B4E",edge="#487DDB",stroke=2,radius=12},overlay);menu.ZIndex=101
  local list=make("ScrollingFrame","Options",menu,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#items*50),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ZIndex=102})
  for i,item in ipairs(items)do
   local row=build({kind="TextButton",name="Option"..i,x=0,y=(i-1)*50,w=w-12,h=46,
    top=item.Key==selected and "#863AFF"or"#0A3274",bottom=item.Key==selected and"#491BCD"or"#062250",radius=8,
    text="   "..item.Label,size=18},list);row.ZIndex=103
   row:SetAttribute("Key",item.Key)
   -- A gradient on a TextButton also tints its own text. Keep the label on an un-tinted child.
   row.Text=""
   local label=build({kind="TextLabel",name="Label",x=12,y=0,w=w-36,h=46,text=item.Label,size=w<300 and 14 or 18},row)
   label.ZIndex=104;label.TextScaled=true
   make("UITextSizeConstraint","TypeSize",label,{MinTextSize=10,MaxTextSize=label.TextSize})
   row.Activated:Connect(function()self:Choose(item.Key)end)
   if item.Key==selected and UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and row:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")then GuiService.SelectedObject=row end
  end
 end
 function api:IsOpen()return opened and overlay~=nil and overlay.Parent~=nil end
 function api:Get()return selected end
 function api:Destroy()self:Close();for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end
 table.insert(connections,trigger.Activated:Connect(function()api:Open()end))
 table.insert(connections,UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if api:IsOpen() and (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)then api:Close()end

 caption();return api
end

-- Shared definitions and pure presentation. Only FundedAccounts awards progression.
local Config=require(script.Parent.ProgressionConfig)
local Rules={}
function Rules.Rank(id)
 for index,r in ipairs(Config.Ranks) do if r.Id==id then return r,index end end
 return nil
end
function Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins)
 return math.max(0,m.Kind=="Trades" and trades or m.Kind=="Wins" and wins or net)
end
function Rules.Qualifies(r,net,trades,wins)
 return trades>=r.Trades and wins>=r.Wins and (r.Profit==0 or net+1e-6>=r.Profit)
end
function Rules.Obsolete(title)
 return title:match("^Legacy .*Trader$")~=nil or title:match("^%d+K Trader$")~=nil or title=="Legacy Top Tier Complete"
end
function Rules.Normalize(p,at)
 if p.ProgressionVersion==Config.ProgressionVersion then return false end
 p.LegacyProgression=p.LegacyProgression or {Titles=table.clone(p.Titles or {}),Rank=p.Rank}
 p.Awards=p.Awards or {};p.AlumniTitles=p.AlumniTitles or {}
 local known={};for _,m in ipairs(Config.Milestones)do known[m.Title]=m; if m.OldTitle then known[m.OldTitle]=m end end
 local seen={};for _,title in ipairs(p.AlumniTitles)do seen[title]=true end
 for _,title in ipairs(p.Titles or {})do
  local m=known[title]
  if m then p.Awards[m.Id]=p.Awards[m.Id] or {At=at,Title=title,Preserved=true}
  else
   local display=Rules.Obsolete(title) and "Founding Trader" or title
   if not seen[display]then table.insert(p.AlumniTitles,display);seen[display]=true end
  end
 end
 p.ProgressionVersion=Config.ProgressionVersion
 return true
end
function Rules.Titles(p)
 local titles,seen={},{};local current
 for _,m in ipairs(Config.Milestones)do if p.Awards[m.Id]then
  if not seen[m.Title]then table.insert(titles,m.Title);seen[m.Title]=true end;current=m
 end end
 for _,title in ipairs(p.AlumniTitles or {})do if not seen[title]then table.insert(titles,title);seen[title]=true end end
 return titles,current
end
return Rules

local function make(class,name,p,props)

local function label(p,name,value,x,y,w,h,size,color,align)

local function levels(side)

function View.new(ctx,parent,x,y,w)

 end,C.Bg,C.Text,16,p.ZIndex+1),"Navy")

 self.Title=label(self.Header,"Title","Level 2",12,0,w-80,40,17)

function View:Row(side,index)
 local pool=self.Rows[side];if pool[index]then return pool[index]end
 local p=make("Frame",side..index,self.Body,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width-16,View.RowHeight),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=self.Body.ZIndex})
 local color=side=="Asks"and C.Red or C.Green
 local bar=make("Frame","Liquidity",p,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.fromScale(1,0),Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),
  BackgroundColor3=color,BackgroundTransparency=.82,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=p.ZIndex})

 local row={Root=p,Bar=bar,Side=label(p,"Side","",2,0,56,View.RowHeight,12,color),

end
function View:SetHeight(height)
 self.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width,height);self.Body.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width,math.max(0,height-40))
 if self.Height~=height then self.Height=height;if self.Context.resize then self.Context.resize(height)end end
end
function View:Update()
 if not self.Root.Parent then return end
 local ctx=self.Context;local expanded=ctx.expanded();local access,quote,fresh=ctx.data()
 self.Root:SetAttribute("Expanded",expanded);self.Body.Visible=expanded
 self.Chevron.Text=expanded and "−"or"+"
 if not expanded then self:SetHeight(40);return end
 -- Geometry never follows the number of levels or a transient data/access state.
 self:SetHeight(40+26+self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight*2+28+8)
 local allowed=access and access.Allowed==true
 local state=access and access.State or "Checking"
 local depth=allowed and fresh and quote and quote.Depth
 local book=type(depth)=="table"
 self.Columns.Visible=book;self.Spread.Visible=book;self.ScaleLabel.Visible=book
 self.Message.Visible=not book;self.Unlock.Visible=not allowed and state~="Checking"
 local asks,bids
 if book then asks=levels(depth.Asks);bids=levels(depth.Bids)end
 local maximum=0
 for _,side in ipairs({asks or{},bids or{}})do for i=1,math.min(#side,self.LevelCount)do maximum=math.max(maximum,side[i].Quantity)end end
 -- A shared, labelled high-water scale prevents every bar breathing when one order disappears.
 -- The context retains this per instrument across other UI redraws. No quantity is fabricated.
 local scale=ctx.scale and ctx.scale()or self.Scale
 while scale<maximum do scale*=2 end
 self.Scale=scale;if ctx.scale then ctx.scale(scale)end
 self.ScaleLabel.Text="Bar max "..ctx.quantity(scale)
 local spreadY=26+self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight
 self.Spread.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,spreadY)
 local spread=asks and asks[1]and bids and bids[1]and asks[1].Price-bids[1].Price
 self.Spread.Text=spread and ("Spread  "..ctx.number(spread))or "Spread unavailable"
 for _,side in ipairs({"Asks","Bids"})do
  local data
  if side=="Asks"then data=asks else data=bids end
  local empty=self["Empty"..side]
  local top=side=="Asks"and 26 or spreadY+28
  empty.Visible=book and (not data or #data==0)
  empty.Text=not data and (side.." unavailable")or (side=="Asks"and "No resting asks"or "No resting bids")
  empty.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,top+(self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight-20)/2)
  for index=1,self.LevelCount do
   local row=self:Row(side,index);local level=data and data[index]
   local slot=side=="Asks"and self.LevelCount-index or index-1
   row.Root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,top+slot*View.RowHeight)
   row.Root.Visible=level~=nil
   if level then
    local changedPrice=row.Root:GetAttribute("Price")~=level.Price
    row.Side.Text=index==1 and (side=="Asks"and "Best ask"or "Best bid")or ""
    row.Root:SetAttribute("Best",index==1);row.Root:SetAttribute("Price",level.Price);row.Root:SetAttribute("Quantity",level.Quantity)
    row.Price.Text=ctx.number(level.Price);row.Quantity.Text=ctx.quantity(level.Quantity)
    local ratio=level.Quantity/scale
    if row.Ratio~=ratio or changedPrice then
     if self.Tweens[row]then self.Tweens[row]:Cancel();self.Tweens[row]=nil end
     if row.Ratio==nil or changedPrice then row.Bar.Size=UDim2.fromScale(ratio,1)
     else local tween=TweenService:Create(row.Bar,TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(ratio,1)});self.Tweens[row]=tween;tween:Play()end
     row.Ratio=ratio
    end
   else
    if self.Tweens[row]then self.Tweens[row]:Cancel();self.Tweens[row]=nil end
    row.Ratio=nil;row.Root:SetAttribute("Price",nil);row.Root:SetAttribute("Quantity",nil)
   end

local Purchase={}
Purchase.__index=Purchase

function Purchase.new(session,preview,changed,services)
 services=services or{}
 local self=setmetatable({Session=session,Preview=preview,Changed=changed,Alive=true,
  Marketplace=services.Marketplace or game:GetService("MarketplaceService"),
  Player=services.Player or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer,Clock=services.Clock or os.clock},Purchase)
 if not preview then
  self.Connection=self.Marketplace.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player,id,purchased)
   if player~=self.Player or id~=self.PromptPass then return end
   self.Prompting=false;self.PromptPass=nil
   -- This client event only controls the waiting label. It never changes entitlement.
   self.VerifyUntil=purchased and self.Clock()+20 or nil

  end)
