-- Single-account lifecycle; historical module name keeps place references stable.
-- All grants, archives and rewards share the exchange's fenced checkpoint.
local Funded={} Funded.__index=Funded
local Rules=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionRules)
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Absence=require(script.Parent.AbsenceSummary)
local Protection=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.TradeProtection)
local function clone(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=clone(x) end return r end
local function keys(t) local r={} for k in pairs(t or {}) do table.insert(r,k) end table.sort(r) return r end
function Funded.Validate(c)
 assert(c.Version==4 and type(c.StartingBalance)=="number" and c.StartingBalance>0 and c.StartingBalance<math.huge and c.StartingBalance%1==0,"Invalid single-account configuration")
 assert(type(c.MinimumContracts)=="number" and c.MinimumContracts>=1 and c.MinimumContracts<math.huge and c.MinimumContracts%1==0
  and type(c.BalancePerContract)=="number" and c.BalancePerContract>0 and c.BalancePerContract<math.huge,"Invalid contract limit configuration")
 local seen={} for _,m in ipairs(c.Milestones) do assert(not seen[m.Id] and m.Goal>0 and m.Title and type(m.StartingBonus)=="number" and m.StartingBonus>=0 and m.StartingBonus<1e6 and m.StartingBonus%1==0,"Invalid milestone");seen[m.Id]=true end
end
function Funded.Key(uid) return tostring(uid) end
function Funded:Profile(uid) return self.Engine.Profiles[uid] end
function Funded:_touch(p) p.Revision=(p.Revision or 0)+1 end
function Funded:Owner(uid) local p=self:Profile(uid);return p and p.Account end
function Funded:Usable(a) return a and not (a.Locked or a.Depleted or a.Retired or a.LegacyRetired) end
function Funded:_new(uid)
 local p={V=4,Run=0,Ledger={},Tiers={},Awards={},Titles={},Rank="New Trader",Tutorial="Pending",Revision=1,
  Created=self.Engine.Time,Events={},RunHistory={},Limits={}}
 self.Engine.Profiles[uid]=p return p
end
function Funded:_open(uid,p,balance,source)
 p.Run+=1
 local id="player:"..uid..":single:"..p.Run
 assert(not self.Engine.Accounts[id],"Duplicate run identity")
 local a=self.Engine:AddAccount(id,balance,self.Config.MinimumContracts,self.Config.MarginUse,true)
 a.ProfileId=uid;a.Group="player:"..uid;a.SingleAccount=true;a.Run=p.Run
 p.Account=id;p.Active=id;p.RunStartBalance=balance;p.RunSource=source;p.FailureNotice=nil
 p.PendingTradeCloses=nil
 table.insert(p.Ledger,id);self:_touch(p);return a
end
function Funded:CreationAllowed(kind)
 if (self.Capacity and not self.Capacity(kind)) or #self.Engine.AccountOrder>=self.Config.AccountLimits.MaxExchangeAccounts then
  return false,"The exchange is at capacity. Please try again later."
 end
 return true
end
-- Run before the first durable V8 checkpoint, without interleaved client or market steps.
-- Close through Submit so the house counter-entry, cash flow and inventory stay balanced.
function Funded:Migrate(p,uid)
 if p.V==4 then
  assert(p.Account and self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account] and p.Awards and p.Ledger,"Invalid single-account profile")
  self.Engine:ContractLimit(self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account])
  self:Evaluate(uid,true)
  return
 end
 assert((p.V or 1)<4,"Unsupported player profile version")
 local e=self.Engine;local original=clone(p);local ids,seen={},{}
 local function retain(id)
  assert(e.Accounts[id] and e.Accounts[id].Player,"Missing historical player account")
  if not seen[id] then seen[id]=true;table.insert(ids,id) end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger or {}) do retain(id) end
 local prefix="player:"..uid..":"
 for _,id in ipairs(e.AccountOrder) do if e.Accounts[id].Player and id:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix then retain(id) end end
 local active=(p.Instances or {})[p.Active] or (p.Tiers or {})[p.Active]
 local selected=type(active)=="table" and active.Account or nil
 if not seen[selected] or not self:Usable(e.Accounts[selected]) then
  selected=nil
  for i=#ids,1,-1 do local a=e.Accounts[ids[i]];if self:Usable(a) and not a.Archive then selected=ids[i];break end end
 end
 local evidence={}
 for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local a=e.Accounts[id]
  evidence[id]={Base=a.Base,Balance=a.Balance,Realized=a.Realized,Positions=clone(a.Positions),Orders={}}
  for _,orderId in ipairs(keys(a.OpenOrders)) do table.insert(evidence[id].Orders,clone(e.Orders[orderId])) end
  e:CancelAll(id)
  for _,contract in ipairs(keys(a.Positions)) do
   local pos=a.Positions[contract];pos.Stop=nil;pos.Target=nil;pos.Triggered="Single account migration"
   while a.Positions[contract] do
    local held=a.Positions[contract]
    local ok,result=e:Submit(id,{Contract=contract,Direction=-held.Direction,Quantity=math.min(held.Quantity,e.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true},{AdministrativeSettlement=true})
    assert(ok and result.Filled>0,"Could not settle historical position")
   end
  end
  TradeStats.Reconcile(e,a,os.time());a.Retired=true;a.LegacyRetired=true;a.Locked=true;a.MigrationArchived=true
 end
 local pending={};for _,v in ipairs(e.PendingStops) do if not seen[v.Owner] then table.insert(pending,v) end end;e.PendingStops=pending
 local carry=selected and e.Accounts[selected].Realized or 0
 local balance=selected and self.Config.StartingBalance+carry or (#ids==0 and self.Config.StartingBalance or 0)
 local q=self:_new(uid);q.Ledger=ids;q.LegacyProfile=original
 q.Migration={Version=1,At=e.Time,Selected=selected,CarryProfit=carry,Balance=balance,Accounts=evidence,
  Rule=tostring(self.Config.StartingBalance).." + selected account net result after closing; no combined balances or wallet conversion"}
 q.PlayerName=p.PlayerName;q.DisplayName=p.DisplayName
 q.Awards=clone(original.Awards or {});q.Titles=clone(original.Titles or {})
 for _,tier in ipairs({"F5K","F10K","F25K","F50K","F100K"}) do
  if (original.Tiers or {})[tier] then table.insert(q.Titles,"Legacy "..tier:sub(2).." Trader") end
 end
 if original.Completion then table.insert(q.Titles,"Legacy Top Tier Complete") end
 local a=self:_open(uid,q,balance,"Migration")
 if balance<=0 then a.Locked=true;a.Depleted=true;a.DepletedAt=e.Time end
 -- Carry is capital on the new run. Its profit is already on the old ledger, counted once.
 self:Evaluate(uid,true)
end
function Funded.new(engine,config,market,options)
 Funded.Validate(config);engine.Profiles=engine.Profiles or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=config,Market=market or engine.Config,Capacity=options and options.Capacity},Funded)
 engine.OnFundedClose=nil
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do
  local a=engine.Accounts[id];local uid=id:match("^player:([^:]+):")
  if a.Player and uid and not engine.Profiles[uid] then engine.Profiles[uid]={V=1,Tiers={},Ledger={}} end
 end
 for _,uid in ipairs(keys(engine.Profiles)) do self:Migrate(engine.Profiles[uid],uid) end
 engine.OnFundedClose=function(a,row)
  local p=a.ProfileId and self:Profile(a.ProfileId)
  if p and p.Account==a.Id then
   Absence.Closed(p,row)
   local earned=self:Evaluate(a.ProfileId,nil,true)
   -- A position can close across many counterpart fills, orders and server steps.
   -- Keep its result in the checkpointed profile until it is flat (or reverses),
   -- independently of the bounded history and unrelated positions/account profit.
   p.PendingTradeCloses=p.PendingTradeCloses or {}
   local result=p.PendingTradeCloses[row.Contract]
   if not result or result.PositionId~=row.PositionId or result.Direction~=row.Direction then
    result={PositionId=row.PositionId,Direction=row.Direction,Pnl=0,Quantity=0,Rewards={}}
    -- Upgrade older open positions using their retained exits, including this fill.
    for _,exit in ipairs(a.History)do
     if exit.PositionId==row.PositionId and exit.Contract==row.Contract and exit.Direction==row.Direction then
      result.Pnl+=exit.Pnl;result.Quantity+=exit.Quantity
     end
    end
    p.PendingTradeCloses[row.Contract]=result
   else
    result.Pnl+=row.Pnl;result.Quantity+=row.Quantity
   end
   for _,title in ipairs(earned)do table.insert(result.Rewards,title)end
   local held=a.Positions[row.Contract]
   if not held or held.Id~=row.PositionId or held.Direction~=row.Direction then
    local view=self:View(a.ProfileId);p.Events=p.Events or {}
    table.insert(p.Events,{Kind="TradeClosed",Account=a.Id,TradeId=row.TradeId,Reason=row.Reason,
     PositionId=row.PositionId,Contract=row.Contract,Quantity=result.Quantity,
     Pnl=result.Pnl,Balance=a.Balance,Next=view.Next,Run=p.Run,Rewards=result.Rewards})
    while #p.Events>16 do table.remove(p.Events,1) end
    p.PendingTradeCloses[row.Contract]=nil
    if not next(p.PendingTradeCloses)then p.PendingTradeCloses=nil end
   end
   self:_touch(p)
  end
 end
 return self
end
function Funded:Join(uid)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then self:Start(uid);p=self:Profile(uid) end;return p
end
function Funded:Start(uid)
 if self:Profile(uid) then return true,"Your trading account is ready.",false end
 local ok,reason=self:CreationAllowed("Start");if not ok then return false,reason end
 self:_open(uid,self:_new(uid),self.Config.StartingBalance,"Start")
 self:Evaluate(uid,true)
 return true,"Your $10,000 account is ready. Choose a market to begin.",true
end
-- Only called on a detached checkpoint by the server's owner command. No client action routes here.
-- Remove every historical account as well as the profile so migration cannot resurrect old progress.
function Funded:ResetPlayer(uid)
 local old=self:Profile(uid);assert(old,"No saved player profile")
 local e=self.Engine local ids,removed={},{} local prefix="player:"..uid..":"
 for _,id in ipairs(e.AccountOrder)do
  local a=e.Accounts[id]
  if a.Player and (a.ProfileId==uid or id:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix)then
   removed[id]=true;table.insert(ids,id)
  end
 end
 for _,id in ipairs(old.Ledger)do assert(removed[id],"Profile contains an account owned by another player")end
 assert(removed[old.Account],"Player account is missing")
 local realized,cash=0,0
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do
  local a=e.Accounts[id];e:CancelAll(id)
  for _,contract in ipairs(keys(a.Positions))do
   local position=a.Positions[contract];position.Stop=nil;position.Target=nil;position.Triggered="Owner reset"
   local ok,fill=e:Submit(id,{Contract=contract,Direction=-position.Direction,Quantity=position.Quantity,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true},{AdministrativeSettlement=true})
   assert(ok and fill.Filled==position.Quantity and not a.Positions[contract],"Could not settle reset position")
  end
  realized+=a.Realized;cash+=a.CashFlow
 end
 -- Anonymous exchange totals balance the removed ledgers. This is not a player account and stores
 -- no identity, trades, statistics or rewards. Other players and the public market tape stay intact.
 local clearing=e.Accounts["house:reset-clearing"] or e:AddAccount("house:reset-clearing",0,1e9,1,false)
 clearing.House=true;clearing.Balance+=realized;clearing.Realized+=realized;clearing.CashFlow+=cash
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e.Accounts[id]=nil end
 for i=#e.AccountOrder,1,-1 do if removed[e.AccountOrder[i]]then table.remove(e.AccountOrder,i)end end
 for i=#e.PendingStops,1,-1 do if removed[e.PendingStops[i].Owner]then table.remove(e.PendingStops,i)end end
 for i=#e.OrderArchive,1,-1 do if removed[e.OrderArchive[i].Owner]then table.remove(e.OrderArchive,i)end end
 local p=self:_new(uid)
 -- Keep only the internal monotonic token: delayed requests from the wiped account must never match.
 p.Run=old.Run;p.PlayerName=old.PlayerName;p.DisplayName=old.DisplayName;p.ProgressionVersion=self.Config.ProgressionVersion
 self:_open(uid,p,self.Config.StartingBalance,"Start");self:Evaluate(uid,true)
 e:Audit()
 return p.Account
end
-- Owner-only capital deposit, called on a detached engine through TransformSaved.
-- Increasing Base with Balance preserves trading P&L and never awards profit titles.
function Funded:GrantMoney(uid,amount,actor,receipt)
 assert(type(amount)=="number"and amount==amount and amount%1==0 and amount>=1 and amount<=1000000000000,"Use a whole-dollar amount from 1 to 1000000000000.")
 assert(type(actor)=="number"and actor>0 and actor%1==0,"Invalid grant issuer")
 assert(type(receipt)=="string"and #receipt>=1 and #receipt<=64,"Invalid grant receipt")
 local p=self:Profile(uid)
 if p then for _,grant in ipairs(p.MoneyGrants or {})do if grant.Id==receipt then
  assert(grant.Amount==amount and grant.Actor==actor,"Grant receipt mismatch");return grant.Balance
 end end end
 if not p then local ok,reason=self:Start(uid);assert(ok,reason);p=self:Profile(uid)end
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account]
 assert(self:Usable(a)and not a.Liquidating,"Restart the player's blown account before using /give.")
 assert(a.Base+amount<4e12 and a.Balance+amount<4e12,"Grant would exceed the $4 trillion account balance limit.")
 a.Base+=amount;a.Balance+=amount;a.LossLimit=a.Base;a.Revision+=1
 p.RunStartBalance=(p.RunStartBalance or a.Base-amount)+amount
 self.Engine:ContractLimit(a)
 p.MoneyGranted=(p.MoneyGranted or 0)+amount;p.MoneyGrants=p.MoneyGrants or {}
 table.insert(p.MoneyGrants,{Id=receipt,Actor=actor,Amount=amount,Account=a.Id,Balance=a.Balance,At=os.time()})
 while #p.MoneyGrants>64 do table.remove(p.MoneyGrants,1)end
 self:_touch(p);return a.Balance
end
function Funded:Earned(p)
 local total=0 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do total+=self.Engine.Accounts[id].Realized end return total
end
function Funded:_counts(p)
 local trades,wins=0,0
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do local a=self.Engine.Accounts[id];local s=a.Stats or TradeStats.Reconcile(self.Engine,a,os.time())
  trades+=(s.Trades or 0)+(s.UntrackedTrades or 0);wins+=s.Wins or 0
 end
 return trades,wins
end
function Funded:_metric(p,m,net,trades,wins)
 return Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins),m.Goal
end
function Funded:Evaluate(uid,silent,closingTrade)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return end
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account];assert(a,"Missing single account")
 local migrated=Rules.Normalize(p,self.Engine.Time)
 local net=self:Earned(p);local trades,wins=self:_counts(p)
 p.ProfitHigh=math.max(p.ProfitHigh or 0,net)
 local earned={}
 for _,m in ipairs(self.Config.Milestones)do
  -- Saved high-water profit is authoritative historical evidence for newly introduced titles.
  local value=self:_metric(p,m,migrated and p.ProfitHigh or net,trades,wins)
  if not p.Awards[m.Id] and value+1e-6>=m.Goal then
   p.Awards[m.Id]={At=self.Engine.Time,Net=net,Run=p.Run,Title=m.Title,Goal=m.Goal}
   table.insert(earned,m.Title)
   if not silent and not closingTrade then p.Events=p.Events or {};table.insert(p.Events,{Kind="Milestone",Name=m.Name,Title=m.Title,Id=m.Id})end
   self:_touch(p)
  end
  -- Raise saved rewards to the current bonus once; never stack or reduce earned funds.
  local award=p.Awards[m.Id]
  if award and (award.StartingBonus==nil or award.StartingBonus<m.StartingBonus) then
   award.StartingBonus=m.StartingBonus;self:_touch(p)
  end
 end
 p.Titles=Rules.Titles(p)
 local previous,index=Rules.Rank(p.RankId);index=index or 1
 p.RankAwards=p.RankAwards or {}
 for i,r in ipairs(self.Config.Ranks)do
  if i<=index or Rules.Qualifies(r,migrated and p.ProfitHigh or net,trades,wins)then
   if not p.RankAwards[r.Id]then p.RankAwards[r.Id]={At=self.Engine.Time,Net=net};self:_touch(p)end
   index=math.max(index,i)
  end
 end
 local rank=self.Config.Ranks[index];p.RankId=rank.Id;p.Rank=rank.Name
 if previous and previous.Id~=rank.Id and not silent and not closingTrade then
  p.Events=p.Events or {};table.insert(p.Events,{Kind="RankUp",Id=rank.Id,Name=rank.Name})
 end
 if migrated then self:_touch(p)end
 if a.Depleted and p.FailureNotice~=p.Run then
  p.FailureNotice=p.Run;p.Events=p.Events or {}
  if not silent then table.insert(p.Events,{Kind="Depleted",Tier=a.Id,Event=tostring(p.Run),Name="Trading account"})end
  self:_touch(p)
 end
 return earned
end
function Funded:StartingBalance(p)
 local bonus=0;for _,award in pairs(p.Awards or {})do bonus+=award.StartingBonus or 0 end
 return self.Config.StartingBalance+bonus,bonus
end
function Funded:Depart(uid,now)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if p then Absence.Depart(self.Engine,p,now or os.time());self:_touch(p)end
end
function Funded:Return(uid,now)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if p and p.Absence then Absence.Return(self.Engine,p,now or os.time());self:_touch(p)end
end
function Funded:AcknowledgeAway(uid,id)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p or not Absence.Acknowledge(p,id)then return false,"Summary already changed."end
 self:_touch(p);return true,"Welcome back."
end
function Funded:_credits(p)
 local state=p.Limits.Reset or {};local c=self.Config.ResetLimits
 return math.min(c.Burst,(state.Tokens or c.Burst)+math.max(0,self.Engine.Time-(state.At or self.Engine.Time))/(c.RefillSeconds*self.Market.SimulationSpeed))
end
function Funded:CanRestart(p)
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account]
 return a.Depleted==true and not next(a.Positions) and not next(a.OpenOrders)
end
-- Completed runs are folded into one accounting record. Legacy migration records remain intact.
function Funded:_archiveRun(uid,p,a)
 assert(not next(a.Positions) and not next(a.OpenOrders),"Cannot archive exposure")
 local id="player:"..uid..":single-history";local archive=self.Engine.Accounts[id]
 if not archive then
  archive=self.Engine:AddAccount(id,0,0,0,true);archive.Retired=true;archive.Locked=true;archive.LegacyRetired=true
  archive.Archive={Attempts=0,Blown=0,Breached=0};table.insert(p.Ledger,id)
 end
 archive.Base+=a.Base;archive.Balance+=a.Balance;archive.Realized+=a.Realized;archive.CashFlow+=a.CashFlow
 archive.Archive.Attempts+=1;archive.Archive.Blown+=a.Depleted and 1 or 0
 archive.CompletedTrades=(archive.CompletedTrades or 0)+(a.CompletedTrades or 0);TradeStats.Merge(archive.Stats,a.Stats)
 for _,row in ipairs(a.History) do table.insert(archive.History,clone(row)) end
 table.sort(archive.History,function(x,y)return x.TradeId>y.TradeId end)
 while #archive.History>self.Engine.Config.MaxAccountHistory do table.remove(archive.History) end
 table.insert(p.RunHistory,1,{Run=p.Run,StartBalance=a.Base,FinalBalance=a.Balance,Net=a.Realized,ClosedAt=self.Engine.Time})
 while #p.RunHistory>32 do table.remove(p.RunHistory) end
 self.Engine.Accounts[a.Id]=nil;table.remove(self.Engine.AccountOrder,table.find(self.Engine.AccountOrder,a.Id))
 table.remove(p.Ledger,table.find(p.Ledger,a.Id))
 local pending={};for _,v in ipairs(self.Engine.PendingStops) do if v.Owner~=a.Id then table.insert(pending,v) end end;self.Engine.PendingStops=pending
end
function Funded:Restart(uid,expected)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return false,"Wait for your account to load." end
 if expected~=p.Account then return false,"Your account has changed. Check it before restarting." end
 if not self:CanRestart(p) then return false,"Restart free after your account fails and all positions and orders close." end
 local credits=self:_credits(p)
 if credits<1 then return false,"Restart limit reached. Wait for a restart to become available; your progress is kept." end
 local ok,reason=self:CreationAllowed("Restart");if not ok then return false,reason end
 self:Evaluate(uid,true)
 self:_archiveRun(uid,p,self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account]);p.Limits.Reset={Tokens=credits-1,At=self.Engine.Time}
 self:_open(uid,p,self:StartingBalance(p),"Restart")
 return true,string.format("Account restarted with $%s. Your permanent progress is kept.",self:StartingBalance(p))
end
-- Discard exposure by transferring its cost basis to an internal clearing account.
-- No player fill, completed trade, profit, volume or milestone is generated.
function Funded:ResetAccount(uid,expected)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return false,"Wait for your account to load."end
 if expected~=p.Account then return false,"Your account has changed. Check it before resetting."end
 local credits=self:_credits(p);if credits<1 then return false,"Reset limit reached. Please wait before resetting again."end
 local ok,reason=self:CreationAllowed("Reset");if not ok then return false,reason end
 local e=self.Engine;local a=e.Accounts[p.Account]
 e:CancelAll(a.Id)
 local clearing=e.Accounts["house:reset-exposure"] or e:AddAccount("house:reset-exposure",0,1e9,1,false)
 clearing.House=true
 for _,key in ipairs(keys(a.Positions))do
  local pos=a.Positions[key];local spec=e.Books[key].Spec
  local order={Id=0,Owner=clearing.Id,Contract=key,Direction=pos.Direction,Remaining=pos.Quantity,Filled=0,Notional=0,Reference=0}
  e:_fillAccount(order,pos.Entry,pos.Quantity,0)
  a.CashFlow+=pos.Entry*pos.Quantity*pos.Direction*spec.Multiplier
  a.Positions[key]=nil
 end
 p.Absence=nil;p.AwaySummary=nil
 self:Evaluate(uid,true)
 self:_archiveRun(uid,p,a);p.Limits.Reset={Tokens=credits-1,At=e.Time}
 self:_open(uid,p,self:StartingBalance(p),"Reset")
 return true,"Account reset. Lifetime statistics, ranks and permanent bonuses are kept."
end
function Funded:Flag(uid,stage)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return false,"Wait for your account to load." end
 if stage~="TutorialDone" and stage~="TutorialSkipped" then return false,"Unknown tutorial step." end
 p.Tutorial=stage=="TutorialDone" and "Done" or "Skipped";self:_touch(p);return true,"Saved."
end
function Funded:TakeEvents(uid)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p or not p.Events or #p.Events==0 then return nil end
 local events=p.Events;p.Events={}
 -- A final fill can enqueue TradeClosed before the engine latches depletion.
 -- Decide at delivery time so the account-failed notice owns that outcome.
 local failed={}
 for _,event in ipairs(events)do if event.Kind=="Depleted"then failed[event.Tier]=true end end
 local visible={}
 for _,event in ipairs(events)do
  local a=event.Account and self.Engine.Accounts[event.Account]
  if event.Kind~="TradeClosed"or not(event.Reason=="Account depleted"or failed[event.Account]or a and a.Depleted)then table.insert(visible,event)end
 end
 return #visible>0 and visible or nil
end
function Funded:SetProtectionPreferences(uid,value)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return false,"Wait for your account to load." end
 local nextValue=Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if not nextValue then return false,"Check your stop loss and take profit settings. Use amounts greater than $0." end
 if not p.ProtectionPreferences or not Protection.SamePreferences(p.ProtectionPreferences,nextValue)then
  p.ProtectionPreferences=nextValue;self:_touch(p)
 end
 return true,"Trade protection settings saved."
end
function Funded:View(uid)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return {New=true,Revision=0} end
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account];local sum=self.Engine:Summary(a);local net=self:Earned(p);local trades,wins=self:_counts(p)
 local failed=a.Depleted==true;local closing=next(a.Positions)~=nil or next(a.OpenOrders)~=nil
 local row={Key=a.Id,Name="Trading account",Short="Trading account",State="Active",Usable=not failed,Depleted=failed,Breached=failed,
  Closing=failed and closing,CanRestart=self:CanRestart(p),DepletionEvent=tostring(p.Run),Balance=a.Balance,Equity=sum.Equity,
  Unrealized=sum.Unrealized,Realized=a.Realized,Limit=self.Engine:ContractLimit(a),Size=a.Base,LossLimit=math.max(0,sum.Equity),Positions=sum.Count}
 local v={Revision=p.Revision,Started=true,Active=a.Id,ActiveName="Trading account",ActiveShort="Trading account",ActiveSize=a.Base,
  Run=p.Run,RunProfit=a.Realized,RunStartBalance=p.RunStartBalance,Earned=net,Open=sum.Unrealized,Balance=a.Balance,Equity=sum.Equity,
  StartingBalance=self:StartingBalance(p),StartingBonus=select(2,self:StartingBalance(p)),BaseStartingBalance=self.Config.StartingBalance,AwaySummary=Absence.WithPnl(self.Engine,clone(p.AwaySummary)),
  ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(p.ProtectionPreferences),
  Rank=p.Rank,RankId=p.RankId,Trades=trades,Wins=wins,Titles=clone(p.Titles),Awards=clone(p.Awards),Tutorial=p.Tutorial,Accounts={row},CanRestart=row.CanRestart,
  ActiveCount=failed and 0 or 1,UsableCount=failed and 0 or 1,Failed=failed,Milestones={},Migrated=p.Migration~=nil}
 for _,m in ipairs(self.Config.Milestones) do
  local value,goal=self:_metric(p,m,net,trades,wins)
  local r={Key=m.Id,Badge=m.Badge,Name=m.Name,Short=m.Name,Title=m.Title,Kind=m.Kind,Goal=goal,Progress=math.min(value,goal),
   StartingBonus=p.Awards[m.Id] and p.Awards[m.Id].StartingBonus or m.StartingBonus,
   Remaining=math.max(0,goal-value),Earned=p.Awards[m.Id]~=nil,
   EarlierGoal=p.Awards[m.Id]~=nil and p.Awards[m.Id].Goal~=goal}
  table.insert(v.Milestones,r);if not r.Earned and not v.Next then v.Next=clone(r) end
 end
 local rank,index=Rules.Rank(p.RankId)
 v.RankBadge=rank and rank.Badge;v.RankLevel=index;v.RankNext=index and clone(self.Config.Ranks[index+1])
 local _,title=Rules.Titles(p);v.Title=title and title.Title or (#p.Titles>0 and p.Titles[#p.Titles] or "Your first title awaits")
 v.TitleId=title and title.Id;v.TitleBadge=title and title.Badge or 1
 v.Ranks={};for _,r in ipairs(self.Config.Ranks)do local item=clone(r);item.Earned=p.RankAwards[r.Id]~=nil;table.insert(v.Ranks,item)end
 v.Completed=v.Next==nil;return v
end
function Funded:Stats(uid)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return {Ready=true,New=true,Scopes={}} end
 local all,current=TradeStats.Empty(),TradeStats.Empty()
 for _,id in ipairs(p.Ledger) do TradeStats.Include(all,self.Engine,self.Engine.Accounts[id]) end
 TradeStats.Include(current,self.Engine,self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account])
 return {Ready=true,Started=true,Run=p.Run,RunStartBalance=p.RunStartBalance,Scopes={
  {Key="ALL",Kind="All",Name="Trading history",Short="Trading history",Life=TradeStats.Finish(all),Current=TradeStats.Finish(current)}}}
end
function Funded:StatsKey(uid)
 local p=self:Profile(uid);if not p then return "new" end
 local a=self.Engine.Accounts[p.Account];return p.Revision..":"..a.Revision..":"..tostring(a.Depleted)
end
function Funded.Perform(engine,owner,req)
 local a=engine.Accounts[owner];if not a then return false,"Unknown account." end
 if req.Action=="Place" then return engine:Submit(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="AmendProtection" then return engine:AmendProtection(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="AmendOrder" then return engine:AmendOrder(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="Cancel" then
  if type(req.OrderId)~="number" then return false,"Unknown order." end
  if req.Protection then return engine:CancelProtection(owner,req.OrderId,req.Protection) end
  return engine:Cancel(owner,req.OrderId)
 elseif req.Action=="Close" then
  local p=a.Positions[req.Contract];if not p then return false,"No open position." end
  engine:CancelAll(owner,req.Contract);p.Triggered="Player close";p.Stop=nil;p.Target=nil
  local ok,result=engine:Submit(owner,{Contract=req.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=engine.Config.PlayerExecution and p.Quantity or math.min(p.Quantity,engine.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
  if ok and result.Remaining>0 and a.Positions[req.Contract]then a.Positions[req.Contract].ExitOrder=result.Id end
  return ok,result
 end
 return false,"Request rejected."
end
function Funded.Describe(result)
 local filled,remaining,cancelled=result.Filled or 0,result.Remaining or 0,result.Cancelled or 0
 local requested=filled+remaining+cancelled
 local prefix=result.Amended and string.format("Limit %s moved to %.2f · ",result.Direction==1 and "Buy"or "Sell",result.Price)or ""
 if result.Queued then return prefix..string.format("Executing %d contracts · %d filled, %d remaining. View or cancel in Orders.",requested,filled,remaining)end
 if cancelled>0 then
  local lead=filled>0 and string.format("Partially filled %d of %d @ %.2f",filled,requested,result.Average) or "No fill"
  return prefix..string.format("%s · %d unfilled contracts cancelled (available liquidity or execution limits).",lead,cancelled)
 elseif filled>0 and remaining>0 then
  return prefix..string.format("Partially filled %d of %d @ %.2f · %d still working.",filled,requested,result.Average,remaining)
 end
 if result.Amended and filled==0 and remaining>0 then return prefix..string.format("No new fills · %d still working.",remaining)end
 return prefix..(filled>0 and string.format("Filled %d @ %.2f",filled,result.Average) or result.Status or "Working")
end
return Funded

local Liquidity=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
-- Disposable engines and fake stores only. No production profile or DataStore is accessed.
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local CP=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local W=require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local TS=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Replies=require(script.Parent.ReplyBuffer)
local Tests={}
local function clone(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=clone(x) end return r end
local function same(a,b)
 assert(type(a)==type(b),"Type differs")
 if type(a)~="table" then assert(a==b,tostring(a).." differs from "..tostring(b));return end
 for k,v in pairs(a) do same(v,b[k]) end;for k in pairs(b) do assert(a[k]~=nil,"Missing "..tostring(k)) end
end
local function fresh(uid)
 local c=clone(C);c.WarmupSeconds=0
 local e=E.new(c,712);local f=F.new(e,L,c);if uid then f:Join(uid) end;return e,f
end
local function pop(e)return setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(712),Agents={}},P)end
local function result(e,id,amount)

-- Bounded per-connection acknowledgement queue (server only).
-- Replies wait for the player's next market packet. A client that never subscribes, or stops reading,
-- keeps at most MaxReplies acknowledgements, each for at most MaxAgeSeconds. Every reply path (accepted,
-- rejected, queue-full and paused) goes through Push, so none of them can grow server memory without bound.
-- When anything is dropped the connection is marked Full: its next packet is a complete authoritative
-- snapshot (positions, orders, history, portfolio and stats) and carries RepliesDropped, so the client
-- never depends on an expired acknowledgement to learn the current state.
local ReplyBuffer={MaxReplies=64,MaxAgeSeconds=30}
ReplyBuffer.__index=ReplyBuffer
function ReplyBuffer.new(maxReplies,maxAgeSeconds)
 return setmetatable({MaxReplies=math.max(1,maxReplies or ReplyBuffer.MaxReplies),MaxAgeSeconds=maxAgeSeconds or ReplyBuffer.MaxAgeSeconds},ReplyBuffer)
end
local function drop(state,count)
 if count<=0 then return end
 local replies,times=state.Replies,state.ReplyTimes
 table.move(replies,count+1,#replies+count,1)
 table.move(times,count+1,#times+count,1)
 state.DroppedReplies=(state.DroppedReplies or 0)+count
 state.Full=true
end
function ReplyBuffer:Prune(state,now)
 state.Replies=state.Replies or {} state.ReplyTimes=state.ReplyTimes or {}
 local times,expired=state.ReplyTimes,0
 while times[expired+1] and now-times[expired+1]>self.MaxAgeSeconds do expired+=1 end
 drop(state,expired)
 return expired
end
function ReplyBuffer:Push(state,reply,now)
 self:Prune(state,now)
 drop(state,#state.Replies-self.MaxReplies+1)
 table.insert(state.Replies,reply) table.insert(state.ReplyTimes,now)
end
-- Hands the queued replies to one outgoing packet and clears the queue.
function ReplyBuffer:Take(state)
 local replies,dropped=state.Replies or {},state.DroppedReplies
 state.Replies={} state.ReplyTimes={} state.DroppedReplies=nil
 return replies,dropped
end
return ReplyBuffer

-- Pure projection of the authoritative funded ledger. Never accepts client scores.

local Rules=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionRules)
local Ranking={Limit=100}

function Ranking.Row(funded,uid,identity)

 local p=funded:Profile(uid)

 local row={UserId=tonumber(uid),Name=identity and identity.Name or p and p.PlayerName,

  DisplayName=identity and identity.DisplayName or p and p.DisplayName,Cents=0,Eligible=false,Tier="—",TierSize=0}

 if not row.UserId or row.UserId%1~=0 then return nil end

 if not p then return row end

 local profit=funded.Engine.Accounts[p.Account].Balance

 assert(profit==profit and math.abs(profit)<9e13,"Invalid account balance")

 row.Cents=math.round(profit*100)

 local trades=funded:_counts(p)

 row.Eligible=trades>0

 local rank=Rules.Rank(p.RankId)
 row.ProgressionRankId=rank and rank.Id;row.ProgressionVersion=p.ProgressionVersion
 row.Tier=rank and rank.Name or nil;row.TierSize=0

 return row

end

function Ranking.Sort(rows,limit)

 local result,seen={},{}

 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

  if row and row.Eligible and not seen[row.UserId] then seen[row.UserId]=true;table.insert(result,table.clone(row)) end

 end

 table.sort(result,function(a,b) if a.Cents~=b.Cents then return a.Cents>b.Cents end return a.UserId<b.UserId end)

 while limit and #result>limit do table.remove(result) end

 for i,row in ipairs(result) do row.Rank=i end

 return result

end

function Ranking.Capture(funded)

 local rows={}

 for uid in pairs(funded.Engine.Profiles) do

  local row=Ranking.Row(funded,uid)

  -- Studio's synthetic negative user ids are allowed only by its separate store scope.

  if row then table.insert(rows,row) end

 end

 return Ranking.Sort(rows,Ranking.Limit)

end

function Ranking.Standing(own,rows,verified)

 own=table.clone(own);own.Rank=nil

 if not own.Eligible then own.Status="Close a trade to join";return own end

 own.Status="Outside top 100"

 if verified then

  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

   if row.UserId==own.UserId and row.Cents==own.Cents then own.Rank=row.Rank;own.Status="#"..row.Rank;break end

  end

 end

 return own

end

return Ranking

-- This game persists EVERY funded profile in one fenced shared-exchange checkpoint.
-- Publish a complete top-100 projection, atomically, instead of racing per-user ordered writes.
-- A lower score can evict a previous winner correctly; ties at the cutoff are deterministic.
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Service={} Service.__index=Service
Service.RefreshSeconds=45
function Service.Scope(studio) return studio and "Studio" or "Live" end
function Service.new(options)
 options=options or {}
 return setmetatable({Store=options.Store,Studio=options.Studio,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Cache=nil,ReadAt=0,NextRead=0,NextWrite=0,Pending=nil,Reading=false,Writing=false,Failures=0},Service)
end
function Service:_store()
 if not self.Store then self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("GetFunded_BalanceLeaderboard_v1",Service.Scope(self.Studio)) end
 return self.Store
end
function Service:Queue(projection)
 if not projection or self.LastProjection==projection then return end
 self.LastProjection=projection
 if not self.Pending or projection.WorldId~=self.Pending.WorldId or projection.Sequence>self.Pending.Sequence then self.Pending=projection end
end
function Service:UseDurableProjection(projection)
 if not projection then return end
 self:Queue(projection)
 -- Already committed in the exchange. Keep the live read model correct even if its store is retrying.
 self.Cache={Version=1,WorldId=projection.WorldId,Sequence=projection.Sequence,SavedAt=projection.SavedAt,Rows=projection.Rows}
 self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
end
function Service:Flush()
 local pending=self.Pending
 if self.Writing or not pending or self.Now()<self.NextWrite then return false end
 self.Writing=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  return self:_store():UpdateAsync("top100",function(old)
   if old then
    assert(old.Version==1 and old.WorldId==pending.WorldId,"Leaderboard belongs to another exchange")
    if old.Sequence>=pending.Sequence then return nil end -- fences delayed/stale writers, including losses
   end
   return {Version=1,WorldId=pending.WorldId,Sequence=pending.Sequence,SavedAt=pending.SavedAt,Rows=pending.Rows}
  end)
 end)
 self.Writing=false
 if ok then
  self.Failures=0;self.WriteError=nil;self.NextWrite=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
  if self.Pending==pending then self.Pending=nil end
  if result then
   -- An overlapping read may already have seen the next owner's newer snapshot.
   if not self.Cache or (result.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and result.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence)then
    self.Cache=result;self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds;self.ReadError=nil
   end
  else self.NextRead=0 end
 else
  self.Failures+=1;self.WriteError=tostring(result)
  self.NextWrite=self.Now()+math.min(45,5*2^math.min(self.Failures-1,4))
 end
 return ok
end
function Service:Read()
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Reading or now<self.NextRead then return self.Cache end
 self.Reading=true;self.NextRead=now+Service.RefreshSeconds
 local ok,record=pcall(function()return self:_store():GetAsync("top100")end)
 self.Reading=false
 if ok and record and (record.Version~=1 or type(record.Rows)~="table" or type(record.SavedAt)~="number" or type(record.Sequence)~="number") then ok=false;record="Invalid leaderboard snapshot" end
 if ok then
  -- Do not regress a cache if a read overlaps a newer successful publish.
  if not record then if not self.Cache then self.ReadAt=now end
  elseif not self.Cache or (record.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and record.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence) then self.Cache=record;self.ReadAt=now end
  self.ReadError=nil
 else self.ReadError=tostring(record);self.NextRead=now+10 end
 return self.Cache
end
function Service:Names(rows)
 self.NameCache=self.NameCache or {};self.NameRetry=self.NameRetry or 0
 local missing={}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local cached=self.NameCache[row.UserId]
  if cached then row.Name=cached.Name;row.DisplayName=cached.DisplayName
  elseif not row.Name and row.UserId>0 then table.insert(missing,row.UserId) end
 end
 if #missing==0 or self.Now()<self.NameRetry then return end
 self.NameRetry=self.Now()+60
 local ok,infos=pcall(function()return game:GetService("UserService"):GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(missing)end)
 if ok then
  for _,info in ipairs(infos) do self.NameCache[info.Id]={Name=info.Username,DisplayName=info.DisplayName} end
  for _,row in ipairs(rows)do local info=self.NameCache[row.UserId];if info then row.Name=info.Name;row.DisplayName=info.DisplayName end end
 end
end
function Service:Global(own)
 self:Read()
 local record=self.Cache
 local stale=record and (self.Now()-record.SavedAt>120 or self.ReadError~=nil or self.WriteError~=nil)
 local rows={}
 for _,r in ipairs(record and record.Rows or {}) do
  local row=table.clone(r);if stale then row.Rank=nil end;table.insert(rows,row)
 end
 self:Names(rows)
 local state=not record and (self.ReadError and "Error" or "Loading") or stale and "Stale" or #rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready"
 return {Tab="Global",State=state,Rows=rows,Your=Ranking.Standing(own,rows,record~=nil and not stale),
  SavedAt=record and record.SavedAt,RefreshSeconds=Service.RefreshSeconds,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
function Service:Server(funded,players,player)
 local rows={}
 for _,p in ipairs(players) do table.insert(rows,Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(p.UserId),p)) end
 rows=Ranking.Sort(rows)
 local own=Ranking.Standing(Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(player.UserId),player),rows,true)
 return {Tab="Server",State=#rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready",Rows=rows,Your=own,RefreshSeconds=10,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
return Service

local Liquidity=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
-- In-memory regression tests only: no DataStore, real player, or live exchange access.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Ladder=table.clone(require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig))
-- Small-balance fixtures exercise the five-contract floor; growth cases below cover larger balances.
Ladder.Tiers={{Id="Single",Size=5000,MaxContracts=5,Short="$5K trading account"}}
local T={}
local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function fresh(tier)
 local e=E.new(Config,4527)
 e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
 local a=e:AddAccount("test",tier.Size,tier.MaxContracts,Ladder.MarginUse,true)
 return e,a
end
local function request(side,qty,price,key)
 return {Action="Place",Contract=key or "BT",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit"or"Market",Price=price,StopTicks=40,TargetTicks=120}
end
local function submit(e,id,r)local ok,v=Liquidity.Submit(e,id,r);assert(ok,tostring(v));return v end
local function quote(e,side,qty,price,key)
 local r=request(side,qty,price or Config.Contracts[key or "BT"].Last,key);r.StopTicks=nil;r.TargetTicks=nil
 return submit(e,"maker",r)
end
-- One participant-to-participant execution at `price`: the only way the market price moves.
local function trade(e,price,key)
 e:AddAccount("t:seller",1e9,10000,.99,false);e:AddAccount("t:buyer",1e9,10000,.99,false);e:CancelAll("maker")
 submit(e,"t:seller",{Contract=key or "BT",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 local r=submit(e,"t:buyer",{Contract=key or "BT",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 assert(r.Filled==1,"Market trade did not print at "..price)
end
local function rejected(e,a,r,max,reason)
 local ok,msg=e:Submit(a.Id,r)
 assert(not ok,"Excess order accepted")
 assert(msg:find("Maximum currently available: "..max.." "..r.Contract,1,true),msg)
 if reason then assert(msg:lower():find(reason,1,true),msg)end
end
function T.Run()
 local results={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,msg=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (msg or "Passed")or tostring(msg)})end
 for i,tier in ipairs(Ladder.Tiers)do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   test(tier.Short..(side==1 and " long "or" short ")..tier.MaxContracts.." BT with default protection",function()
    assert(tier.MaxContracts==({5,10,25,50,100})[i])
    local e,a=fresh(tier)
    rejected(e,a,request(side,tier.MaxContracts+1),tier.MaxContracts,"limit")
    quote(e,-side,tier.MaxContracts)
    local r=submit(e,a.Id,request(side,tier.MaxContracts))
    assert(r.Filled==tier.MaxContracts and a.Positions.BT.Quantity==tier.MaxContracts)
    local p=a.Positions.BT;assert(p.Direction==side and p.Stop and p.Target)
    assert(math.abs(p.Entry-p.Stop)==40*.25 and math.abs(p.Entry-p.Target)==120*.25)
    assert(Config.Contracts.BT.Multiplier==20 and Config.Contracts.BT.Tick==.25)
    rejected(e,a,request(side,1),0,"limit")
    e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(a.Positions.BT and not a.Liquidating)
    e:Audit()
   end)
  end
 end
 test("Existing exposure, mixed instruments, pending orders and cancellation reserve total capacity",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);quote(e,-1,2);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,2))
  local pending=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,1,20480))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,3),2,"limit")
  submit(e,a.Id,request(1,1,5800,"BX"))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,2),1,"limit") -- 2 held + 1 pending BT + 1 pending BX = 4; the account total is 5
  assert(e:Cancel(a.Id,pending.Id));assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BT",1,40)==2) -- 5 total minus the BX entry minus 2 held
  e:CancelAll(a.Id);assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BT",1,40)==3)
 end)
 test("Both directions reserve worst-case entries; reduce-only exits do not reserve new exposure",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5,20480));submit(e,a.Id,request(-1,5,20490))
  rejected(e,a,request(1,1),0);rejected(e,a,request(-1,1),0)
  e:CancelAll(a.Id);quote(e,-1,5);submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5))
  local close=request(-1,5,20490);close.ReduceOnly=true;submit(e,a.Id,close)
  assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BT",-1,40)==10)
  rejected(e,a,request(1,1),0)
 end)
 test("Below $5K the five-contract minimum remains; $0 equity still stops new entries",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);a.Balance=1000;a.Realized=1000-a.Base -- a starter account reduced to $1,000
  for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
   assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,key,1)==5 and e:OrderCapacity(a,key,-1)==5,"Low equity reduced "..key.." capacity")
   local snap=e:Snapshot(a.Id,key,"1m",false);assert(snap.Capacity[key].Buy==5 and snap.Capacity[key].Sell==5,"UI capacity")
  end
  rejected(e,a,request(1,6),5,"limit")
  local r=request(1,5);r.StopTicks=1000;quote(e,-1,5)
  assert(submit(e,a.Id,r).Filled==5 and a.Positions.BT.Quantity==5,"5 BT rejected on a $1,000 balance")
  rejected(e,a,request(1,1),0,"limit")
  assert(Liquidity.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="Close",Contract="BT"}));assert(not a.Positions.BT)
  a.Balance=0;a.Realized=-a.Base;rejected(e,a,request(-1,1),0,"$0")
  e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(a.Locked);rejected(e,a,request(-1,1),0,"account failed")
  a.Balance=a.Base;a.Realized=0
 end)
 for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   test(key.." wide stops allow entry and dragging; depletion still liquidates "..side,function()
    local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);local spec=Config.Contracts[key];local qty=2
    e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
    local function tickPrice(price)return math.round(price/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick end
    local function mark(price)
     e:CancelAll("maker") -- player fills never consume quotes; clear them so the next print sets the price
     quote(e,side,1,price,key)
     local r=request(-side,1,nil,key);r.StopTicks=nil;r.TargetTicks=nil
     submit(e,"taker",r)
    end
    quote(e,-side,qty,spec.Last,key)
    local entry=request(side,qty,nil,key)
    entry.StopTicks=math.ceil(a.Base*1.5/(qty*spec.Multiplier*spec.Tick))
    assert(submit(e,a.Id,entry).Filled==qty,"Wide initial stop rejected")
    local p=a.Positions[key];local target=p.Target;local initial=p.Stop
    local wide=tickPrice(p.Entry-side*a.Base*2/(qty*spec.Multiplier))
    assert(e:AmendProtection(a.Id,{Contract=key,OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=wide,ExpectedPrice=initial}))
    assert(p.Stop==wide and p.Target==target and math.abs(p.Entry-wide)*qty*spec.Multiplier>a.Base)
    assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,{Contract=key,OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=wide,ExpectedPrice=initial}),"Stale drag accepted")
    local pending=submit(e,a.Id,request(side,1,wide,key))
    mark(tickPrice(p.Entry-side*(a.Base-250)/(qty*spec.Multiplier)))
    assert(e:Summary(a).Equity>0 and e:Summary(a).Equity<e:Summary(a).Margin)
    e:AdvanceClock(.25)
    assert(a.Positions[key]==p and not p.Triggered and not a.Locked and not a.Liquidating,"Positive equity liquidated")
    assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,key,side)==2,"Low equity must not reduce the contract limit (2 held + 1 working of 5)")
    -- Alternate exact-zero and negative-equity boundaries across long/short cases.
    local beyond=side==1 and 0 or 250
    local exit=tickPrice(p.Entry-side*(a.Base+beyond)/(qty*spec.Multiplier))
    mark(exit)
    assert(a.Locked and p.Triggered=="Account depleted" and not p.Stop and not p.Target,"Depletion did not latch")
    local lastTick,volume=e.Books[key].Last,e.Books[key].Volume
    Liquidity.Offer(e,key,side,qty,exit)
    e:AdvanceClock(.25)
    -- Post executable exit liquidity; liquidation retries if the book is empty.
    assert(not e.Orders[pending.Id] and not a.Positions[key] and a.Locked,"Liquidation must cancel entries and close at the market")
    assert(e.Books[key].Last==lastTick and e.Books[key].Volume==volume+qty,"Liquidation must consume and print actual exit liquidity")
    rejected(e,a,request(side,1,nil,key),0,"account failed")
    -- The exit is tick-rounded, so on a 0.1-tick market (BG) the loss can differ from Base+beyond by under a tick per contract.
    local loss=(p.Entry-exit)*side*qty*spec.Multiplier
    assert(loss>=a.Base and math.abs(loss-(a.Base+beyond))<=qty*spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier and #a.History==1)
    assert(math.abs(a.Realized+loss)<1e-5 and math.abs(a.Balance-(a.Base-loss))<1e-5)
    e:Audit()
   end)
  end
 end
 -- Consistent 5-contract minimum on $5K for every market (equal $750 simulated margin).
 for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   test("$5K "..key..(side==1 and " long"or" short").." reaches exactly 5 contracts; the 6th is rejected",function()
    assert(Config.Contracts[key].Margin==750,"Unequal market margin")
    local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);local last=Config.Contracts[key].Last
    assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,key,side)==5,"Fresh $5K capacity for "..key.." is "..e:OrderCapacity(a,key,side))
    rejected(e,a,request(side,6,nil,key),5,"limit")
    quote(e,-side,5,last,key);local r=submit(e,a.Id,request(side,5,nil,key))
    assert(r.Filled==5 and a.Positions[key].Quantity==5)
    rejected(e,a,request(side,1,nil,key),0,"limit")
    local snap=e:Snapshot(a.Id,key,"1m",false)
    assert(snap.Capacity[key][side==1 and "Buy" or "Sell"]==0 and snap.Capacity[key][side==1 and "Sell" or "Buy"]==10 and snap.Limit==5,"Snapshot capacity for the UI")
    e:Audit()
   end)
  end
 end
 test("Stop entries validate side, tick, band and account; they arm off-book and reserve the cap",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);local last=Config.Contracts.BX.Last
  local function stop(side,qty,price)local r=request(side,qty,price,"BX");r.Type="Stop";return r end
  assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,stop(1,1,last-1)),"Stop buy below market accepted")
  assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,stop(-1,1,last+1)),"Stop sell above market accepted")
  assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,stop(1,1,last)),"Stop buy at market accepted")
  assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,stop(1,1,last+0.1)),"Off-tick stop accepted")
  assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,stop(1,1,last*1.2)),"Stop outside the price band accepted")
  local reduce=stop(-1,1,last-5);reduce.ReduceOnly=true;assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,reduce),"Reduce-only stop accepted")
  local r=submit(e,a.Id,stop(1,3,last+5))
  assert(r.Status=="Stop armed" and r.Filled==0 and e.Orders[r.Id].Type=="Stop" and #e.Books.BX.Bids==0 and #e.Books.BX.Asks==0,"Stop rested in the book")
  rejected(e,a,request(1,3,nil,"BX"),2,"limit") -- 3 armed + 3 would exceed 5
  local sell=submit(e,a.Id,stop(-1,5,last-5)) -- opposite side is independently worst-case
  rejected(e,a,request(-1,1,last+50,"BX"),0,"limit")
  local snap=e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",false)
  local kinds={} for _,o in ipairs(snap.Orders)do kinds[o.Kind]=o.Status end
  assert(kinds["Stop Buy"]=="Armed" and kinds["Stop Sell"]=="Armed","Orders tab labels")
  assert(e:Cancel(a.Id,sell.Id) and e:Cancel(a.Id,r.Id) and e:OrderCapacity(a,"BX",1)==5,"Cancel released capacity")
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("A stop triggers on the trade that reaches it, fills at market with SL/TP, and reports once",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,10000,.99,false);local last=Config.Contracts.BX.Last
  local r=request(1,2,last+2,"BX");r.Type="Stop";local armed=submit(e,a.Id,r)
  quote(e,-1,1,last+1,"BX");submit(e,"taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});e:ProcessStops()
  assert(e.Orders[armed.Id] and not a.Positions.BX,"Triggered before the stop price")
  quote(e,-1,1,last+2,"BX");quote(e,-1,5,last+3,"BX");submit(e,"taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})
  assert(e.Orders[armed.Id].Triggered,"Did not latch on the reaching trade")
  e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Orders[armed.Id] and a.Positions.BX and a.Positions.BX.Quantity==2 and a.Positions.BX.Stop and a.Positions.BX.Target,"Stop did not become a protected market entry")
  assert(a.Triggers[1].Id==armed.Id and a.Triggers[1].Ok and a.Triggers[1].Filled==2 and #a.Triggers==1,"Trigger report")
  e:ProcessStops();assert(#a.Triggers==1,"Reported twice")
  local s=request(-1,1,a.Positions.BX.Entry-20,"BX");s.Type="Stop";submit(e,a.Id,s)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("A triggered stop waits for executable liquidity and never fabricates a fill",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,10000,.99,false);local last=Config.Contracts.BX.Last
  local r=request(1,2,last+2,"BX");r.Type="Stop";local armed=submit(e,a.Id,r)
  quote(e,-1,1,last+2,"BX");submit(e,"taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})
  e:ProcessStops();assert(e.Orders[armed.Id]and not a.Positions.BX,"Empty book fabricated a fill")
  quote(e,-1,2,last+2.25,"BX");e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Orders[armed.Id]and a.Positions.BX.Quantity==2 and a.Triggers[1].Filled==2)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Triggered stops re-validate the balance-based cap after closed losses",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);e:AddAccount("taker",1e9,10000,.99,false);local last=Config.Contracts.BX.Last
  a.Balance=10000;a.Realized=10000-a.Base
  local r=request(1,8,last+2,"BX");r.Type="Stop";local armed=submit(e,a.Id,r)
  -- Closed losses elsewhere reduce capacity while the stop waits.
  a.Balance=5000;a.Realized=5000-a.Base
  quote(e,-1,10,last+2,"BX");submit(e,"taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Orders[armed.Id] and not a.Positions.BX,"Stop filled past the contract limit")
  assert(a.Triggers[1].Ok==false and tostring(a.Triggers[1].Message):find("Maximum currently available: 5 BX",1,true),"Rejection not reported: "..tostring(a.Triggers[1].Message))
  e:CancelAll("maker");local r2=request(1,4,last+4,"BX");r2.Type="Stop";local second=submit(e,a.Id,r2)
  a.Balance=1000;a.Realized=1000-a.Base -- the five-contract minimum remains
  quote(e,-1,10,last+4,"BX");submit(e,"taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Orders[second.Id] and a.Positions.BX and a.Positions.BX.Quantity==4 and a.Triggers[1].Ok,"Low balance blocked a stop within the limit")
  a.Balance=a.Base;a.Realized=0;e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Armed stops survive a checkpoint round trip off-book and still trigger",function()
  local e=E.new(Config,3131);local population=P.new(e);for _=1,120 do population:Step() end
  local f=F.new(e,Ladder,Config);f:Start("stops");local id=f:Owner("stops")
  local last=e.Books.BX.Last*e.Books.BX.Spec.Tick
  local r=request(1,2,last+50,"BX");r.Type="Stop";local armed=submit(e,id,r)
  local snapshot=Checkpoint.Capture(e,population);assert(snapshot.Version==Checkpoint.Version)
  local restored,rp=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot)),Config)
  local o=restored.Orders[armed.Id];assert(o and o.Type=="Stop" and restored.Accounts[id].OpenOrders[armed.Id],"Stop lost on restore")
  for _,side in ipairs({"Bids","Asks"})do for _,l in ipairs(restored.Books.BX[side])do for _,x in ipairs(l.Orders)do assert(x.Id~=armed.Id,"Stop rested in the book")end end end
  restored:AddAccount("t:maker",1e9,10000,.99,false);restored:AddAccount("t:taker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
  for _,aid in ipairs(restored.AccountOrder)do if not restored.Accounts[aid].Player then restored:CancelAll(aid)end end
  restored:ProcessStops() -- flush any participant exits carried in the checkpoint
  local top=o.Price*restored.Books.BX.Spec.Tick
  restored.Books.BX.FairReference=o.Price -- This fixture moves fair value to the stop, not just the last trade.
  submit(restored,"t:maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1000,Type="Limit",Price=top})
  submit(restored,"t:taker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});restored:ProcessStops()
  assert(not restored.Orders[armed.Id] and restored.Accounts[id].Positions.BX and restored.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Quantity==2,"Restored stop did not trigger")
  restored:Audit()
 end)
 test("Waiting player limits execute against incoming quantity and re-check capacity",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);local r=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5,20480))
  a.Balance=1000;a.Realized=-4000;quote(e,-1,5,20480)
  assert(a.Positions.BT.Quantity==5 and a.Positions.BT.Entry==20480 and not e.Orders[r.Id])
  assert(Liquidity.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="Close",Contract="BT"}))
  a.Balance=10000;a.Realized=10000-a.Base
  local second=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,8,20470));a.Balance=5000;a.Realized=5000-a.Base
  quote(e,-1,8,20470);assert(not a.Positions.BT and not e.Orders[second.Id],"Waiting entry filled past the cap")
  a.Balance=a.Base;a.Realized=0;e:Audit()
 end)
 test("A marketable player limit consumes finite liquidity and rests its residual",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1]);quote(e,-1,2,20485.5)
  local r=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,5,20486))
  assert(r.Filled==2 and r.Remaining==3 and r.Average==20485.5)
  assert(#e.Books.BT.Asks==0 and e.Books.BT.Bids[1].Quantity==3 and #e.Trades==1)
  rejected(e,a,request(1,1),0);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Invalid, fractional, infinite and oversized remote quantities are rejected",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1])
  for _,n in ipairs({0,-1,1.5,math.huge,0/0})do assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,request(1,n)))end
  rejected(e,a,request(1,101),5);rejected(e,a,request(-1,1000),5)
 end)
 test("Saved old margins/caps adopt current policy without changing player progress or exposure",function()
  local old=clone(Config);old.Contracts.BT.Margin=2000;old.MaxPlayerInventory=40;old.MaxPlayerQuantity=20
  local e=E.new(old,592);local population=P.new(e);local f=F.new(e,Ladder,old);f:Start("migration")
  local profile=e.Profiles.migration
  local id=f:Owner("migration")
  local a=e.Accounts[id];a.Limit=40
  e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,10000,.99,false);quote(e,-1,1);submit(e,id,request(1,1))
  submit(e,id,request(1,1,20480))
  a.Limit=40 -- model the stale value persisted by the previous build
  local snapshot=Checkpoint.Capture(e,population)
  local restored=Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,Config);F.new(restored,Ladder,Config)
  local after=restored.Accounts[id]
  assert(after.Balance==a.Balance and after.Realized==a.Realized and #after.History==#a.History)
  assert(after.Positions.BT.Entry==a.Positions.BT.Entry and after.Positions.BT.Quantity==1)
  assert(after.Positions.BT.Stop==a.Positions.BT.Stop and next(after.OpenOrders))
  assert(after.Limit==10 and restored.Books.BT.Spec.Margin==750)
  assert(restored.Profiles.migration.ProgressCredit==profile.ProgressCredit)
  assert(snapshot.Config.Contracts.BT.Margin==2000 and a.Limit==40,"Restore mutated source checkpoint")
 end)
 test("Closed balance determines capacity at every $1K boundary, with a minimum of five",function()
  local e,a=fresh(Ladder.Tiers[1])
  for _,pair in ipairs({{1,5},{999,5},{4999.99,5},{5000,5},{5999.99,5},{6000,6},{9999.99,9},{10000,10},{10999.99,10},{11000,11},{49999.99,49},{50000,50},{100000,100},{101000,101},{250000,250},{9999.999999999998,10}})do
   a.Balance=pair[1];a.Realized=a.Balance-a.Base;a.Limit=5 -- stale saved cap must not win
   for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
    assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,key,side)==pair[2],"Incorrect limit for balance "..pair[1])
   end end
   local s=e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",false)
   assert(s.Limit==pair[2] and s.Capacity.BX.Buy==pair[2] and a.Limit==pair[2],"Snapshot and cached limit disagree")
  end
 end)
 for _,balance in ipairs({10000,50000,101000,250000})do for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
  test("$"..balance.." allows "..(balance/1000).." "..key.." contracts on side "..side,function()
   local e,a=fresh({Size=balance,MaxContracts=5});local limit=balance/1000

   assert(e.TotalVolume==limit and e.Books[key].Last==math.round(Config.Contracts[key].Last/Config.Contracts[key].Tick),"Player fill must print exactly its executed quantity")
   assert(submit(e,a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=-side,Quantity=limit,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}).Filled==limit,"Large positions can still close in full")
   e:Audit()
  end)
 end end end
 test("Realized profit/loss changes the cap immediately; open P&L does not",function()
  local e,a=fresh({Size=10000,MaxContracts=5});local b=e.Books.BX
  submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})
  local entry=a.Positions.BX.Entry
  b.Last=math.round((entry+1000/b.Spec.Multiplier)/b.Spec.Tick)
  assert(e:Summary(a).Equity==11000 and e:ContractLimit(a)==10,"Open profit increased cap")
  submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
  assert(a.Balance==11000 and a.Limit==11 and e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",false).Limit==11)
  submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})
  b.Last-=2000/(b.Spec.Multiplier*b.Spec.Tick)
  submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
  assert(a.Balance==9000 and a.Limit==9,"Closed loss did not reduce the cap immediately")
  submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=9,Type="Market"})
  -- Simulate a closed loss elsewhere while an existing position is above the new cap.
  a.Balance=5000;a.Realized=5000-a.Base
  assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BX",1)==0,"Loss must block additional exposure")
  assert(submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=9,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}).Filled==9,"A lower cap blocked closing an existing position")
 end)
 test("$50K reservations are shared across markets and are released on cancel",function()
  local e,a=fresh({Size=50000,MaxContracts=5})
  submit(e,a.Id,request(1,20,nil,"BX"))
  local waiting=submit(e,a.Id,request(1,15,Config.Contracts.BT.Last-10,"BT"))
  assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BG",1)==15)
  rejected(e,a,request(1,16,nil,"BG"),15,"limit")
  assert(e:Cancel(a.Id,waiting.Id));assert(e:OrderCapacity(a,"BG",1)==30)
 end)
 return results
end
return T

-- Reply queue and empty-book pricing regressions. Disposable engines only.
local Tests={}
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Settings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local ReplyBuffer=require(script.Parent.ReplyBuffer)
local function clone(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=clone(x) end return r end
local function equal(a,b,label) assert(a==b,(label or "value")..": "..tostring(a).." ~= "..tostring(b)) end
local function exchange(l,uid,options)
 local c=clone(C);c.WarmupSeconds=0
 local e=E.new(c,4821);local f=F.new(e,l or L,c,options)
 if uid then assert(f:Start(uid)) end
 return e,f
end

function Tests.Run()
 local report={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,value=pcall(fn);table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (value or "Passed") or tostring(value)})end
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ F3 replies
 test("F3: reply queues stay bounded by count and age for clients that never subscribe",function()
  local buffer=ReplyBuffer.new(Settings.MaxQueuedReplies,Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds)
  local state={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}};local now=0
  for i=1,10000 do
   now+=1/6 -- the remote limiter's sustained rate
   local kind=i%3==0 and {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Exchange busy. Please retry."} or i%3==1 and {RequestId=i,Ok=true,Message="Saved.",Kind="Start"} or {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Rejected"}
   buffer:Push(state,kind,now)
   assert(#state.Replies<=Settings.MaxQueuedReplies and #state.ReplyTimes==#state.Replies,"reply queue exceeded its bound")
  end
  equal(#state.Replies,Settings.MaxQueuedReplies);assert(state.Full and state.DroppedReplies==10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies)
  equal(state.Replies[#state.Replies].RequestId,10000,"newest reply kept");equal(state.Replies[1].RequestId,10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies+1)
  local queued,dropped=buffer:Take(state);equal(#queued,Settings.MaxQueuedReplies);equal(dropped,10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies)
  equal(#state.Replies,0);equal(state.DroppedReplies,nil)
  -- Age bound: idle connections release everything after ReplyMaxAgeSeconds.
  state.Full=false
  for i=1,5 do buffer:Push(state,{RequestId=i,Ok=true},now) end
  buffer:Prune(state,now+Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds);equal(#state.Replies,5,"not yet expired")
  buffer:Prune(state,now+Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds+0.01);equal(#state.Replies,0);assert(state.Full,"expiry forces a full resync")
  local _,expired=buffer:Take(state);equal(expired,5)
  -- A normally subscribed client (flushed every broadcast) never loses a reply.
  local live={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}}
  for i=1,200 do buffer:Push(live,{RequestId=i},i*0.1);if i%1==0 then local got,lost=buffer:Take(live);equal(#got,1);equal(lost,nil) end end
 end)

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ S1 pricing
 test("S1: missing liquidity never fabricates fills, balances, or round-trip profit",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,f=exchange(nil,"q1");e:AddAccount("maker",1000000,500,.8,false)
   local id=f:Owner("q1");local b=e.Books.BX;local tick=b.Spec.Tick;local last=b.Last or b.Reference
   assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=10,Type="Limit",Price=(last+side)*tick}))
   local start=e.Accounts[id].Balance
   for _=1,10 do
    local ok,fill=F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=5,Type="Market"})
    assert(ok and fill.Filled==0 and fill.Cancelled==5 and not e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX)
    assert(not F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"}))
   end
   assert(e.Accounts[id].Balance==start and e.TotalVolume==0 and not e.Accounts[E.HouseId])
   local ok,rest=F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=last*tick})
   assert(ok and rest.Filled==0 and rest.Remaining==1);e:Cancel(id,rest.Id);e:Audit()
  end
  local e,f=exchange(nil,"depletion");local id=f:Owner("depletion");local b=e.Books.BX
  e:AddAccount("maker",1e9,10000,.99,false)
  assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=2,Type="Limit",Price=6000}))
  assert(F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=2,Type="Market"}))
  b.Last=math.round(5900/b.Spec.Tick);e:AdvanceClock(.25)
  assert(e.Accounts[id].Locked and e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Triggered=="Account depleted")
  assert(e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Quantity==2,"Empty book fabricated a liquidation")
  assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=2,Type="Limit",Price=5900}))
  e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(not e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX);e:Audit()
  local e2,f2=exchange(nil,"spread");local id2=f2:Owner("spread");local b2=e2.Books.BX;local ref=b2.Reference
  for i,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   e2:AddAccount("maker"..i,1e9,10000,.99,false)
   assert(e2:Submit("maker"..i,{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=5,Type="Limit",Price=(ref-side*2)*b2.Spec.Tick}))
  end
  local _,buy=F.Perform(e2,id2,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"})
  local _,sell=F.Perform(e2,id2,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"})
  equal(buy.Average,(ref+2)*b2.Spec.Tick);equal(sell.Average,(ref-2)*b2.Spec.Tick)
  assert(e2.Accounts[id2].Balance<e2.Accounts[id2].Base);e2:Audit()
 end)

 return report
end
return Tests

-- Authoritative lifetime trading statistics, stored on each player account inside the exchange checkpoint.
-- A "completed trade" is one closing execution: exactly one row of the account's Trade History. A partial
-- close records the contracts it closed; the rest count when they close. A reversal counts its closing part.
-- Counters are updated by MarketEngine on the same execution that changes Balance/Realized, so they save and
-- restore atomically with the ledger. Display history is bounded (MaxAccountHistory); these counters are not.
local Stats={Version=1,EvenCents=0}
local EPS=0.005 -- half a cent: reconciliation tolerance for floating-point P&L

-- Calendar days are [00:00:00, 24:00:00) UTC, from the server's close timestamp.
-- Simulation HH:MM:SS is deliberately never treated as a historical calendar date.
local function dayRow()
 return {Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0}
end
function Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local stamp=row.ClosedAt
 if type(stamp)=="number" and stamp==stamp and stamp>0 and stamp<1e12 then
  local key=tostring(math.floor(stamp/86400))
  local d=s.Days[key] or dayRow() s.Days[key]=d
  local pnl=row.Pnl or 0 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
  d.Trades+=1 d.Net+=pnl
  if cents>0 then d.Wins+=1 elseif cents<0 then d.Losses+=1 else d.Even+=1 end
  if pnl>0 then d.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then d.Loss-=pnl end
  d.Best=math.max(d.Best or pnl,pnl) d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or pnl,pnl)
  s.FirstClosedAt=math.min(s.FirstClosedAt or stamp,stamp)
 end
 s.DayLastTradeId=math.max(s.DayLastTradeId or 0,row.TradeId or 0)
end
function Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 if s.DayV~=1 then s.DayV=1 s.Days={} s.DayLastTradeId=0 end
 -- Also repairs dates retained after an older server updated lifetime counters but not days.
 local last=s.DayLastTradeId or 0
 for i=#(rows or {}),1,-1 do local row=rows[i]
  if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>last and row.TradeId<=(s.LastTradeId or 0) then Stats.TrackDay(s,row) end
 end
end

function Stats.New(origin,now)
 return {V=Stats.Version,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Best=nil,Worst=nil,LastTradeId=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Origin=origin or "Live",Since=now,DayV=1,Days={},DayLastTradeId=0}
end
-- Classify by the cent: a result that rounds to $0.00 is break-even. Sums use the exact values so that
-- Gains - Loss equals the ledger's realized total.
function Stats.Add(s,row)
 Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local pnl=row.Pnl or 0
 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
 s.Trades+=1
 if cents>Stats.EvenCents then s.Wins+=1 elseif cents<-Stats.EvenCents then s.Losses+=1 else s.Even+=1 end
 if pnl>0 then s.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then s.Loss-=pnl end
 if s.Best==nil or pnl>s.Best then s.Best=pnl end
 if s.Worst==nil or pnl<s.Worst then s.Worst=pnl end
 if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>s.LastTradeId then s.LastTradeId=row.TradeId end
end
function Stats.Tracked(s) return s.Gains-s.Loss end

-- Depletion is recorded per attempt, once. New executions set Depleted when the engine latches Locked at
-- $0 equity. Saved attempts from before this marker existed are classified from their final state.
function Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 -- An archive record aggregates many finished attempts; each was classified before it was folded.
 if a.Archive or a.MigrationArchived or a.Depleted or a.Breached or not a.Locked or not a.Player then return end
 local equity=engine:Summary(a).Equity
 -- Checkpoint v3 reopened every positive-equity account that older loss rules had locked, so a current
 -- (not retired) locked account is depleted. A retired attempt still holding most of its capital was
 -- restarted under the earlier loss-limit rules and is reported separately, not as blown.
 if equity<=0 or not a.Retired or a.Balance<=a.Base*0.5 then a.Depleted=true
 else a.Breached="Earlier loss limit" end
end

-- Idempotent migration + drift repair. Safe to call on every restore.
--  * Accounts without Stats are rebuilt from their saved Trade History. When the rows reconcile with the
--    ledger (realized total, and the completed-trade counter when present) and the history was never trimmed,
--    the rebuild is complete ("Recovered"). Otherwise the unmatched part is kept as an untracked remainder
--    ("Partial") so Net realized still equals the ledger, and the UI labels the breakdown period.
--  * Accounts with Stats pick up any retained rows newer than LastTradeId (e.g. written by an older server
--    build), and any remaining mismatch is moved into the untracked remainder. Nothing is ever counted twice.
function Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,now)
 if not a.Player then return nil end
 local max=engine.Config.MaxAccountHistory or 60
 local rows=a.History or {}
 local s=a.Stats local fresh=type(s)~="table" or s.V~=Stats.Version
 if fresh then s=Stats.New("Recovered",now) a.Stats=s end
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 -- History is newest first. Skip the scan when the newest row is already counted.
 local newest=rows[1]
 if fresh or (newest and type(newest.TradeId)=="number" and newest.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then
  for i=#rows,1,-1 do
   local h=rows[i]
   if fresh or (type(h.TradeId)=="number" and h.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then Stats.Add(s,h) end
  end
 end
 local gap=a.Realized-(Stats.Tracked(s)+s.UntrackedNet)
 local ledger=a.CompletedTrades
 if fresh then
  local trimmed=#rows>=max
  local countKnown=(ledger==nil and not trimmed) or ledger==s.Trades
  if math.abs(gap)<EPS and countKnown then
   s.Origin=#rows>0 and "Recovered" or "Live"
   -- The completed-trade counter predates some saves; a complete rebuild makes it exact.
   if ledger==nil and s.Trades>0 then a.CompletedTrades=s.Trades end
  else
   s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=now
   s.UntrackedNet=gap
   s.UntrackedTrades=math.max(0,(ledger or #rows)-s.Trades)
   -- A counter that started from an already-trimmed history can itself undercount. Say so.
   s.CountUnknown=trimmed and ledger~=s.Trades
  end
 else
  if math.abs(gap)>=EPS then s.UntrackedNet+=gap s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
  local counted=s.Trades+s.UntrackedTrades
  if ledger and ledger>counted then s.UntrackedTrades+=ledger-counted s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
 end
 Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 return s
end

-- Folds one finished attempt's lifetime counters into an archive record. Every field is additive or an
-- extreme (best/worst, first/last), so the archive reports exactly what the separate attempts reported.
function Stats.Merge(into,s)
 Stats.EnsureDays(into) Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do into[k]+=s[k] or 0 end
 if s.Best~=nil and (into.Best==nil or s.Best>into.Best) then into.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (into.Worst==nil or s.Worst<into.Worst) then into.Worst=s.Worst end
 into.LastTradeId=math.max(into.LastTradeId or 0,s.LastTradeId or 0)
 into.DayLastTradeId=math.max(into.DayLastTradeId or 0,s.DayLastTradeId or 0)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=into.Days[key] or dayRow() into.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then into.FirstClosedAt=math.min(into.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if s.Since then into.Since=math.min(into.Since or s.Since,s.Since) end
 into.CountUnknown=into.CountUnknown==true or s.CountUnknown==true
 into.RecoveredAny=into.RecoveredAny or s.RecoveredAny or s.Origin=="Recovered" or nil
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  into.Origin="Partial"
  if s.PartialSince then into.PartialSince=math.min(into.PartialSince or s.PartialSince,s.PartialSince) end
 elseif into.Origin~="Partial" and into.RecoveredAny then into.Origin="Recovered" end
 return into
end
-- Aggregation used by every Stats scope. Open P&L comes from the live engine summary of open positions.
function Stats.Empty()
 return {Attempts=0,Blown=0,Breached=0,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0,Open=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Partial=false,Recovered=false,Since=nil,Days={}}
end
function Stats.Include(agg,engine,a)
 local s=a.Stats or Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,os.time())
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,a.History)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=agg.Days[key] or dayRow() agg.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then agg.FirstClosedAt=math.min(agg.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if a.Archive then
  -- Folded finished attempts keep their own attempt/blown/breached classification.
  agg.Attempts+=a.Archive.Attempts agg.Blown+=a.Archive.Blown agg.Breached+=a.Archive.Breached
 else
  agg.Attempts+=1
  if a.Depleted then agg.Blown+=1 elseif a.Breached then agg.Breached+=1 end
 end
 if s.RecoveredAny then agg.Recovered=true end
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do agg[k]+=s[k] end
 agg.Net+=a.Realized
 if not a.Retired then agg.Open+=engine:Summary(a).Unrealized end
 if s.Best~=nil and (agg.Best==nil or s.Best>agg.Best) then agg.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (agg.Worst==nil or s.Worst<agg.Worst) then agg.Worst=s.Worst end
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  agg.Partial=true agg.CountUnknown=agg.CountUnknown or s.CountUnknown
  if s.PartialSince and (agg.Since==nil or s.PartialSince<agg.Since) then agg.Since=s.PartialSince end
 elseif s.Origin=="Recovered" then agg.Recovered=true end
 return agg
end
-- Derived values, computed once on the server so every client shows the same numbers.
function Stats.Finish(agg,datedOnly)
 if math.abs(agg.UntrackedNet)<EPS then agg.UntrackedNet=0 end
 agg.Total=agg.Net+agg.Open
 agg.WinRate=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Wins/agg.Trades or nil
 agg.AllTrades=agg.Trades+agg.UntrackedTrades
 if not agg.CountUnknown and agg.AllTrades>0 then agg.Average=agg.Net/agg.AllTrades agg.AverageScope="All"
 elseif agg.Trades>0 then agg.Average=(agg.Gains-agg.Loss)/agg.Trades agg.AverageScope="Tracked" end
 agg.AvgWin=agg.Wins>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Wins or nil
 agg.AvgLoss=agg.Losses>0 and agg.Loss/agg.Losses or nil
 agg.WinLossRatio=agg.AvgLoss and agg.AvgLoss>0 and (agg.AvgWin or 0)/agg.AvgLoss or nil
 agg.ProfitFactor=agg.Loss>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Loss or nil
 agg.NoLosses=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Gains>0 and agg.Loss==0
 local dated=Stats.Empty() local days,wins,lossDays,dayTrades,best=0,0,0,0,nil
 for _,day in pairs(agg.Days or {}) do
  days+=1 dayTrades+=day.Trades
  if math.round(day.Net*100)>0 then wins+=1 end
  if math.round(day.Net*100)<0 then lossDays+=1 end
  best=math.max(best or day.Net,day.Net)
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do dated[k]+=day[k] end
 end
 agg.UndatedTrades=math.max(0,agg.AllTrades-dayTrades)
 agg.DayCount=days agg.WinningDays=wins agg.LosingDays=lossDays agg.BestDay=best
 agg.DailyComplete=agg.UndatedTrades==0 and not agg.CountUnknown and not agg.Partial
 agg.DayWinRate=agg.DailyComplete and days>0 and wins/days or nil
 agg.BestDayShare=agg.DailyComplete and best and best>0 and agg.Net>=EPS and best/agg.Net or nil
 if not datedOnly then
  dated.Days=agg.Days dated.FirstClosedAt=agg.FirstClosedAt
  dated.Attempts=agg.Attempts dated.Blown=agg.Blown dated.Breached=agg.Breached
  agg.Dated=Stats.Finish(dated,true)
 end
 -- Day buckets remain on the saved account; only compact derived results cross the network.
 agg.Days=nil
 return agg
end
return Stats
