local Liquidity=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
-- Isolated regression checks: no live accounts, DataStores or remotes.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Protection=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.TradeProtection)
return function()
 local n=0
 local function check(ok,msg)n+=1;assert(ok,msg)end
 for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder)do
  local spec=Config.Contracts[key]
  for _,qty in ipairs({1,3,5})do
   local amount=127.39
   for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
    for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
     local p=Protection.Resolve(spec,qty,amount,spec.Last,side,field)
     check(p and math.abs(p.Price/spec.Tick-math.round(p.Price/spec.Tick))<1e-6,"tick-aligned "..key)
     check(math.abs(p.Dollars-amount)<=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*qty/2+.001 or p.Ticks==1,"nearest valid total")
     check((p.Price-spec.Last)*side*(field=="Stop"and -1 or 1)>0,"correct protection side")
    end
   end
  end
 end
 for _,bad in ipairs({0,-1,math.huge,0/0})do check(not Protection.Resolve(Config.Contracts.BX,1,bad),"invalid dollars")end
 local e=E.new(Config,41)
 local a=e:AddAccount("test",100000,100,.8,true)
 e:AddAccount("other",100000,100,.8,true)
 local spec=Config.Contracts.BX local price=spec.Last-20
 local ok,r=Liquidity.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=3,Type="Limit",Price=price,StopDollars=100,TargetDollars=200})
 check(ok,"place dollar-protected limit")
 local id=r.Id local o=e.Orders[id]
 check(o.StopTicks==3 and o.TargetTicks==5,"server converts totals using quantity")
 local function req(p,expected,qty)return {Action="AmendOrder",Contract="BX",OrderId=id,Price=p,ExpectedPrice=expected or price,ExpectedQuantity=qty or 3}end
 local function reject(owner,r)
  local old=o.Price local accepted=F.Perform(e,owner,r)
  check(not accepted and o.Price==old and e.Orders[id]==o,"rejection is atomic")
 end
 reject("other",req(price+1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+.1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,price+2))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,nil,2))
 reject(a.Id,req(spec.Last*2))
 a.Locked=true;reject(a.Id,req(price+1));a.Locked=false
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(price+1)),"accepted amendment")
 check(o.Price*spec.Tick==price+1 and o.Id==id and o.Remaining==3 and o.StopTicks==3,"preserves identity, quantity, protection")
 price+=1
 Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",-1,3,spec.Last)
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(spec.Last+10)),"marketable amendment accepted")
 check(not e.Orders[id] and a.Positions.BX.Quantity==3,"marketable amendment fills normally")
 local p=a.Positions.BX
 check(math.abs((p.Entry-p.Stop)*spec.Multiplier*3-112.5)<.001,"chart stop reflects effective total")
 check(math.abs((p.Target-p.Entry)*spec.Multiplier*3-187.5)<.001,"chart target reflects effective total")
 check(not F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(price)),"filled order cannot be amended")
 local accepted,v=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=spec.Last+30})
 check(accepted and e:Cancel(a.Id,v.Id) and not e.Orders[v.Id],"cancel exact pending order")
 check(a.Positions.BX.Quantity==3,"cancel leaves position intact")
 check(not e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=100,StopTicks=10}),"reject ambiguous units")
 -- A hand-moved SL/TP keeps its exact price when the position grows; it still protects the whole position.
 local held,book=a.Positions.BX,e.Books.BX
 book.Last=book.Reference+8 -- the add fills 2 points higher, so the average entry moves
 local movedStop,movedTarget=held.Stop-1.25,held.Target+2.5

 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="AmendProtection",Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection="Target",Price=movedTarget,ExpectedPrice=held.Target}),"move TP")
 local entry=held.Entry

 check(held.Stop==movedStop and held.Target==movedTarget,"moved SL/TP keep their exact prices after adding")
 local covered=0
 for _,o in ipairs(e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",false).Orders)do if o.Protection and o.Id==held.Id and o.Quantity==5 then covered+=1 end end
 check(covered==2,"SL and TP cover the updated quantity")
 check(e:CancelProtection(a.Id,held.Id,"Stop") and not held.Stop and not held.ManualStop,"cancelling a moved SL clears its manual flag")
 -- Ticket-created protection also keeps its original price when the average entry changes.
 check(Liquidity.Perform(e,"other",{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=100}),"other opens")
 local q=e.Accounts.other.Positions.BX local first=q.Stop
 book.Last=book.Reference+16
 check(Liquidity.Perform(e,"other",{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=100}),"other adds")

 e:Audit()
 return {Passed=true,Cases=n}
end

-- Server-only command policy. Dependencies keep security and lookup tests off real profiles.
local Command={} Command.__index=Command
function Command.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string" or #text>80 then return nil end
 local alias,name=text:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+@?([%w_]+)%s*$")
 if not alias or alias:lower()~="/reset" or #name<3 or #name>20 then return nil end
 return name
end
function Command.IsOwner(userId,creatorType,creatorId,groupLookup)
 if type(userId)~="number" or userId<=0 or creatorId<=0 then return false end
 if creatorType==Enum.CreatorType.User then return userId==creatorId end
 if creatorType~=Enum.CreatorType.Group then return false end
 local ok,info=pcall(groupLookup,creatorId)
 return ok and type(info)=="table" and type(info.Owner)=="table" and info.Owner.Id==userId
end
function Command.new(options)
 return setmetatable({Options=options,Busy=false,LastAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})},Command)
end
function Command:Handle(player,text)
 local o=self.Options local now=(o.Now or os.clock)()
 if now-(self.LastAt[player] or -math.huge)<2 then return end
 self.LastAt[player]=now
 if not Command.IsOwner(player.UserId,o.CreatorType,o.CreatorId,o.GroupLookup)then
  o.Notify(player,"Only the experience owner can use /reset.");return
 end
 local name=Command.Parse(text)
 if not name then o.Notify(player,"Usage: /reset <exact Roblox username>");return end
 if self.Busy then o.Notify(player,"A reset is already in progress. Please wait.");return end
 if not o.Ready()then o.Notify(player,"The saved exchange is busy or unavailable. Try /reset again shortly.");return end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local found,uid,canonical=pcall(o.Resolve,name)
  if not found or type(uid)~="number" or uid<=0 or type(canonical)~="string" or canonical:lower()~=name:lower()then
   o.Notify(player,"Username not found. Use the exact current Roblox username, not a display name.");return
  end
  o.Notify(player,"Resetting @"..canonical.."...")
  local saved,message=o.Reset(uid,canonical)
  o.Notify(player,message)
  if saved and o.AfterReset then o.AfterReset(uid)end
 end)
 self.Busy=false
 if not ok then
  warn("[Get Funded!] Owner reset failed: "..tostring(err))
  o.Notify(player,"Reset could not be confirmed. Wait for the saved exchange to recover, then check the player before retrying.")
 end
end
return Command

 if type(a)~="table"then assert(a==b,tostring(a).." ~= "..tostring(b));return end
 for k,v in pairs(a)do same(v,b[k])end;for k in pairs(b)do assert(a[k]~=nil,"Added "..tostring(k))end

 local e=E.new(C,412);local f=F.new(e,L,C);f:Join("101");f:Join("102")

local function trade(e,id,pnl)
 for _,owner in ipairs(e.AccountOrder)do e:CancelAll(owner,"BX")end -- Do not orphan live reserve orders when replacing this fixture's book.
 local b=e.Books.BX;b.Last=24000;b.Reference=24000;b.Bids={};b.Asks={}
 b.FairReference=b.Last
 Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",-1,100,b.Last*b.Spec.Tick) -- Preserve depth around the one-contract accounting fixture.

 e:CancelAll("fixture:liquidity:BX:-1","BX")
 b.Last+=pnl/(b.Spec.Multiplier*b.Spec.Tick)
 b.FairReference=b.Last;Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",1,100,b.Last*b.Spec.Tick)
 assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}))

local function store()
 local s={}
 function s:UpdateAsync(_,callback)
  if self.BeforeWrite then self.BeforeWrite()end
  if self.Fail then error("Injected write failure")end
  local v=callback(clone(self.Value));if v then self.Value=clone(v)end
  if self.LostReply then error("Injected lost commit response")end
  return clone(v)
 end
 function s:GetAsync()return clone(self.Value)end
 return s
end

end
local function clean(e,uid)

 assert(a.Balance==10000 and a.Realized==0 and a.CashFlow==0 and a.Base==10000)

 assert(#a.History==0 and #a.Fills==0 and not next(a.Positions)and not next(a.OpenOrders))
 assert(#p.Ledger==1 and #p.Titles==0 and not next(p.Awards)and #p.RunHistory==0)

function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,detail=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and(detail or "Passed")or tostring(detail)})end
 test("Exact username parser rejects multi-target and malformed commands",function()

 end)

  local cmd=Command.new({CreatorType=Enum.CreatorType.User,CreatorId=7,Now=function()return now end,Ready=function()return true end,

 test("Saved reset removes titles, rank, all histories, preferences and counters",function()
  local e,f=fresh();trade(e,f:Owner("101"),25000)

 test("Open positions, armed stops and working limits settle without moving the market or another player",function()
  local e,f=fresh();trade(e,f:Owner("102"),500);local otherId=f:Owner("102")

   local id=f:Owner("101");assert(not seen[id]);seen[id]=true;trade(e,id,500);f:ResetPlayer("101")

 test("Transaction saves new profile and projection before replacing the live engine",function()
  local w,s=world();local original=w.Engine;local other=clone(original.Profiles["102"])
  s.BeforeWrite=function()assert(w.Engine==original and not w:CanRun()and w.Busy)end
  assert(w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):ResetPlayer("101")end))
  assert(w.Engine~=original and w:CanRun()and not w.Busy);clean(w.Engine,"101");same(w.Engine.Profiles["102"],other)
  local restored=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(s.Value.Checkpoint),w.Config);clean(restored,"101")

 test("Validation failure keeps the original engine and saved record intact",function()

 test("Write failure pauses and reloads durable data without overwriting it",function()
  local w,s=world();local record=clone(s.Value);s.Fail=true
  assert(not w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):ResetPlayer("101")end))
  assert(not w.Engine and not w:CanRun()and w.Mode=="Unavailable");same(s.Value,record)
  assert(not w:Save(false));s.Fail=false;w:Open();assert(w:CanRun())
  assert(F.new(w.Engine,L,C):Earned(w.Engine.Profiles["101"])==500)
 end)
 test("Lost commit response recovers the saved wipe instead of restoring old progress",function()
  local w,s=world();s.LostReply=true
  assert(not w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):ResetPlayer("101")end))
  assert(not w:CanRun()and not w.Engine);s.LostReply=false;w:Open();assert(w:CanRun());clean(w.Engine,"101")
 end)
 test("Busy, follower and unsaved worlds reject resets before mutation",function()
  local w=world();local function unexpected()error("Must not mutate")end
  w.Busy=true;assert(not w:TransformSaved(unexpected));w.Busy=false
  w.Mode="Following";assert(not w:TransformSaved(unexpected));w.Mode="Local";assert(not w:TransformSaved(unexpected))
 end)
 test("Leaderboard drops wiped scores immediately and persists the newer projection",function()
  local w=world();local s=store();local lb=Leaderboards.new({Store=s,Now=function()return 1000 end})
  lb:Queue(w.DurableProjection);assert(lb:Flush()and #s.Value.Rows==1)
  assert(w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):ResetPlayer("101")end))
  lb:UseDurableProjection(w.DurableProjection);assert(#lb.Cache.Rows==0)
  s.Fail=true;lb.NextWrite=0;assert(not lb:Flush()and #lb.Cache.Rows==0)
  s.Fail=false;lb.NextWrite=0;assert(lb:Flush()and #s.Value.Rows==0)
 end)

end
return Tests

 player.DevComputerMovementMode=Enum.DevComputerMovementMode.Scriptable

end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(add)

-- Server-only entitlement and packet boundary. Ownership is always verified by Roblox.
-- PassId=0 disables access; there is no Studio or client ownership bypass.
local Access={PassId=2006894567}
Access.__index=Access

function Access.new(passId,marketplace,clock)
 return setmetatable({PassId=passId or Access.PassId,Marketplace=marketplace or game:GetService("MarketplaceService"),Clock=clock or os.clock,Players={}},Access)
end
function Access:Configured()
 local id=self.PassId
 return type(id)=="number"and id>0 and id<math.huge and id%1==0
end
function Access:Refresh(player,force)
 if not self:Configured()then return end
 local state=self.Players[player]
 if not state then state={Allowed=false,State="Checking",NextCheck=0};self.Players[player]=state end
 if state.Busy then if force then state.Recheck=true end;return end
 if not force and self.Clock()<state.NextCheck then return end
 state.Busy=true
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,owned=pcall(self.Marketplace.UserOwnsGamePassAsync,self.Marketplace,player.UserId,self.PassId)
  if self.Players[player]~=state then return end
  state.Busy=false;state.Allowed=ok and owned==true
  state.State=not ok and "Unavailable"or state.Allowed and "Owned"or "Locked"
  state.NextCheck=self.Clock()+(ok and 120 or 15)
  if state.Recheck then state.Recheck=nil;self:Refresh(player,true)end
 end)
end
function Access:Status(player)
 if not self:Configured()then return {Allowed=false,State="Unconfigured"}end
 local state=self.Players[player]
 return {Allowed=state~=nil and state.Allowed==true,State=state and state.State or "Checking",PassId=self.PassId}
end
function Access:Apply(packet,player,contract)
 packet.DepthAccess=self:Status(player)
 for symbol,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes or{})do
  if not packet.DepthAccess.Allowed or symbol~=contract then quote.Depth=nil end
 end
end
function Access:Forget(player)self.Players[player]=nil end
return Access

local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local T={}
function T.Offer(e,key,side,qty,price)
 local id="fixture:liquidity:"..key..":"..side
 e:AddAccount(id,1e12-1,1000000,.99,false)
 local ok,result=e:Submit(id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 assert(ok,tostring(result));return result
end
function T.Ensure(e,id,r)
 local a=e.Accounts[id];local b=e.Books[r.Contract]
 if not a or not a.Player or not b or r.Type~="Market"or type(r.Quantity)~="number"or r.Quantity<1 or r.Quantity%1~=0 then return end
 if not r.ReduceOnly and (a.Locked or e:OrderCapacity(a,r.Contract,r.Direction)<r.Quantity)then return end
 local levels=r.Direction==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids;local qty=0;local ticks=b.Last or b.Reference
 for _,l in ipairs(levels)do qty+=l.Quantity;ticks=l.Price end
 if qty<r.Quantity then T.Offer(e,r.Contract,-r.Direction,r.Quantity-qty,ticks*b.Spec.Tick)end
end
function T.Submit(e,id,r,...)
 T.Ensure(e,id,r);return e:Submit(id,r,...)
end
function T.Perform(e,id,r)
 local p=e.Accounts[id]and e.Accounts[id].Positions[r.Contract]
 if r.Action=="Close"and p then T.Ensure(e,id,{Contract=r.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=p.Quantity,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
 elseif r.Action=="Place"then T.Ensure(e,id,r)end
 return F.Perform(e,id,r)
end
return T

-- Finite shared liquidity: isolated engines, no live player balances or purchase grants.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Tests={}
function Tests.Run()
 local results={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,result=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(result)})end
 local function fresh()
  local e=E.new(C,7261)
  for _,id in ipairs({"p1","p2","p3"})do e:AddAccount(id,100000,100,.9,true)end
  e:AddAccount("bot",1e9,10000,.9,false)
  e:SetConnectedOwners({p1=true,p2=true,p3=true})
  return e
 end
 local function order(e,id,side,qty,price,extra)
  local req={Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit"or "Market",Price=price}
  for k,v in pairs(extra or{})do req[k]=v end
  local ok,result=e:Submit(id,req);assert(ok,tostring(result));return result
 end
 local function book(e)return e:Snapshot("p2","BX","1m",true).Quotes.BX.Depth end
 test("Player and participant quantities aggregate anonymously and execute FIFO",function()
  local e=fresh();local first=order(e,"p1",-1,3,5825);local second=order(e,"bot",-1,4,5825)
  local depth=book(e);assert(#depth.Asks==1 and depth.Asks[1].Quantity==7 and depth.Asks[1].Price==5825)
  for k in pairs(depth.Asks[1])do assert(k=="Price"or k=="Quantity","Identity leaked")end
  order(e,"p2",1,2);assert(e.Orders[first.Id].Remaining==1 and e.Orders[second.Id].Remaining==4 and book(e).Asks[1].Quantity==5)
  order(e,"p3",1,2);assert(not e.Orders[first.Id]and e.Orders[second.Id].Remaining==3 and book(e).Asks[1].Quantity==3)
  assert(e:Cancel("bot",second.Id));assert(#book(e).Asks==0)
  assert(not e.Accounts[E.HouseId],"Live player fill used the historical house")
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Price priority and finite marketable limits leave exact residuals",function()
  local e=fresh();order(e,"p1",-1,2,5825.25);order(e,"bot",-1,2,5825)
  local r=order(e,"p2",1,6,5825);assert(r.Filled==2 and r.Remaining==4 and r.Average==5825)
  assert(book(e).Bids[1].Quantity==4 and book(e).Asks[1].Price==5825.25)
  order(e,"p3",-1,1);assert(e.Orders[r.Id].Remaining==3 and book(e).Bids[1].Quantity==3)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Empty and one-sided books never generate synthetic fills or levels",function()
  local e=fresh();local r=order(e,"p1",1,3);assert(r.Filled==0 and r.Cancelled==3 and not e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX)
  assert(#book(e).Asks==0 and #book(e).Bids==0)
  order(e,"p2",1,2,5824);assert(#book(e).Asks==0 and #book(e).Bids==1)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Repricing retains identity and protection but resets FIFO priority",function()
  local e=fresh();local a=order(e,"p1",-1,3,5826,{StopTicks=10,TargetTicks=20});local b=order(e,"p3",-1,2,5825)
  assert(e:AmendOrder("p1",{Contract="BX",OrderId=a.Id,Price=5825,ExpectedPrice=5826,ExpectedQuantity=3}))
  assert(e.Orders[a.Id].StopTicks==10 and e.Orders[a.Id].TargetTicks==20)
  local snapshot=Checkpoint.Capture(e,setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=C,Random=P.RNG.new(7261),Agents={}},P))
  local restored=Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,C);assert(restored.Books.BX.Asks[1].Orders[1].Id==b.Id)
  order(restored,"p2",1,3);assert(not restored.Orders[b.Id]and restored.Orders[a.Id].Remaining==2)
  restored:Audit()
 end)
 test("Self-trade prevention covers multiple accounts with the same owner",function()
  local e=fresh();e.Accounts.p1.Group="same";e.Accounts.p2.Group="same"
  local a=order(e,"p1",-1,3,5825);order(e,"p2",1,3)
  assert(not e.Orders[a.Id]and e.TotalVolume==0 and not e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Disconnect cancels all resting liquidity and rejects stale entries",function()
  local e=fresh();local a=order(e,"p1",-1,3,5825);order(e,"p3",1,2,5824)
  e:SetConnected("p1",false);assert(not e.Orders[a.Id]and #book(e).Asks==0 and book(e).Bids[1].Quantity==2)
  assert(not e:Submit("p1",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
  e:SetConnected("p1",true);assert(#book(e).Asks==0,"Reconnect resurrected cancelled orders")
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Invalid capacity, expired orders and untriggered stops are excluded",function()
  local e=fresh();local a=order(e,"p1",-1,10,5825);e.Accounts.p1.Balance=1000;e.Accounts.p1.Realized=-99000
  local r=order(e,"p3",1,2,5824,{Expires=e.Time+1})
  order(e,"p2",1,2,5830,{Type="Stop"})
  assert(#book(e).Asks==0 and not e.Orders[a.Id]and #book(e).Bids==1)
  e:AdvanceClock(1);assert(not e.Orders[r.Id]and #book(e).Bids==0)
  e.Accounts.p1.Balance=e.Accounts.p1.Base;e.Accounts.p1.Realized=0;e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Stop entries wait for liquidity, partially fill, then report once",function()
  local e=fresh();local r=order(e,"p1",1,3,5826,{Type="Stop",StopTicks=4,TargetTicks=8})
  order(e,"bot",-1,1,5826);order(e,"p2",1,1);e:ProcessStops()
  assert(e.Orders[r.Id]and not e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX)
  order(e,"bot",-1,1,5826.25);e:ProcessStops();assert(e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX.Quantity==1 and e.Orders[r.Id].Remaining==2)
  order(e,"p3",-1,2,5826.5);e:ProcessStops()
  assert(not e.Orders[r.Id]and e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX.Quantity==3 and #e.Accounts.p1.Triggers==1 and e.Accounts.p1.Triggers[1].Filled==3)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Stop-loss partial fills retry without reversing and preserve OCO",function()
  local e=fresh();order(e,"bot",-1,3,5825);order(e,"p1",1,3,nil,{StopTicks=4,TargetTicks=8})
  order(e,"p2",1,2,5824);order(e,"p3",-1,1);e:ProcessStops()
  local p=e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX;assert(p.Quantity==2 and p.Triggered=="Stop loss"and not p.Target)
  order(e,"p2",1,2,5823.75);e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(not e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Take-profit rests at its target and cannot fill at a worse price",function()
  local e=fresh();order(e,"bot",-1,3,5825);order(e,"p1",1,3,nil,{StopTicks=4,TargetTicks=8})
  order(e,"p2",1,1,5827);order(e,"p3",-1,1);e:ProcessStops()
  local p=e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX;assert(p and p.ExitOrder and e.Orders[p.ExitOrder].Remaining==3 and not p.Stop)
  local id=p.ExitOrder;e:AdvanceClock(.25);assert(p.ExitOrder==id and e.Orders[id],"TP lost priority during retry")
  order(e,"p2",1,2,5826.75);assert(e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX.Quantity==3)
  order(e,"p2",1,3,5827);assert(not e.Accounts.p1.Positions.BX and e.Accounts.p1.History[1].Exit==5827)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Old checkpoints cancel off-book player limits without rewriting balances or tape",function()
  local e=fresh();local r=order(e,"p1",1,3,5824)
  local state=Checkpoint.Capture(e,setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=C,Random=P.RNG.new(7261),Agents={}},P));state.Version=8
  local restored=Checkpoint.Restore(state,C)
  assert(not restored.Orders[r.Id]and restored.TotalVolume==e.TotalVolume and restored.Accounts.p1.Balance==e.Accounts.p1.Balance)
  restored:Audit()
 end)
 test("Maker quotes retain queue position and partial quantity between material changes",function()
  local e=E.new(C,42617);local bots=P.new(e);local a=bots.Agents[1]
  -- Freeze the other participants and fair value to isolate cancellation churn.
  e:CancelAll(a.Id);a.QuotePolicy=nil;bots:_maker(a)
  local ids={};for _,id in pairs(a.Quotes)do ids[id]=e.Orders[id].Remaining end
  assert(next(ids),"No maker quote")
  for _=1,5 do e.Time+=1;bots:_maker(a)end
  for id,qty in pairs(ids)do assert(e.Orders[id]and e.Orders[id].Remaining==qty,"Unchanged quote churned")end
  e:Audit()
 end)
 return results
end
return Tests

 local b=engine.Books[key];return (b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick
end
-- Use the saved return price, including for summaries created before full P&L was stored.
-- Keep the since-departure deltas for accounting, separate from the displayed trade P&L.
function Absence.WithPnl(engine,summary)
 if not summary then return nil end
 summary.Unrealized=0
 for _,row in ipairs(summary.Rows)do
  row.Unrealized=row.Remaining>0 and (row.CurrentPrice-row.Entry)*row.Remaining*row.Direction*engine.Books[row.Contract].Spec.Multiplier or 0
  summary.Unrealized+=row.Unrealized
 end
 return summary
end
function Absence.Depart(engine,p,now)
 if p.Absence then return end
 local a=engine.Accounts[p.Account];if not a then return end
 p.AbsenceSequence=(p.AbsenceSequence or 0)+1
 local absence={Id=tostring(p.Run)..":"..p.AbsenceSequence,Account=a.Id,At=now,Step=engine.Step,Time=engine.Time,Positions={}}
 for key,pos in pairs(a.Positions)do
  absence.Positions[key]={Id=pos.Id,Contract=key,Direction=pos.Direction,Entry=pos.Entry,Quantity=pos.Quantity,
   DeparturePrice=mark(engine,key),Multiplier=engine.Books[key].Spec.Multiplier,Closed=0,Realized=0,RealizedChange=0,Exits={}}
 end
 p.Absence=absence
end
function Absence.Closed(p,row)
 local absence=p.Absence
 local item=absence and absence.Positions[row.Contract]
 if not item or row.PositionId~=item.Id or row.TradeId<=(item.LastTradeId or 0)then return end
 item.LastTradeId=row.TradeId
 item.Closed+=row.Quantity;item.Realized+=row.Pnl
 item.RealizedChange+=(row.Exit-item.DeparturePrice)*row.Quantity*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
 local reason=row.Reason or "Trade"
 local exit=item.Exits[reason] or {Reason=reason,Quantity=0,Realized=0,Change=0,Notional=0}
 exit.Quantity+=row.Quantity;exit.Realized+=row.Pnl;exit.Change+=(row.Exit-item.DeparturePrice)*row.Quantity*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
 exit.Notional+=row.Exit*row.Quantity;item.Exits[reason]=exit
end
function Absence.Return(engine,p,now)
 local absence=p.Absence;if not absence then return end
 p.Absence=nil
 if absence.Account~=p.Account or not next(absence.Positions)then return end
 local a=engine.Accounts[p.Account]
 local summary={Id=absence.Id,Seconds=math.max(0,now-absence.At),MarketSeconds=math.max(0,engine.Time-absence.Time),
  Realized=0,RealizedChange=0,UnrealizedChange=0,Rows={},
  Coverage="Exits use actual exchange trades while the server runs. The market pauses when no server is running; no missing prices or outcomes are invented."}
 local ordered={};for key in pairs(absence.Positions)do table.insert(ordered,key)end;table.sort(ordered)
 for _,key in ipairs(ordered)do
  local item=absence.Positions[key];local held=a.Positions[key]
  local remaining=held and held.Id==item.Id and held.Quantity or 0
  local current=mark(engine,key)
  local delta=(current-item.DeparturePrice)*remaining*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
  local exits={};for _,exit in pairs(item.Exits)do table.insert(exits,exit)end
  table.sort(exits,function(x,y)return x.Reason<y.Reason end)
  table.insert(summary.Rows,{Contract=key,Direction=item.Direction,Quantity=item.Quantity,Remaining=remaining,
   Entry=item.Entry,DeparturePrice=item.DeparturePrice,CurrentPrice=current,Realized=item.Realized,
   RealizedChange=item.RealizedChange,UnrealizedChange=delta,Exits=exits})
  summary.Realized+=item.Realized;summary.RealizedChange+=item.RealizedChange;summary.UnrealizedChange+=delta
 end
 summary.Total=summary.RealizedChange+summary.UnrealizedChange
 summary.CarriedIn=summary.Realized-summary.RealizedChange
 p.AwaySummary=Absence.WithPnl(engine,summary)
end
function Absence.Acknowledge(p,id)
 if p.AwaySummary and p.AwaySummary.Id==id then p.AwaySummary=nil;p.LastAwaySummary=id;return true end
 return p.LastAwaySummary==id
end
return Absence

local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)

local T=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)

local Tests={}
local function fresh()
 local e=E.new(C,712);local f=F.new(e,L,C);f:Join("101");return e,f,e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
end
local function restore(e)
 local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(712),Agents={}},P)
 local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),C)
 return r,F.new(r,L,C)
end
local function open(e,a,side,qty)
 assert(T.Submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Type="Market",Quantity=qty or 1,Direction=side}))
 return a.Positions.BX
end
local function printPrice(e,price)
 local n="print:"..e.NextOrder;local b=e.Books.BX
 e:AddAccount(n,1e9,1e6,.99,false)
 T.Offer(e,"BX",-1,1,price)
 assert(e:Submit(n,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
 assert(b.Last*b.Spec.Tick==price,"Fixture did not execute the requested price")
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,err=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(err)})end
 test("Legacy earned awards receive the current permanent bonus once",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  p.Awards.FirstWin={At=1,Title="Green Spark",Goal=25};p.Awards.Trades5={At=2,Title="Tape Reader",Goal=100}
  f:Evaluate("101",true);assert(f:StartingBalance(p)==22500 and a.Balance==10000)
  for _=1,3 do f:Evaluate("101",true);f:Join("101")end
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(f:StartingBalance(p)==22500)
  assert(p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus==5000 and p.Awards.Trades5.StartingBonus==7500)
 end)
 test("Saved bonuses increase on reload, never stack or shrink, and fund the next reset",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  for _,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do p.Awards[m.Id]={At=1,Title=m.Title,Goal=m.Goal,StartingBonus=m.StartingBonus/10}end
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");a=e.Accounts[p.Account]
  local view=f:View("101");assert(view.StartingBonus==250000 and view.StartingBalance==260000)
  assert(a.Balance==10000 and f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==0)
  for i,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do assert(view.Milestones[i].Earned and view.Milestones[i].StartingBonus==m.StartingBonus)end
  local revision=p.Revision
  for _=1,3 do assert(#f:Evaluate("101",true)==0);f:Join("101")end
  assert(p.Revision==revision and f:StartingBalance(p)==260000)
  -- A later lower tuning must preserve an already-earned larger reward.
  p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus=6000
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus==6000 and f:StartingBalance(p)==261000)
  assert(f:ResetAccount("101",p.Account));assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==261000)
  assert(f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==0);e:Audit()
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==261000 and f:StartingBalance(p)==261000);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Reset clears both directions and pending stops without trades, P&L or milestone progress",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101");local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   held.Stop=held.Entry-side*2;held.Target=held.Entry+side*4
   assert(e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BT",Type="Limit",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Price=C.Contracts.BT.Last-100}))
   table.insert(e.PendingStops,{Owner=a.Id,Contract="BX",Position=held.Id})
   f:Depart("101",100);local id=a.Id;local trades=e.NextTrade
   local stats=f:Stats("101");assert(f:ResetAccount("101",id));assert(not f:ResetAccount("101",id))
   local nextA=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")];assert(nextA.Balance==10000 and not next(nextA.Positions)and not next(nextA.OpenOrders))
   assert(e.NextTrade==trades and f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==0 and not next(p.Awards))
   assert(not p.Absence and not p.AwaySummary)
   e:ProcessStops();e:AdvanceClock(.25);e:Audit()
   e,f=restore(e);assert(not next(e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")].Positions));assert(f:_counts(f:Profile("101"))==0);e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Earned balance and permanent rank survive healthy resets; reset tokens and ownership are enforced",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  p.Awards.FirstWin={StartingBonus=500};p.RankId="Apprentice";f:Evaluate("101",true)
  assert(not f:ResetAccount("101","player:other:single:1"))
  for _=1,L.ResetLimits.Burst do local id=p.Account;assert(f:ResetAccount("101",id));assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==15000 and p.RankId=="Apprentice")end
  assert(not f:ResetAccount("101",p.Account));e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Open positions remain open; gains before disconnect are excluded; summary acknowledgment persists",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+2);f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false)
  printPrice(e,entry+3);e:AdvanceClock(.25);f:Return("101",160)
  local p=f:Profile("101");local summary=p.AwaySummary
  assert(a.Positions.BX and summary.Seconds==60 and summary.Realized==0 and summary.UnrealizedChange==50 and summary.Total==50)
  assert(summary.Unrealized==150 and summary.Rows[1].Unrealized==150 and f:View("101").AwaySummary.Unrealized==150)
  local id=summary.Id;f:Return("101",170);assert(p.AwaySummary.Id==id)
  assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",id));assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",id))
  e,f=restore(e);assert(not f:Profile("101").AwaySummary);e:Audit()
 end)
 for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
  test((side==1 and "Long"or "Short").." offline "..field.." latches from executed history and settles once",function()
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2);local entry=held.Entry
   local threshold=entry+(field=="Stop"and -side or side)*4;held[field]=threshold
   printPrice(e,entry+side);f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false)
   printPrice(e,threshold)
   assert(held.Triggered==(field=="Stop"and "Stop loss"or "Take profit"))
   -- Real executable counterparties fill the protective reduction.
   T.Offer(e,"BX",side,2,threshold);e:ProcessStops()
   assert(not a.Positions.BX,"Protection must close against offered liquidity")
   printPrice(e,entry);e:ProcessStops()
   local count=f:_counts(f:Profile("101"));assert(count==1)
   e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",200)
   local p=f:Profile("101");local summary=p.AwaySummary
   assert(summary and #summary.Rows[1].Exits==1 and summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Reason==(field=="Stop"and "Stop loss"or "Take profit"))
   assert(summary.RealizedChange==(threshold-entry-side)*side*2*50 and summary.UnrealizedChange==0)
   assert(summary.Realized==(threshold-entry)*side*2*50 and summary.Unrealized==0)
   assert(summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Realized==summary.Realized)
   e:ProcessStops();assert(f:_counts(p)==count);e:Audit()
  end)
 end end
 test("Liquidation while absent uses an intervening execution, not recovered reconnect price",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,5);local entry=held.Entry
  f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false);printPrice(e,entry-40)
  assert(a.Depleted and held.Triggered=="Account depleted")
  T.Offer(e,"BX",1,5,entry-40);e:ProcessStops();printPrice(e,entry)
  f:Return("101",200);local summary=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary
  assert(summary.Total==-10000 and summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Reason=="Account depleted");e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Partial offline exits split carried-in, realized change and remaining unrealized change",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,2);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+2);f:Depart("101",100)
  assert(T.Submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}))
  printPrice(e,entry+3);f:Return("101",140);local s=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary
  assert(s.Realized==100 and s.CarriedIn==100 and s.RealizedChange==0 and s.UnrealizedChange==50 and s.Total==50)
  assert(s.Unrealized==150 and s.Realized+s.Unrealized==250)
  assert(s.Rows[1].Remaining==1);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Paused returns show full entry P&L for long and short gains and losses",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,move in ipairs({-8,8})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   printPrice(e,held.Entry+move);local expected=e:Summary(a).Unrealized
   f:Depart("101",100);e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",200)
   local summary=f:View("101").AwaySummary
   assert(expected==move*side*2*50 and summary.Unrealized==expected)
   assert(summary.Total==0 and summary.Realized==0 and summary.MarketSeconds==0)
   e:Audit()
  end end
 end)
 test("Older saved summaries recover full P&L from their return price without changing with live quotes",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,2);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+8);f:Depart("101",100);f:Return("101",200)
  local p=f:Profile("101");p.AwaySummary.Unrealized=nil;p.AwaySummary.Rows[1].Unrealized=nil
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");printPrice(e,entry+10)
  local summary=f:View("101").AwaySummary
  assert(summary.Unrealized==800 and summary.Rows[1].Unrealized==800 and summary.Total==0)
  assert(f:View("101").Open==1000 and p.AwaySummary.Unrealized==nil and p.AwaySummary.Rows[1].Unrealized==nil)
  assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",summary.Id));assert(not f:View("101").AwaySummary);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Price-history absence never creates returns while simulation is paused",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();open(e,a,-1);f:Depart("101",100);e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",86400)
  local s=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary;assert(s.MarketSeconds==0 and s.Total==0 and s.Rows[1].Remaining==1 and #s.Rows[1].Exits==0)
 end)
 test("Drag-created SL/TP validates both directions, stale quantities, wrong sides and duplicates",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
    local price=held.Entry+(field=="Stop"and -side or side)*2
    local req={Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection=field,Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=2,Price=price}
    assert(e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req))
   end
   assert(held.Stop and held.Target)
   e:CancelProtection(a.Id,held.Id,"Stop")
   local req={Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection="Stop",Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=1,Price=held.Entry-side*2}
   assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));req.ExpectedQuantity=2;req.Price=held.Entry+side*2;assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req))
   req.Price=0/0;assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Soft magnet chooses nearest OHLC, holds near ties and releases at different zoom levels",function()
  local c={Time=100,Open=100,Close=104,High=108,Low=96}
  for _,scale in ipairs({1,4,20})do
   local function y(p)return (110-p)*scale end
   local hit=Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)+.5);assert(hit and hit.Field=="High")
   assert(Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.Low)+.5).Field=="Low")
   assert(Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)-9,hit).Field=="High")
   assert(not Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)-12,hit))
  end
  assert(Tools.ProtectionField(1,100,99)=="Stop" and Tools.ProtectionField(1,100,101)=="Target")
  assert(Tools.ProtectionField(-1,100,99)=="Target" and Tools.ProtectionField(-1,100,101)=="Stop")
 end)
 test("Leaderboard projects raw account balance without changing negative accounting",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();a.Balance=-125;a.Realized=a.Balance-a.Base;a.Stats.UntrackedNet=a.Realized;a.Stats.Trades=1;a.Stats.Losses=1
  assert(Ranking.Row(f,"101").Cents==-12500 and a.Balance==-125)
 end)
 test("Reset confirmation keeps its original run token after a lost response",function()
  local M=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketClient);local session=M.New(nil,true)
  session.Preview=false;session.CanTrade=true;session.AccountToken="new-run"
  local captured;session.Remote={FireServer=function(_,request)captured=request end}

 end)
 return rows

-- Disposable exchanges only: close notifications must describe a whole position, not its last fill.
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local CP=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Liquidity=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
local Tests={}
local uid="closed-pnl-test"
local function fresh()
 local c=table.clone(C);local l=table.clone(L);l.StartingBalance=200000
 local e=E.new(c,8192);local f=F.new(e,l,c);f:Join(uid)
 return e,f,f:Owner(uid)
end
local function fill(e,id,key,side,qty,price,reduce)
 Liquidity.Offer(e,key,-side,qty,price)
 local ok,r=e:Submit(id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=reduce})
 assert(ok and r.Filled==qty,tostring(r));return r
end
local function near(actual,expected)
 assert(math.abs(actual-expected)<0.001,tostring(actual).." differs from "..tostring(expected))
end
local function closed(f,expected,qty)
 local events=f:TakeEvents(uid);assert(events and #events==1,"Expected one completed-position notification")
 local ev=events[1];assert(ev.Kind=="TradeClosed");near(ev.Pnl,expected)
 assert(ev.Quantity==qty and ev.PositionId and ev.TradeId,"Missing closed-position identity/quantity")
 assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"Close was announced twice");return ev
end
local function restore(e)
 local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(8192),Agents={}},P)
 local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),e.Config)
 return r,F.new(r,L,r.Config)
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={}
 local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,detail=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (detail or "Passed")or tostring(detail)})
 end
 for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,move in ipairs({4,-4,0})do
  test((side==1 and "Long"or "Short").." 40 + 20 + 30 + 30 contracts: whole-position PNL, move "..move,function()
   local e,f,id=fresh();local cost=0
   for _,entry in ipairs({{40,5825},{20,5826},{30,5827},{30,5828}})do
    fill(e,id,"BX",side,entry[1],entry[2]);cost+=entry[1]*entry[2]
   end
   local position=e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX;local positionId=position.Id
   local average=cost/120;near(position.Entry,average)
   assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"Entries should not announce a close")
   -- Offer 100 first, then the final 20 on a later step to exercise a partial close.
   local proceeds=0
   for _,q in ipairs({10,15,25,50})do
    local price=5826.5+side*move
    Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",side,q,price);proceeds+=q*price
   end
   local before=e.Accounts[id].Realized
   assert(F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"}))
   assert(e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Quantity==20)
   assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"A partial fill announced the whole trade closed")
   local finalPrice=5826.5+side*move;Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",side,20,finalPrice);proceeds+=20*finalPrice
   e:AdvanceClock(e.Config.StepSeconds);e:ProcessPlayerOrders();assert(not e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX)
   local expected=(proceeds-cost)*side*50;local ev=closed(f,expected,120)
   assert(ev.PositionId==positionId and ev.Reason=="Player close")
   near(e.Accounts[id].Realized-before,expected);near(ev.Balance,e.Accounts[id].Balance);e:Audit()
   return {Pnl=ev.Pnl,LastFillPnl=e.Accounts[id].History[1].Pnl,Quantity=ev.Quantity}
  end)
 end end
 test("Partial exits survive save/rejoin and trimmed history; new additions stay in the same trade",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();e.Config.MaxAccountHistory=2
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,40,5825)
  for _=1,5 do fill(e,id,"BX",-1,5,5827,true)end
  assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid));assert(#e.Accounts[id].History==2)
  e,f=restore(e)
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,20,5826)
  fill(e,id,"BX",-1,35,5828,true)
  closed(f,(25*2+15*3+20*2)*50,60)
  assert(not f:Profile(uid).PendingTradeCloses);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Prior trades and other open markets never enter the closed position total",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh()
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,2,5825);fill(e,id,"BX",-1,2,5832,true);closed(f,700,2)
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,4,5825);fill(e,id,"BT",-1,3,20480)
  fill(e,id,"BX",-1,1,5826,true);assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid))
  fill(e,id,"BT",1,3,20482,true);local other=closed(f,-120,3);assert(other.Contract=="BT")
  fill(e,id,"BX",-1,3,5827,true);closed(f,350,4)
  near(e.Accounts[id].Realized,930);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("A reversal completes the old trade and starts a separate result for the new direction",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh()
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,3,5825);fill(e,id,"BX",-1,1,5826,true)
  assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid))
  fill(e,id,"BX",-1,5,5827);closed(f,250,3)
  assert(e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Direction==-1 and e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Quantity==3)
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,3,5828,true);closed(f,-150,3);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Rewards earned on earlier fills accompany the final notification once",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();local profile=f:Profile(uid)
  -- Set only the test configuration threshold; the award still comes from real close accounting.
  local config=table.clone(f.Config);config.Milestones={{Id="FillReward",Kind="Profit",Goal=50,Title="Fill reward",Name="Fill reward",StartingBonus=0}}
  f.Config=config
  fill(e,id,"BX",1,3,5825);fill(e,id,"BX",-1,1,5826,true)
  assert(profile.Awards.FillReward and not f:TakeEvents(uid))
  fill(e,id,"BX",-1,2,5825,true);local ev=closed(f,50,3)

-- Persistent aggregate execution budgets. Cancelling, splitting requests, changing
-- instruments, or switching accounts of the same profile does not reset the allowance.
local Policy={}
function Policy.Owner(a)return tostring(a.ProfileId or a.Group or a.Id)end
function Policy.Liquidity(e,b,side)
 local depth=0
 for _,level in ipairs(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)do
  if Policy.Allows(e,b,level.Price,side)then for _,o in ipairs(level.Orders)do
   if not e.Accounts[o.Owner].Player then depth+=e:_available(o,true)end
  end end
 end
 return depth
end
function Policy.State(e)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution
 if not c then return nil end
 local window=math.floor(e.Time/c.WindowSeconds)
 if not e.Execution or e.Execution.Window~=window then
  e.Execution={Window=window,Owners={},Markets={},Cursor=e.Execution and e.Execution.Cursor or ""}
 end
 return e.Execution
end
function Policy.Budget(e,a,b,o)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution
 if not c or not a.Player then return math.huge end
 local state=Policy.State(e);local owner=Policy.Owner(a)..":"..o.Direction
 local market=b.Key..":"..o.Direction
 local budget=state.Markets[market]
 if not budget then
  local limit=c.MarketContracts
  if b.FairReference then
   local depth=Policy.Liquidity(e,b,o.Direction)
   limit=math.min(limit,math.floor(depth*c.BookFraction))
  end
  budget={Used=0,Limit=limit};state.Markets[market]=budget
 end
 -- New clicks join the queue behind other players already waiting on this side.
 if not e.ProcessingPlayerQueue then
  for _,other in pairs(e.Orders)do
   if other~=o and other.Queued and other.Contract==b.Key and other.Direction==o.Direction
    and Policy.Owner(e.Accounts[other.Owner])~=Policy.Owner(a)then return 0 end
  end
 end
 local available=math.max(0,math.min(c.OwnerContracts-(state.Owners[owner]or 0),budget.Limit-budget.Used))
 -- Recheck current real bot depth: withdrawals and player-owned spoof quotes
 -- cannot turn an earlier allowance into permission to consume the whole side.
 if available>0 and b.FairReference then available=math.min(available,math.floor(Policy.Liquidity(e,b,o.Direction)*c.BookFraction))end
 -- Share a thin market's allowance among the owners awaiting a turn. A fixed 5,000
 -- slice must not hand the entire small-book allowance to one owner per window.
 if e.ProcessingPlayerQueue and e.PlayerQueuePeers then
  available=math.min(available,math.max(1,math.floor(budget.Limit/math.min(c.OwnersPerStep,e.PlayerQueuePeers[market]or 1))))
 end
 return available
end
function Policy.Record(e,a,b,side,quantity)
 if not e.Config.PlayerExecution or not a.Player then return end
 local s=Policy.State(e);local owner=Policy.Owner(a)..":"..side;local market=b.Key..":"..side
 s.Owners[owner]=(s.Owners[owner]or 0)+quantity
 if s.Markets[market]then s.Markets[market].Used+=quantity end
end
-- Standard limits must either finish matching the crossed liquidity or rest without
-- crossing the book. Reject a blocked submission/amendment before any fill or cancel.
function Policy.StandardLimitAllowed(e,a,b,o,price,quantity)
 if not a.Player or not e.Config.PlayerExecution then return true end
 local side=o.Direction
 if not Policy.Allows(e,b,price,side)then return false end
 local allowance=Policy.Budget(e,a,b,o)
 local needed=0
 for _,level in ipairs(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)do
  if (level.Price-price)*side>0 then break end
  for _,resting in ipairs(level.Orders)do
   local ra=e.Accounts[resting.Owner]
   local same=resting.Owner==a.Id or a.Group and ra.Group==a.Group or a.ProfileId and ra.ProfileId==a.ProfileId
   local available=not same and e:_available(resting,true)or 0
   if available>0 then
    if not Policy.Allows(e,b,level.Price,side)then return false end
    needed+=math.min(available,quantity-needed)
    if needed>allowance then return false end
    if needed>=quantity then return true end
   end
  end
 end
 return true
end
function Policy.Allows(e,b,price,side)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution
 return not c or not b.FairReference or (price-b.FairReference)*side<=c.GuardTicks*math.max(1,b.Spec.Scale or 1)
end
function Policy.Process(e)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution;if not c then return end
 local state=Policy.State(e);local pending={}
 for _,o in pairs(e.Orders)do if o.Queued then
  local a=e.Accounts[o.Owner];local owner=Policy.Owner(a);local old=pending[owner]
  -- Protective exits get priority within one player's queue, then oldest order first.
  if not old or o.ReduceOnly and not old.ReduceOnly or o.ReduceOnly==old.ReduceOnly and o.Id<old.Id then pending[owner]=o end
 end end
 local owners={}for owner in pairs(pending)do table.insert(owners,owner)end;table.sort(owners)
 if #owners==0 then return end
 local peers={};for _,o in pairs(pending)do local key=o.Contract..":"..o.Direction;peers[key]=(peers[key]or 0)+1 end
 e.PlayerQueuePeers=peers
 local start=1;for i,owner in ipairs(owners)do if owner>state.Cursor then start=i;break elseif i==#owners then start=1 end end
 e.ProcessingPlayerQueue=true
 for offset=0,math.min(#owners,c.OwnersPerStep)-1 do
  local owner=owners[(start+offset-1)%#owners+1];local o=pending[owner]
  if e.Orders[o.Id] and (e:_available(o,false)<=0 or Policy.Budget(e,e.Accounts[o.Owner],e.Books[o.Contract],o)>0)then
   local filled=o.Filled;e:_match(e.Accounts[o.Owner],e.Books[o.Contract],o)
   if o.Filled>filled then state.Cursor=owner end
  end
 end
 e.ProcessingPlayerQueue=nil;e.PlayerQueuePeers=nil
end
return Policy

end

function Tests.Run()
 local results={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and r or tostring(r)})end
 test("Billion-dollar balances retain buying power while spam shares one allowance",function()

  assert(e:ContractLimit(a)==10000000)
  for _=1,40 do

local function counts(book)
 local result={};for _,side in ipairs({"Bids","Asks"})do result[side]={};for _,l in ipairs(book[side])do table.insert(result[side],l.Quantity)end end

end
function Tests.Run()
 local results={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and r or tostring(r)})end
 test("Production reserve quotes vary by instrument and occupy consecutive ticks",function()
  local e,p=fixture(fixed());local report={}

   local b=e.Books[key];report[key]=counts(b)

     assert(l.Quantity>0 and l.Quantity<500,"Oversized reserve wall")

 test("Actual production simulation remains finite, varied and deterministic",function()
  local report={}

   local e,p=fixture(nil,seed);local stats={}
   for _,key in ipairs(C.ContractOrder)do stats[key]={Samples=0,Total=0,Max=0,Empty=0}end

-- Server-only chat command. Uses the same creator/group-owner policy as /reset.
local Owner=require(script.Parent.OwnerResetCommand)
local Command={MaxAmount=1000000000000};Command.__index=Command
local powers={k=3,m=6,b=9,t=12}
function Command.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string"or #text>100 then return nil end
 local alias,name,token=text:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+@?([%w_]+)%s+(%S+)%s*$")
 if not alias or alias:lower()~="/give"or #name<3 or #name>20 then return nil end
 local digits,suffix=token:lower():match("^([%d%.]+)([kmbt]?)$")
 if not digits then return nil end
 local whole,fraction=digits:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
 if not whole then whole=digits:match("^(%d+)$");fraction=""end
 if not whole then return nil end
 fraction=fraction:gsub("0+$","")
 local power=powers[suffix]or 0
 -- Scale decimal digits as integers so 1.001k is exactly 1001 dollars.
 if #fraction>power then return nil end
 local amount=tonumber(whole..fraction)*10^(power-#fraction)
 if not amount or amount<1 or amount>Command.MaxAmount or amount%1~=0 then return nil end
 return name,amount
end
function Command.new(options)return setmetatable({Options=options,Busy=false,LastAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})},Command)end
function Command:Handle(player,text)
 local o=self.Options;local now=(o.Now or os.clock)()
 if now-(self.LastAt[player]or -math.huge)<2 then return end;self.LastAt[player]=now
 if not Owner.IsOwner(player.UserId,o.CreatorType,o.CreatorId,o.GroupLookup)then o.Notify(player,"Only the experience owner can use /give.");return end
 local name,amount=Command.Parse(text)
 if not name then o.Notify(player,"Usage: /give <exact Roblox username> <amount>. Examples: 1k, 1.5m, 10m, 1b, 1t. Range: $1–$1 trillion, whole dollars.");return end
 if self.Busy then o.Notify(player,"A money grant is already being saved. Please wait.");return end
 if not o.Ready()then o.Notify(player,"The saved exchange is busy or unavailable. Try /give again shortly.");return end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local found,uid,canonical=pcall(o.Resolve,name)
  if not found or type(uid)~="number"or uid<=0 or uid%1~=0 or type(canonical)~="string"or canonical:lower()~=name:lower()then
   o.Notify(player,"Username not found. Use the exact current Roblox username, not a display name.");return
  end
  local saved,message=o.Give(uid,canonical,amount,player.UserId)
  o.Notify(player,message)
 end)
 self.Busy=false
 if not ok then
  warn("[Get Funded!] Owner give failed: "..tostring(err))
  o.Notify(player,"Grant could not be confirmed. Check the saved balance before retrying /give.")
 end
end
return Command

local function fresh()
 local e=E.new(C,934);local f=F.new(e,L,C);f:Join("101");return e,f,f:Owner("101")

 function s:UpdateAsync(_,callback)

  if self.LostReply then error("Injected lost grant confirmation")end

 end
 function s:GetAsync()return clone(self.Value)end
 local c=clone(C);c.WarmupSeconds=0
 local w=W.new(c,{Studio=false,PlaceId=123,JobId="give-test",CanOwn=true,Store=s,Now=function()return 1000 end})
 w:Open();assert(w:CanRun(),w.LastError)
 F.new(w.Engine,L,c):Join("101");assert(w:Save(false));return w,s
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and(r or "Passed")or tostring(r)})end
 test("Parser accepts exact usernames and positive whole dollars only",function()
  local name,n=Command.Parse(" /GIVE @Trader_123 50000 ");assert(name=="Trader_123"and n==50000)
  assert(select(2,Command.Parse("/give Trader 1000000000000"))==Command.MaxAmount)
  for _,v in ipairs({"/give","/give Trader","/give Trader 0","/give Trader -1","/give Trader 1.5","/give Trader nan","/give Trader inf","/give Trader 1e6","/give Trader 1000000000001","/give Display Name 100","/give Trader 100 extra","/give * 100"})do assert(not Command.Parse(v),v)end
 end)
 test("Amount shortcuts scale exact whole dollars and reject malformed or excessive amounts",function()
  for token,expected in pairs({["1k"]=1000,["1m"]=1000000,["10m"]=10000000,["1b"]=1000000000,["1t"]=1000000000000,
   ["1K"]=1000,["1.5M"]=1500000,["0.5B"]=500000000,["0.001T"]=1000000000,["1.001k"]=1001,["0.001k"]=1})do
   assert(select(2,Command.Parse("/give Trader "..token))==expected,token)
  end
  for _,token in ipairs({"1kk","1q","1..5m","1.m",".5m","-1m","0k","1.0001k","1.000000000001b","1.1t","2t","1e3k","1,000k"})do
   assert(not Command.Parse("/give Trader "..token),token)
  end
 end)
 test("Non-owner is rejected before any lookup or grant",function()
  local notices={};local command=Command.new({CreatorType=Enum.CreatorType.User,CreatorId=1,
   Resolve=function()error("Unauthorized lookup")end,Give=function()error("Unauthorized grant")end,
   Notify=function(_,message)table.insert(notices,message)end})
  command:Handle({UserId=2},"/give Trader 50000");assert(#notices==1 and notices[1]:find("Only the experience owner"))
 end)
 test("Owner grant resolves canonical username and forwards only validated inputs",function()
  local count=0;local now=100;local player={UserId=1};local notices={}
  local command=Command.new({CreatorType=Enum.CreatorType.User,CreatorId=1,Now=function()return now end,Ready=function()return true end,
   Resolve=function(name)assert(name=="trader");return 101,"Trader"end,
   Give=function(uid,name,amount,actor)assert(uid==101 and name=="Trader"and amount==50000 and actor==1);count+=1;return true,"Saved"end,
   Notify=function(_,message)table.insert(notices,message)end})
  command:Handle(player,"/give trader 50k");command:Handle(player,"/give trader 50k")
  assert(count==1 and notices[1]=="Saved"and not command.Busy)
  now+=3;command.Options.Resolve=function()return 101,"WrongUser"end
  command:Handle(player,"/give trader 50000");assert(count==1 and notices[#notices]:find("Username not found"))
 end)
 test("Group owner is authorized; group members and unavailable exchanges cannot grant",function()
  local count=0;local command=Command.new({CreatorType=Enum.CreatorType.Group,CreatorId=77,GroupLookup=function()return {Owner={Id=1}}end,
   Ready=function()return true end,Resolve=function()return 101,"Trader"end,Give=function()count+=1;return true,"Saved"end,Notify=function()end})
  command:Handle({UserId=2},"/give Trader 1");assert(count==0)
  command:Handle({UserId=1},"/give Trader 1");assert(count==1)
  command.Options.Ready=function()return false end;command:Handle({UserId=1},"/give Trader 1");assert(count==1)
 end)
 test("Grant adds capital without altering open trades, profit, ranks or statistics",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopTicks=10,TargetTicks=20}))
  local a=e.Accounts[id];local p=a.Positions.BX;local entry,stop,target=p.Entry,p.Stop,p.Target
  local tradeCount=e.NextTrade;assert(f:GrantMoney("101",50000,1,"receipt-a")==60000)
  assert(a.Base==60000 and a.Balance==60000 and a.Realized==0 and a.Limit==60 and a.Positions.BX==p)
  assert(p.Entry==entry and p.Stop==stop and p.Target==target and e.NextTrade==tradeCount)
  f:Evaluate("101");assert(f:Earned(f:Profile("101"))==0 and not next(f:Profile("101").Awards)and a.Stats.Trades==0)
  e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Receipt replay is idempotent after checkpoint restore",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();f:GrantMoney("101",10000000000,1,"receipt-b")
  local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=C,Random=P.RNG.new(934),Agents={}},P)
  local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),C);local rf=F.new(r,L,C)
  assert(rf:GrantMoney("101",10000000000,1,"receipt-b")==10000010000)
  assert(r.Accounts[id].Balance==10000010000 and #rf:Profile("101").MoneyGrants==1)
  assert(not pcall(function()rf:GrantMoney("101",1,1,"receipt-b")end));r:Audit()
 end)
 test("Offline new players receive one account; malformed and blown-account grants fail",function()
  local e,f=fresh();assert(f:GrantMoney("202",50000,1,"offline")==60000)
  assert(#f:Profile("202").Ledger==1 and f:Owner("202"))
  local a=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")];a.Depleted=true;a.Locked=true
  assert(not pcall(function()f:GrantMoney("101",1,1,"failed")end));assert(a.Balance==10000)
  for _,value in ipairs({0,-1,1.5,math.huge,0/0,1000000000001})do
   assert(not pcall(function()f:GrantMoney("202",value,1,"invalid")end))
  end
  assert(e.Accounts[f:Owner("202")].Balance==60000);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Confirmed save installs the grant and survives reload",function()
  local w,s=world();local original=w.Engine
  local ok,balance=w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):GrantMoney("101",1000000000000,1,"saved")end)
  assert(ok and balance==1000000010000 and w.Engine~=original)
  local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(s.Value.Checkpoint),C);assert(r.Accounts[r.Profiles["101"].Account].Balance==1000000010000);r:Audit()
 end)
 test("Trillion-dollar grants retain trading and account limit safeguards",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();f:GrantMoney("101",1000000000000,1,"trillion")
  assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,id,{Contract="BG",Direction=1,Quantity=3,Type="Market"}))
  assert(Liquidity.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="BG"}));e:Audit()
  assert(f:Earned(f:Profile("101"))==e.Accounts[id].Realized)
  f:GrantMoney("101",1000000000000,1,"second");f:GrantMoney("101",1000000000000,1,"third")
  local before=e.Accounts[id].Balance
  assert(not pcall(function()f:GrantMoney("101",1000000000000,1,"over-limit")end))
  assert(e.Accounts[id].Balance==before);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Failed save never credits the live or durable account",function()
  local w,s=world();s.Fail=true
  assert(not w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):GrantMoney("101",50000,1,"fail")end))
  assert(not w.Engine and not w:CanRun());s.Fail=false;w:Open();assert(w:CanRun())
  assert(w.Engine.Accounts[w.Engine.Profiles["101"].Account].Balance==10000)
 end)
 test("Lost acknowledgement recovers exactly the committed grant",function()
  local w,s=world();s.LostReply=true
  assert(not w:TransformSaved(function(e)return F.new(e,L,C):GrantMoney("101",50000,1,"lost")end))
  s.LostReply=false;w:Open();assert(w:CanRun())
  local f=F.new(w.Engine,L,C);assert(f:GrantMoney("101",50000,1,"lost")==60000)
  assert(w.Engine.Accounts[f:Owner("101")].Balance==60000);w.Engine:Audit()
 end)
 return rows
end
return Tests

local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local CP=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Client=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketClient)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Tests={}
local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function fresh()
 local c=clone(C);c.PlayerExecution.SliceContracts=2;c.PlayerExecution.OwnerContracts=8;c.PlayerExecution.MarketContracts=20
 local e=E.new(c,937);e:AddAccount("user",1000000,1000,.8,true);e:AddAccount("maker",1000000,1000,.8,false)
 local price=c.Contracts.BX.Last
 assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Type="Limit",Direction=-1,Quantity=100,Price=price}))
 return e,c,price
end
local function submit(e,mode,kind,price)
 return e:Submit("user",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=20,Type=kind or "Market",Price=price,Execution=mode})
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(r)})end
 test("Default market fills immediately within budget, cancels remainder and never resumes",function()
  local e,c=fresh();local ok,r=submit(e);assert(ok and r.Filled==8 and r.Cancelled==12 and r.Remaining==0 and not r.Queued)
  assert(not e.Orders[r.Id]);e:AdvanceClock(c.PlayerExecution.WindowSeconds);e:ProcessPlayerOrders()
  assert(e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==8);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Explicit slicing continues and cancellation stops later fills",function()
  local e,c=fresh();local ok,r=submit(e,"Sliced");assert(ok and r.Filled==2 and r.Remaining==18 and r.Queued)
  e:ProcessPlayerOrders();assert(e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==4)
  assert(e:Cancel("user",r.Id));e:AdvanceClock(c.PlayerExecution.WindowSeconds);e:ProcessPlayerOrders()
  assert(e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==4);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Changing modes never resets the shared allowance",function()
  local e=fresh();assert(submit(e,"Immediate"));local ok,r=submit(e,"Sliced")
  assert(ok and r.Filled==0 and r.Queued);assert(e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==8);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Empty market cancels standard order and retains explicitly sliced order",function()
  local e=fresh();e:CancelAll("maker");local ok,r=submit(e,"Immediate")
  assert(ok and r.Filled==0 and r.Cancelled==20 and not e.Orders[r.Id])
  local yes,s=submit(e,"Sliced");assert(yes and s.Queued and s.Remaining==20);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Standard marketable limits reject blocked submissions without creating an order",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();local ok,r=submit(e,"Immediate","Limit",price)
  assert(not ok and r:find("No order placed",1,true)and not next(e.Accounts.user.OpenOrders)and not next(e.Accounts.user.Positions));e:Audit()
  local yes,passive=submit(e,"Immediate","Limit",price-c.Contracts.BX.Tick)
  assert(yes and not passive.Queued and passive.Remaining==20 and #e.Books.BX.Bids==1);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Sliced limits preserve execution choice when amended",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();local ok,r=submit(e,"Sliced","Limit",price-c.Contracts.BX.Tick);assert(ok and not r.Queued)
  assert(e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=price-c.Contracts.BX.Tick,ExpectedQuantity=20,Price=price}))
  assert(e.Orders[r.Id].Queued and e.Orders[r.Id].Execution=="Sliced");e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Limit amendment reports partial fills, retained remainders and full fills",function()
  local function amend(e,r,old,price,quantity)
   local ok,result=e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=old,ExpectedQuantity=quantity,Price=price})
   assert(ok and type(result)=="table"and result.Amended);return result,F.Describe(result)
  end
  -- Standard consumes the eligible liquidity and keeps the unfilled remainder on the book.
  local e,c,price=fresh();e:CancelAll("maker")
  assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=8,Type="Limit",Price=price}))
  local _,r=submit(e,"Immediate","Limit",price-2*c.Contracts.BX.Tick)
  local result,message=amend(e,r,price-2*c.Contracts.BX.Tick,price,20)
  assert(result.Filled==8 and result.Cancelled==0 and result.Remaining==12 and not result.Queued)
  assert(message:find("Partially filled 8 of 20",1,true)and message:find("12 still working",1,true));e:Audit()
  -- No cross: the order remains working and the message includes the quantity.
  local a,config,p=fresh();local _,passive=submit(a,"Immediate","Limit",p-2*config.Contracts.BX.Tick)
  local idle,text=amend(a,passive,p-2*config.Contracts.BX.Tick,p-config.Contracts.BX.Tick,20)
  assert(idle.Filled==0 and idle.Remaining==20 and text:find("20 still working",1,true));a:Audit()
  -- Full fill: only a genuinely completed fill receives that description.
  config.PlayerExecution.OwnerContracts=100;config.PlayerExecution.MarketContracts=100
  local full,confirmation=amend(a,passive,p-config.Contracts.BX.Tick,p,20)
  assert(full.Filled==20 and full.Cancelled==0 and full.Remaining==0 and confirmation:find("Filled 20 @",1,true));a:Audit()
 end)
 test("Blocked buy and sell amendments preserve order identity, FIFO, protection and quantity",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,c,price=fresh();e:CancelAll("maker")
   assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-side,Quantity=100,Type="Limit",Price=price}))
   local old=price-side*c.Contracts.BX.Tick
   local ok,r=e:Submit("user",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=20,Type="Limit",Price=old,Execution="Immediate",StopTicks=10,TargetTicks=20});assert(ok)
   local o=e.Orders[r.Id];local before=clone(o);local revision=e.Accounts.user.Revision;local nextPriority=e.NextPriority
   local accepted,message=e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=old,ExpectedQuantity=20,Price=price})
   assert(not accepted and message:find("original limit order is unchanged",1,true))
   for k,v in pairs(before)do assert(o[k]==v,k)end
   assert(e.Orders[r.Id]==o and e.Accounts.user.Revision==revision and e.NextPriority==nextPriority and not next(e.Accounts.user.Positions))
   local levels=side==1 and e.Books.BX.Bids or e.Books.BX.Asks;assert(levels[1].Orders[1]==o);e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Exhausted budgets and price guards reject moves before any fill or self-trade cancellation",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();assert(submit(e,"Immediate"))
  local old=price-2*c.Contracts.BX.Tick;local ok,r=submit(e,"Immediate","Limit",old);assert(ok)
  local selfOk,selfOrder=e:Submit("user",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price-c.Contracts.BX.Tick,Execution="Immediate"});assert(selfOk)
  assert(not e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=old,ExpectedQuantity=20,Price=price}))
  assert(e.Orders[r.Id].Remaining==20 and e.Orders[r.Id].Price==old/c.Contracts.BX.Tick and e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==8)
  assert(e.Orders[selfOrder.Id]and e.Orders[selfOrder.Id].Remaining==1,"Rejected move cancelled a self-owned quote")
  e.Books.BX.FairReference=e.Books.BX.Reference
  local tooFar=price+(c.PlayerExecution.GuardTicks+1)*c.Contracts.BX.Tick
  assert(not e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=old,ExpectedQuantity=20,Price=tooFar}))
  assert(e.Orders[r.Id].Price==old/c.Contracts.BX.Tick);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Standard limit remainder stays on book, fills on later orders and survives restore",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,c,price=fresh();e:CancelAll("maker")
   assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-side,Quantity=8,Type="Limit",Price=price}))
   local ok,r=e:Submit("user",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=20,Type="Limit",Price=price,Execution="Immediate"})
   assert(ok and r.Filled==8 and r.Remaining==12 and r.Cancelled==0 and not r.Queued);e:Audit()
   local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=c,Random=P.RNG.new(937),Agents={}},P)
   local restored=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),c)
   local o=restored.Orders[r.Id];assert(o and o.Remaining==12 and not o.Queued and o.Execution=="Immediate")
   local filled,result=restored:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-side,Quantity=12,Type="Market"})
   assert(filled and result.Filled==12 and not restored.Orders[r.Id]);restored:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Repeated sliced amendments report new fills without counting previous executions again",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();local _,r=submit(e,"Sliced","Limit",price)
  assert(r.Filled==2 and r.Remaining==18)
  local ok,result=e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=price,ExpectedQuantity=18,Price=price+c.Contracts.BX.Tick})
  assert(ok and result.Filled==2 and result.Remaining==16 and result.Cancelled==0 and result.Queued)
  assert(F.Describe(result):find("2 filled, 16 remaining",1,true));assert(e.Orders[r.Id].Filled==4);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Moving a partially filled limit without new matches never reports historical fills as new",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();local _,r=submit(e,"Sliced","Limit",price)
  local ok,result=e:AmendOrder("user",{Contract="BX",OrderId=r.Id,ExpectedPrice=price,ExpectedQuantity=18,Price=price-c.Contracts.BX.Tick})
  assert(ok and result.Filled==0 and result.Remaining==18 and not result.Queued and result.Average==nil)
  assert(F.Describe(result):find("No new fills · 18 still working",1,true));e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Triggered stops honor standard versus sliced execution",function()
  for _,mode in ipairs({"Immediate","Sliced"})do
   local e,c,price=fresh();local ok,r=submit(e,mode,"Stop",price+c.Contracts.BX.Tick);assert(ok)
   e.Orders[r.Id].Triggered=e.Time;e:ProcessStops()
   assert((e.Orders[r.Id]~=nil)==(mode=="Sliced"));assert(e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX.Quantity==(mode=="Sliced"and 2 or 8));e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Invalid execution mode cannot create orders or fills",function()
  local e=fresh();local before=e.NextOrder
  for _,mode in ipairs({"Unlimited","",true,7,{}})do assert(not submit(e,mode))end
  assert(e.NextOrder==before and not next(e.Accounts.user.OpenOrders));e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Execution choice and existing queued orders survive checkpoint restore",function()
  local e,c,price=fresh();local _,r=submit(e,"Sliced")
  local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=c,Random=P.RNG.new(937),Agents={}},P)
  local saved=CP.Capture(e,pop);local restored=CP.Restore(saved,c)
  assert(restored.Orders[r.Id].Execution=="Sliced"and restored.Orders[r.Id].Queued);restored:Audit()
  for _,o in ipairs(saved.Engine.Orders)do if o.Id==r.Id then o.Execution=nil end end
  local legacy=CP.Restore(saved,c);assert(legacy.Orders[r.Id].Execution=="Sliced"and legacy.Orders[r.Id].Queued)
 end)
 test("Client forwards selection and defaults to standard",function()
  local s=Client.New(10000,true);s.Ready=true;local sent
  s.Send=function(_,action,request)assert(action=="Place");sent=request;return true end
  assert(s:Place("BX",1,20,"Market"));assert(sent.Execution=="Immediate")
  assert(s:Place("BX",1,20,"Market",nil,nil,nil,"Sliced"));assert(sent.Execution=="Sliced")
  s:Destroy()
 end)
 test("Triggered take profits stay labelled as closing protection through partial fills and restore",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do
   local e,c,price=fresh();e:CancelAll("maker");e:AddAccount("trigger",1000000,1000,.8,false)
   assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-side,Quantity=3,Type="Limit",Price=price}))
   local ok,entry=e:Submit("user",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=3,Type="Market",TargetTicks=4});assert(ok and entry.Filled==3)
   local p=e.Accounts.user.Positions.BX;local target=p.Target
   -- An unrelated trade touches TP but consumes the available counterpart liquidity.
   assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=target}))
   assert(e:Submit("trigger",{Contract="BX",Direction=-side,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
   e:ProcessStops();assert(p.Triggered=="Take profit"and p.ExitOrder)
   local exit=e.Orders[p.ExitOrder];assert(exit.ReduceOnly and exit.Direction==-side and exit.Type=="Limit")
   local function check(engine,quantity)
    local snapshot=engine:Snapshot("user","BX","1m",false);assert(#snapshot.Orders==1)
    local order=snapshot.Orders[1]
    assert(order.Protection=="Target"and order.Closing and order.Quantity==quantity and order.Type==nil)
    assert(order.Kind==(side==-1 and "Take profit · closing short"or "Take profit · closing long"))
    assert(snapshot.Positions.BX.Direction==side and snapshot.Positions.BX.Quantity==quantity)
   end
   check(e,3);e:Audit()
   local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=c,Random=P.RNG.new(937),Agents={}},P)
   local restored=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),c);check(restored,3)
   local filled,r=restored:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});assert(filled and r.Filled==1)
   check(restored,2)
   local done,result=restored:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=2,Type="Market"});assert(done and result.Filled==2)
   local snapshot=restored:Snapshot("user","BX","1m",false)
   assert(not snapshot.Positions.BX and #snapshot.Orders==0,"Protective exit left or reversed the position");restored:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Trillion-dollar settlement does not accumulate balance rounding drift",function()
  local c=clone(C);c.PlayerExecution=nil
  local e=E.new(c,91);local a=e:AddAccount("large",1e12,100000,.8,true);e:AddAccount("counter",1e11,100000,.8,false)
  local price=c.Contracts.BG.Last;local tick=c.Contracts.BG.Tick
  local function fill(side,qty,p)
   assert(e:Submit("counter",{Contract="BG",Direction=-side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=p}))
   local ok,r=e:Submit("large",{Contract="BG",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market"});assert(ok and r.Filled==qty)
  end
  for _=1,1000 do fill(1,1,price);fill(1,2,price+tick);fill(-1,3,price+tick)end
  assert(math.abs(a.Balance-a.Base-a.Realized)<.001);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Restore repairs only sub-cent large-account drift and still rejects larger discrepancies",function()
  local e,c=fresh();local a=e.Accounts.user;a.Base=1e12;a.Balance=1e12
  local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=c,Random=P.RNG.new(937),Agents={}},P)
  local saved=CP.Capture(e,pop)
  for _,account in ipairs(saved.Engine.Accounts)do if account.Id=="user"then account.Balance+=.0011 end end
  local restored=CP.Restore(saved,c);assert(restored.Accounts.user.Balance==1e12);restored:Audit()
  for _,account in ipairs(saved.Engine.Accounts)do if account.Id=="user"then account.Balance+=.1 end end
  assert(not pcall(function()CP.Restore(saved,c)end))
 end)
 return rows
end
return Tests
